data.name: My Little Village
data.description_full:
My Little Village — a Vietnamese village-building game in an idle simulation style. Build houses, expand your neighborhood, recruit residents, trade, and grow your very own rural community! A simulation game that captures the essence of traditional Vietnamese life, deeply filled with nostalgic childhood memories.

🏡 BUILD & EXPAND YOUR VILLAGE
Start from a few simple cottages, and step-by-step build and upgrade them into a bustling, lively neighborhood. Construct residential houses, street-corner tea stalls, rural markets, schools, medical clinics, and dozens of other community buildings. Each new structure unlocks new professions, daily life activities, and trading opportunities for the whole village. Plan, arrange, and decorate your neighborhood in your own unique style.

👫 RECRUIT & MANAGE RESIDENTS
Every resident in the village has their own distinct personality, dream job, and daily routine. Recruit new residents and match the right person to the right job — from the hard-working farmer in the field, the cheerful vendor at the rural market, to the highly skilled carpenter. Build close-knit neighborly relationships and watch your community grow stronger every day. Complete quests from residents to earn rewards and unlock new content.

🌾 ENJOY THE VIBE OF VIETNAMESE COUNTRYSIDE
Golden rice fields, water buffaloes lazily grazing, a shimmering fish pond in the afternoon, and the cheerful laughter of neighbors — a peaceful, tranquil atmosphere that brings you back to your most beautiful childhood memories. The traditional Vietnamese countryside setting is authentically recreated with a cute, bright, and familiar art style. Experience the beauty of folk culture, traditional crafts, bustling village markets, and vibrant village festivals.

⏰ IDLE - RELAXING CASUAL GAMEPLAY EVERY DAY
My Little Village is an idle game - gather resources automatically without needing to be online constantly or connected to the internet 24/7. Just open the game for a few minutes a day to manage your village, harvest resources, and feel the warm, little joys of life. Perfectly suited for busy people who want to unwind with a gentle, pressure-free, and non-competitive game - play at your own pace.

🎮 HIGHLIGHT FEATURES
• Build and upgrade dozens of traditional Vietnamese village structures
• Recruit residents with diverse personalities and professions
• Dynamic economic system: trading, manufacturing, and harvesting crops
• Complete quests and events to unlock brand new areas
• Cute graphics with a distinct Vietnamese art style
• Offline idle game: casual play, automatic resource collection
• Free to download, suitable for all ages
• Regular content updates with new events and residents

📲 Download MY LITTLE VILLAGE today — build your dream village, rediscover your childhood memories, and enjoy a peaceful life in our little neighborhood!

Developer: COROCHTI
Genre: Simulation | Idle | Village Building | Casual

data.name: Lucky Water Sort Master
data.description_full:
Enter a dazzling rainbow laboratory where every test tube sparkles and every pour counts! Lucky Water Sort Master invites you to slip on virtual gloves and become a true color-sorting scientist. Each level presents a rack of crystal-clear test tubes filled with layered liquids in vibrant hues. Your mission is elegantly simple yet endlessly engaging: tap to select a tube, tap again to pour, and watch as streams of liquid cascade downward. Only matching colors can stack, so plan each move carefully to avoid muddy mixtures. When every tube finally glows with a single, pure shade, the board clears in a splash of confetti and your coin vault overflows with instant rewards.

How to Play
- Tap any tube to select it, then tap a second tube to transfer liquid; identical colors blend seamlessly
- Fill an entire tube with one color to lock it and open up precious space for new combinations
- Continue pouring, blending and locking until every drop is sorted, then celebrate as big bonuses flood your balance

Key Features
- Escalating difficulty: more colors, tighter tubes, trickier layer patterns that test your logic and foresight
- Huge completion bonuses: finish stages to earn mountains of gleaming coins and unlock dazzling new tube skins
- Rich toolkit: Undo last pour, Add Extra Tube, Shuffle Colors and more power-ups to break any deadlock
- Daily challenges and bonus levels keep the rewards flowing, while leaderboards let you showcase your sorting mastery

Lucky Water Sort Master—pour smart, sort fast, and let an endless river of prizes carry you to victory!
data.description_short: Sort colors, fill tubes, conquer levels!

As you progress, the grids grow larger, the paths become more complex, and your planning skills are pushed to the limit. Every successful clear earns you rewards – the smarter you play, the more you earn!

Simple Yet Deep Mechanics: Easy to understand, but increasingly challenging to master. Every level requires careful thought and strategic sequencing.

Minimalist & Clean Design: A distraction-free visual style that lets you focus entirely on the puzzle. Beautiful colors and smooth animations make every move a pleasure.

Relaxing, No-Pressure Gameplay: No timers, no rushing, no stress. Play at your own pace and enjoy the satisfaction of solving each puzzle.

Hint System: Stuck on a tough level? Use hints to get a gentle nudge in the right direction and keep progressing.

Heart System: You start each puzzle with a set of hearts. Make a mistake and lose one – clear the grid without losing them all to achieve a perfect victory and bigger rewards!

Perfect for Quick Sessions or Long Play: Whether you have five minutes or an hour, Arrow Smash: Earn Cash fits your schedule.

Why You'll Love It:

Arrow Smash: Earn Cash is the perfect game for players who love to exercise their brain without the pressure of timers or fast reflexes. Triunfo Bet is a sports prediction game that challenges players to forecast the outcomes of dynamically generated sporting events across soccer, basketball, tennis, and American football. Each round presents a unique matchup between teams or athletes with individual strength ratings, and players must decide quickly who will win before the timer runs out triunfo bet app venezuela.

The game features a lives-based survival system combined with a streak multiplier mechanic. Consecutive correct predictions build a streak that awards bonus points, while incorrect guesses cost lives. Once all lives are lost, the game ends and players receive a performance rank ranging from Novice to Oracle based on their final score triunfo bet venezuela.

Three difficulty levels control the decision timer, letting players choose between a relaxed or high-pressure experience triunfo bet app. A dedicated statistics screen tracks lifetime performance including total predictions, accuracy percentage, best streaks, and high scores, all saved locally for offline access.

The application also includes an educational Sports Insights section with interesting facts about prediction science, home advantage statistics, momentum effects, and historical connections between sports and forecasting.

triunfo bet colombia is designed as a fully offline single-player experience with a professional dark interface inspired by competitive esports aesthetics. Custom typography, responsive layouts, and carefully crafted visual effects create a polished experience on devices of all screen sizes.

data.name: American Stock Car Series
data.description_full:
Compete in the ultimate American Stock Car Series championship featuring 40 cars on track and a unique competition format inspired by America's greatest stock car racing series

The championship consists of 26 races. During the first 16 races of the Regular Season, drivers battle to finish among the top 16. Only those drivers qualify for the Final Phase, where the last 10 races determine the champion, while all 40 cars continue racing in every event.

Race across 26 events on nascar style oval tracks located throughout the United States:
California, Tennessee, Darlington, Florida, Dover, Madison, Carolina, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Virginia, Michigan, Ohio, Texas and Arizona.

In addition to the championship, enjoy every circuit available in Fx Racer, including 13 spectacular oval tracks, all available for Quick Races, Practice Sessions, and Online Multiplayer Duels.

Main Features
American Stock Car Series Championship.
26-race season.
40 cars racing simultaneously.
16-race Regular Season.
10-race Final Phase featuring the top 16 drivers.
More than 30 circuits, including 13 oval tracks.
Online 1 vs 1 multiplayer.
Private online duels with friends.
Quick Race mode.
Practice Sessions.
Qualifying before every championship race.
Two driving modes: Standard and Simulation.
Race strategy.
Pit stops with tire changes.
Complete car setup.
Up to 50 upgrades for every car.
Dynamic weather.
Car livery editor.

Standard and Simulation Modes
Choose between two completely different driving experiences

Standard Mode delivers fast-paced, arcade-style racing with spectacular action.

Simulation Mode is designed for demanding players, featuring more realistic physics, no traction control, and authentic vehicle handling.

Car Setup
Fine-tune every aspect of your car:

Engine power.
Gear ratios.
Aerodynamics.
Suspension.

Every adjustment affects acceleration, top speed, stability, and tire wear. Find the perfect setup for every circuit.

Upgrade Your Cars
Earn credits by competing in the championship and Quick Races.

Each car can receive up to 50 performance upgrades, allowing you to maximize its potential and build a true championship contender.

Race Strategy
Winning isn't just about speed.

Manage tire wear, plan your pit stops, and adapt your strategy to changing race conditions.

Dynamic Weather
Weather conditions can change during the race.

A sunny day can quickly turn into heavy rain, forcing you to rethink your strategy on the fly.

Qualifying
Before each championship race, compete in a qualifying session to secure the best possible starting position.

If you skip qualifying, your grid position will be assigned randomly.

Practice Sessions
Practice on any circuit to test different setups and improve your lap times.

Compare your results after each session to find the perfect configuration.

Quick Races and Multiplayer
Every Fx Racer circuit is available for:

Quick Races.
Practice Sessions.
Online 1 vs 1 Duels.

Compete against players from around the world or challenge your friends to prove who is the best American Stock Car Series driver.

🕹️ Arrow Escape Champ – A Relaxing Yet Highly Addictive Brain Puzzle!

Welcome to Arrow Escape Puzzle game, a highly challenging yet relaxing brain teaser, which helps you both get entertained and train your mind in a fun-friendly environment! Your objective in this minimalist logic-based challenge is to help each arrow find a correct path to escape or tap the arrow without any collisions and before running out of all given lives (hearts). Plan your way strategically to clear the grid across all 100 unique and engaging stages.

In this addictive, free arrow escape puzzle or arrow exit game, finding the right order in each stage requires patience, logical thinking and creativity. This mind-boggling puzzle is perfect for everyone, including kids and grown-ups.

• 3 Lives to Use to clear each stage.
• Resume the puzzle from where you left off.
• 100 different and exciting levels to play through.
• Get ready to solve random stages after completing 100 stages
• Watch an ad to activate a hint during the gameplay.
• Click “Retry” or watch an advertisement to continue the level.
• Players can also add a Heart or Life after watching an ad.
• Choose your preferred language out of 9 different options.
• Change music, language and SFX anytime in setting.
• Play with or without background music.
• Deactivating SFX mutes the arrow movement.
• Use the zoom feature to tap the correct arrow in complex stages.

🎮 How to Play:-

➡️ Tap or Click: Choose an arrow, tap or click to release it in its pointed direction.
➡️ Solve the Correct Order: Keep an eye on the maze, and work your way to spot the right order of moves.
➡️ Clear the Grid: The successful removal of all arrows is the only way to enter the next stage.
➡️ Strategic Hints: Hints are also available to solve the complex stages.
Limited Hearts: Avoid making as minimum mistakes as possible since you have limited hearts to use to clear the puzzle.
➡️ Extra Lives Available: Don’t worry if you get out of hearts as you can add a heart by watching an ad.
➡️ Zoom the Screen: This feature will help you to zoom the screen and tap the right arrow to avoid the loss of a life unnecessarily.

Dive into an interesting arrow puzzle-packed environment in this one of the best arrow escape games – whether you are seeking a longer fun session or want a few minutes break for a quick distraction. data.name: Печать Демонов
data.description_full:

Печать Демонов — ролевая игра (MMORPG) в жанре восточного фэнтези, где вас ждут легендарные герои, могущественные богини и демоны, а также захватывающие сражения с игроками (PVP) и против игрового мира (PVE)!

Печать древней эпохи разрушена, и бесчисленные орды демонов вырвались на свободу. Шесть Миров оказались на грани гибели. Только Командующий способен собрать сильнейший отряд и остановить надвигающуюся катастрофу.

«Печать Демонов» — это коллекционная ролевая игра с элементами массовой многопользовательской онлайн-игры (MMORPG), системой призыва героев и режимом автоматического боя, а также фоновым накоплением ресурсов (Idle). Призывайте легендарных воителей, бессмертных героев, богинь, духов и демониц из древних легенд, развивайте их способности и создавайте непобедимые комбинации для сражений с игроками (PVP) и против игрового мира (PVE)!

Соберите собственную команду и отправляйтесь в путешествие по миру восточного фэнтези, наполненному тайнами, опасностями и великими испытаниями в новой коллекционной ролевой игре с элементами массовой многопользовательской онлайн-игры (MMORPG).

🌠 Десятки уникальных героев
Призывайте редких персонажей, собирайте коллекцию героев и открывайте новых богов, духов, демонов и бессмертных воителей. Каждый герой обладает собственными навыками, стихиями и ролью в отряде.

✨ Развитие без лишней рутины
Получайте ресурсы и награды даже тогда, когда не находитесь в игре. Режим фонового накопления ресурсов (Idle) позволяет усиливать героев и развивать отряд в удобном темпе.

🏹 Сражения против окружения (PvE)
Проходите сюжетную кампанию, участвуйте в испытаниях, исследуйте подземелья, побеждайте могущественных боссов и открывайте новые главы истории Шести Миров.

⚔️Сражения с игроками (PvP)
Проверяйте силу своей команды на аренах, поднимайтесь в рейтингах и сражайтесь с другими игроками за ценные награды и почётные места в таблицах лидеров.

⭐ Тактические автобитвы
Подбирайте героев по стихиям, классам и способностям. Используйте сильные стороны персонажей, создавайте эффективные сочетания навыков и находите слабости противников.

👤 Глубокая система развития
Улучшайте персонажей, создавайте снаряжение, открывайте новые способности и повышайте боевую мощь своей команды. Развитие героев открывает множество вариантов тактики и стратегии.

🏆 Гильдии и совместные приключения
Вступайте в гильдии, участвуйте в совместных событиях, помогайте союзникам и покоряйте сложные испытания вместе с другими игроками.

📜 Мир восточного фэнтези
Погрузитесь в атмосферу древних легенд, где бессмертные герои, боги и демоны ведут вечную борьбу за судьбу мира. Вас ждут яркие локации, красочные персонажи и захватывающая история.

Соберите сильнейший отряд, раскройте тайны Шести Миров, завоюйте доверие легендарных героинь и вступите в бесконечную битву богов и демонов.

Печать Демонов — коллекционная ролевая игра с элементами массовой многопользовательской онлайн-игры (MMORPG), где ты найдешь приключения с героями, гильдиями, сражениями против окружения (PvE) и сражениями с игроками (PvP), где каждая победа приближает вас к спасению мира.

data.name: Grid Fit
data.description_full:
Looking for a quiet way to sharpen your mind and unwind? Welcome to Grid Fit. This is a gentle spatial logic puzzle where every block reacts to your moves with its own expressive face. Your objective is simple: drag out rectangles based on the numbers on the grid and find the exact space each emotion needs to feel balanced.
✨ Why You Will Love Grid Fit
• Expressive, Reactive Blocks: The grid is alive with feelings! As you drag to form shapes, the faces inside react in real time. Watch them show worry when cramped, surprise when stretched too far, or calm satisfaction when given the correct space.

• Mind Bending Challenges: Start with simple shapes and advance to massive brain teasers. As you progress, you will encounter tricky obstacles like hidden numbers (?) and locked tiles (🔒) that require clever strategies to solve.

• Calming, Focused Gameplay: Designed with clean visuals and minimal interruptions. Sink into a steady, relaxing flow state as you work through each level at your own pace.

• Helpful Boosters: Stuck on a super hard level? Use the lightbulb hint to instantly reveal the perfect fit for a stubborn block and keep the fun going.

•A Low Pressure Environment: There are no stressful timers or harsh penalties. Take your time to analyze the grid, follow the clues, and let the board puzzle together naturally.

💡 How to Play
• Give Each Emotion its Space: The number on each face indicates exactly how many grid squares its rectangle must cover.
• Drag to Fit: Swipe to stretch the block into a square or rectangle.
• Establish Boundaries: Each shape must contain exactly one expressive face, and territories cannot overlap.
• Solve the Puzzle: When the entire grid is correctly filled with the right sized shapes, the board clears and rewards you with a screen of fully satisfied, happy faces!

🧠 Benefits of Playing
• Interactive Logic: The changing micro expressions of the blocks make solving numeric grids intuitive and visually engaging.
• Gentle Brain Training: Quietly exercises your spatial reasoning and logical deduction skills without overwhelming your mind.
• Satisfying Order: Experience the quiet satisfaction of turning a scattered grid of numbers into an organized, harmonious board of perfectly balanced expressions.

Grid Fit is a straightforward logic puzzle built for quiet moments. Easy to learn yet offering a steady mental workout, it is a soothing way to spend a few minutes a day bringing order to a world of colorful emotions.
Download today and find your flow!
data.description_short: Solve relaxing logic puzzles and balance block emotions in Grid Fit.

data.name: Age of Spirits
data.description_full:
Long before kingdoms rose and steel was forged, the world belonged to the dark. Beneath a cold canopy of bone and ash, primitive savages huddled around scattered hearth-fires, listening for the whispers of the Old Ones, the ancient wicked gods who hungered for living warmth and dragged the souls of the weak into the underworld. Most clans flickered out before the first dawn. A few endured. And then, the spirits sent a Chief.

You are that Chief, the one whose will guides the people from above the firelight. Though you do not lift the spear yourself, every shaman you awaken bears your command, every villager labors by your decree, and every hearth-fire that burns is kindled because you have decided it should. From the high seat of an isolated tribe at the edge of the dark, you must reclaim wandering savages, summon legendary heroes to lead your warbands, build the first true settlement the Wilds have ever known, and forge a people strong enough to outlive the night.

Age of Spirits is a strategy game of awakening, ritual, and primal resolve. Will you raise tall stones around your hearth-fire and grow your tribe into a city of rites and crafts, or will you march your warbands deep into ancestral grounds to seize what only the bravest can win? The ancestors are watching. The Old Ones are stirring. The spark of all that is to come rests in your hands. Do you have the will to lead the first tribe into a new age?

GAME FEATURES

Awaken Savages, Bestow Wisdom: Bring untamed savages from the deep Wilds to your hearth-fire and awaken them as villagers. Assign your people to every post that matters, gathering, hunting, crafting, and tending the rites. Watching each pair of hands turn raw labor into the resources that grow your tribe.

Lead Expeditions, Claim the Spoils: Command your heroes on expeditions deep into ancestral grounds. Face perilous trials in turn-based combat, defeat champions of the dark, and bring home precious bounties and the rare materials no settlement can rise without.

Summon Legendary Heroes: Summon spirit-touched champions, such as fierce hunters, far-sighted wizards, and bone-clad guardians, to serve as the heroes of your tribe. Promote and equip them with ancestral weapons and ritual gear, then send your strongest to lead every march and stand at the front of every fight.

Build Your Tribe from a Single Fire: Raise your settlement from a circle of stones into a thriving tribe. Kindle the central hearth, consecrate altars of wisdom and faith, sink quarries and woodyards, train new warriors, and upgrade every structure to unlock new units, rites, and strength.

Challenge Across the World Map: March your armies across a vast living world. Lay claim to resource grounds, raid rival tribes, contest sacred lands, defeat field bosses, and write your name on the map in flame and stone.

Join Forces with Alliances: Form alliances with players from across the world. Coordinate strategies, share resources, defend each other's lands, and wage large-scale battles together against rival forces.

SPECIAL NOTES
· This game includes random-item purchases.
· Network connection is required.
· Privacy Policy: https://www.leyinetwork.com/en/privacy/
· Terms of Use: https://www.leyinetwork.com/en/privacy/terms_of_use

Welcome to Beauty Match Magic, a delightful puzzle game that brings together the best of two worlds – addictive match-3 gameplay and relaxing jigsaw puzzles! Every challenge you complete reveals a stunning illustration of a fantasy beauty. Whether you're swapping tiles or dragging puzzle pieces into place, every move brings you closer to unlocking gorgeous artwork. No timers, no stress – just pure puzzle magic!

Gameplay Overview:

Beauty Match Magic offers two exciting ways to play:

Match-3 Mode: Swap and match colorful tiles to clear the board. Trigger combos, overcome obstacles, and progress through hundreds of levels. Each cleared level unlocks a piece of the puzzle – literally!

Jigsaw Mode: Once you've earned enough pieces through match-3 levels, dive into the jigsaw puzzle. Drag and snap each piece into its correct position to complete the full, breathtaking illustration of a fantasy beauty.

The more you play, the more beauty you unveil – from ethereal fairies and elegant princesses to mysterious sorceresses and charming divas.

Key Features:

Dual Game Modes – Enjoy both match-3 and jigsaw puzzle gameplay in one app! Switch between modes for endless variety.

Revealing Rewards – Every match-3 level you clear earns you puzzle pieces. Complete the jigsaw to unlock the full, stunning artwork – piece by piece, layer by layer.

Gorgeous Fantasy Art – Immerse yourself in a world of beautifully drawn characters, from ethereal fairies and elegant princesses to mysterious sorceresses and charming divas. Each beauty has her own unique charm and style.

Simple & Addictive Match-3 – Easy to pick up, hard to put down. Match tiles, trigger delightful combos, and clear levels with satisfying visual effects.

Relaxing Jigsaw Puzzles – Drag and drop pieces into place with intuitive controls. Choose from different difficulty levels to suit your mood.

Pure Relaxation – No time limits, no PvP battles, no leaderboard pressure. Play at your own pace and let the beauty of the artwork brighten your day.

Hundreds of Levels – A rich world of puzzles awaits, with diverse challenges to keep you entertained for hours.

Offline Friendly – Play anytime, anywhere – no internet connection required!

Hint System – Stuck on a tough match-3 level or jigsaw puzzle? Use hints to get a helpful nudge and keep progressing.

Why You'll Love It:

Beauty Match Magic is more than just a puzzle game – it's a magical visual journey with twice the fun! Every match you make and every piece you place brings you closer to uncovering a stunning piece of art. There is no stress, no competition, just the joy of solving puzzles and the excitement of seeing beautiful characters revealed right before your eyes. It's the perfect game to unwind with after a long day.

Download now and start your magical puzzle adventure – beautiful surprises await at every level!
data.description_short: Match tiles & piece puzzles to reveal stunning fantasy beauties!

data.name: Aviator Duel
data.description_full:
🎯 Aviator Duel is a fast-paced arcade plane battle where victory belongs not to the trigger-happy, but to the sharpshooter who aims ahead.

Your aircraft flies its orbit automatically — you only choose when to fire. Bullets travel through the air while your target moves, so you must shoot WHERE THE ENEMY IS HEADING, not where they are now. One clean hit wins the round.

⭐ GAME FEATURES

🎮 Local duel on one device — two friends, split screen (P1 taps left half, P2 taps right)
🤖 Challenge AI opponents across three difficulty levels (Easy / Normal / Hard)
🎯 Lead-the-shot mechanics: predict the trajectory, don't spray randomly
🏆 Choose match length before playing with a friend — Best of 3, 5, or 7 rounds
⚡ Every round is unique: speeds, orbit shapes, and starting positions change each time
🌅 Retro warplane aesthetic with dramatic sunset skies
⏱️ Lightning-fast sessions — 1 to 2 minutes per match
📴 Works completely offline, no internet required

🕹️ HOW TO PLAY

Your plane follows its orbit — no steering needed.
Tap your side of the screen to fire along the nose.
Aim where your opponent IS GOING, not where they currently are.
First hit takes the round. First to reach the target number of victories claims the match.

🔥 DIFFICULTY SETTINGS

Easy: Slow, wide orbits. Fast bullets with minimal leading. Forgiving challenge.
Normal: Balanced speed and timing. A fair, even-handed contest.
Hard: Fast, eccentric orbits. Slow bullets requiring big leads. Razor-sharp precision demanded.

Download now and prove your aim in the skies!

data.name: Blox Go!
data.description_full:
🧊 Cube Sort 3D – Match, Store, and Plan Your Way! 🧊

In this relaxing 3D puzzle, a colorful stack of cubes sits in the middle of your screen. Your goal? Pick out the right colored cubes and send them flying into matching storage boxes above. Each level shows you exactly which colors you need and how many – just tap a cube of that color, and it automatically zips into its box. Watch the numbers drop to zero, and you’re one step closer to winning!

🔍 See Every Angle
The cube pile is fully rotatable – spin it, zoom in, or zoom out to spot hidden colors. Long‑press to make cubes transparent, so you can peek inside the pile and find those tricky buried pieces. No rush – take your time to examine the structure from every side.

📦 The Storage Slot – Your Backup Plan
Below the target boxes, you’ll find a row of temporary storage slots. If you accidentally tap a cube whose color isn’t currently needed, it won’t disappear – it lands in a storage slot. Later, when that color becomes a target again, the stored cubes automatically jump into the right box and help you progress. But slots are limited, so don’t fill them with random colors!

🧠 Smart Strategy for Success
Always prioritize the current target color – this keeps your storage slots free for emergencies. Use rotation and zoom to spot the easiest cubes to reach first. For blocked areas, long‑press to see through and plan your next moves. The fewer cubes you store, the smoother your run. Plan your taps wisely, and every level becomes a satisfying, stress‑free victory.

data.name: Words of Wonders: Hexa
data.description_full:
Crossword meets Hexa!

Words of Wonders Hexa (WoW Hexa) is a brand-new word puzzle from the creators of Words of Wonders, where you solve crosswords by swiping through connected hexagon tiles. It's not just what you spell — it's how you get there.

Every level gives you a honeycomb of letters. Trace a path through adjacent hexagons to form words, and each correct word snaps into the crossword above. One board, two brains: your vocabulary finds the word, your eyes find the path.

Why WoW Hexa feels different
Classic word games give you a wheel of letters — WoW Hexa gives you a hexagon board where only touching tiles connect. The same letters can hide many paths, and only the right ones spell the words you need.

Endless variety of boards
From compact honeycombs to sprawling hexagon grids, every chapter reshapes the board and resets the challenge. No two levels play the same.

Bonus words and rewards
Sharp eyes earn extra: discover hidden bonus words for coins, and use hints when a tricky crossword has you stuck.

Relax while you play
Serene landscapes, gentle animations, and no time pressure make WoW Hexa the perfect game to calm your mind while keeping it sharp.

Game from Fugo: Creators of Words of Wonders Crossword - WoW

data.name: Paint or Seek and Hide: Online
data.description_full:
Paint or Seek is a hide-and-seek action game where you can paint your character, blend into the environment, and avoid being discovered by Seekers. Play online with other players or enjoy the game offline in single-player mode without Wi-Fi. Choose your role, explore various maps, and use camouflage to hide in plain sight. Play as a Hider and blend into the environment like a chameleon, or become a Seeker and find every hidden player before the timer runs out.

PAINT YOUR CHARACTER AND HIDE
As a Hider, find the perfect hiding place and press the red Paint button to enter Paint Mode. Use the painting tools to change your character’s colors and match nearby walls, objects, patterns, and decorations. The better your camouflage, the harder it will be for Seekers to notice you. Hiding is not only about standing behind objects. Paint your character, become part of the map, and hide directly in front of your opponents.

USE AUTO PAINT
Use the Auto Paint button to quickly camouflage your character. Auto Paint uses the environment behind you to help your character match nearby colors and patterns. Stand in the right position, activate Auto Paint, and prepare your camouflage before the search begins. Choose your hiding place carefully, because even perfect camouflage will not help if a Seeker notices you moving.

PLAY PROP HUNT MODE
Discover Prop Hunt gameplay and use objects, decorations, walls, and other parts of the environment to your advantage. Find a clever hiding place, match your surroundings, and use camouflage to fool the Seekers. Stay hidden until the timer ends and prove that you have chosen the perfect spot.

PLAY AS A SEEKER
As a Seeker, your goal is to search the entire map and find all hidden players. Look carefully at walls, corners, objects, decorations, and unusual shapes. Hiders may be painted to match the environment and could be hiding directly in front of you. You have five minutes to find every Hider before the timer reaches zero.

SURVIVE AS A HIDER
As a Hider, you must remain hidden until the end of the match. Find a smart location, paint your character, stay quiet, and avoid attracting attention. Seekers will inspect every part of the map, so both positioning and camouflage are important. Survive until the countdown ends to win the round.

ONLINE MULTIPLAYER
Join online hide-and-seek and Prop Hunt matches with other players. Compete as a Hider or Seeker, discover new hiding strategies, and test whether your camouflage can fool real opponents. Play online with friends or join multiplayer matches with players from around the world.

OFFLINE SINGLE-PLAYER
No internet connection? Paint or Seek can also be played offline. Enjoy single-player gameplay without Wi-Fi, practice painting and camouflage, explore colorful maps, and play hide-and-seek against computer-controlled characters. Offline mode is perfect while traveling, when mobile data is unavailable, or whenever you want to play alone.

data.description_full:

Welcome to the Fill-in Word crosswords puzzle, where you will improve your brain power and decision-making.

Fill-In word puzzles, sometimes known as Word-Fit, Kriss Kross or Criss-Cross puzzles combine a love of words with a love of logic.
The rules of kriss kross are simple, but solving them may not be! Given a list of words of different lengths, you must fit them all into the grid.
Match each of the words to the corresponding grid spaces, in order to form a valid crossword-style solution.However, some words can be placed in multiple positions in the grid when you first start, so you may need to cross-reference at times to complete the puzzle.

Each kriss kross has a starting letter, which is a clue to solving the puzzle, however, you will have to test your logic and thinking ahead abilities.

Fill-in Word is a perfect crosswords game for adults. Start from easy puzzles and progress to the hard ones.Test your word puzzle skills or pick a difficulty that is just for you.
Play mini crosswords to relax, and huge ones to keep your brain active.
Criss Cross categories will help you to enrich your vocabulary and get to know more words in a variety of topics.
Have you ever tried the number kriss kross? They are a little bit harder, as there is a higher chance of multiple numbers fitting in the same place in the grid.

This Kriss-Kross Puzzle Book is a fun and relaxing way for teens, adults or seniors to sharpen their minds and test their logic skills.
The game features:

● Discover new words daily, with our daily crossword challenge.
● Progress from easy to extreme puzzles with no given clues and master your solving skills.
● Use hints can help you out when stuck fitting all the words to continue a winning streak!
● Choose between dark and light mode for comfortable play anywhere anytime!
● Offline mode is available for free

If you enjoy brain twisters and logic games, you'll appreciate fill-in puzzles as a stimulating daily mental workout, with varying levels of complexity.

data.name: UV666Zenith
data.description_full: UV666Zenith is a portrait layered screw puzzle app that combines observation, memory, and sequential operation. Players must remove the topmost colored hexagonal screws from stacked wooden boards in the marked order. Each successful removal earns points. Tapping the wrong screw immediately ends the round, with a red flash and vibration alert. As levels advance, the grid grows larger, layers increase, and screw colors become more similar, steadily raising the difficulty. After fully clearing one layer, the next layer automatically appears; clearing all layers advances to a new level. If a key screw is blocked and cannot be removed, the round also ends. The app supports pause, restart, and high-score recording. The rules are simple and the pace tight, testing both observation and strategic planning, perfect for quick challenges during short breaks.

data.name: 히간: 이루실
data.description_full:
연극처럼 펼쳐지는 3D 실시간 전략 RPG —
지시와 전술로 악몽을 무너뜨려라!

이에 맞서 신도들은 세계의 질서를 지키기 위해 비밀 조직 ‘고페르 극단’을 결성한다.

그리고 지금—
‘별이 선택한 자’인 당신이
이 모든 운명의 중심에 선다.

▶ 매혹적인 미소녀들과 완성하는 나만의 극단
조합과 선택에 따라 전투와 전략이 완전히 달라진다.
각기 다른 개성과 능력을 지닌 캐릭터들을 모으고
당신만의 극단으로 최고의 무대를 완성하라!

▶ 부담 없이 즐기는 전투, 강렬한 쾌감
오프라인 성장으로 자원을 획득하고,
한 번의 터치로 강력한 필살기를 발동!
다양한 적과 보스에 도전하며 압도적인 전투 쾌감을 느껴라!

▶ 공연처럼 펼쳐지는 화려한 전투 장면
모든 전투가 하나의 공연처럼 펼쳐진다!
화려한 스킬과 강렬한 타격으로 전장의 피날레를 장식하라!

▶ 끝없이 확장되는 성장과 콘텐츠
다양한 콘텐츠와 성장 시스템이 끊임없이 이어진다!
플레이할수록 더 강해지고, 더 넓은 전장이 열린다.
풍성한 보상으로 빠른 성장을 체감하라!

▶ 마음을 움직이는 판타지 드라마
무대 밖에서 만나는 또 다른 그녀들의 모습.
함께하는 시간 속에서 쌓이는 감정과 이야기,
오직 당신만을 향한 특별한 순간을 경험하세요.

지금, 당신의 이야기로 무대를 완성하세요.

■ 스마트폰 앱 접근권한 안내
앱 이용 시 아래와 같은 서비스를 제공하기 위해 접근 권한을 요청하고 있습니다.
[필수적 접근권한]
-
[선택적 접근 권한]
저장공간: 사진 및 동영상 저장 및 업로드를 위해 필요합니다.
카메라 : 사진 및 동영상 촬영을 위해 필요합니다.
알림: 서비스와 관련된 알림을 받기 위해 필요합니다.
* 선택적 접근권한 허용에 동의하지 않아도 서비스 이용이 가능합니다.

▶ 안드로이드 6.0 이상: 설정 > 앱 > 권한 항목 선택 > 권한 목록 > 접근권한 동의 또는 철회 선택

data.name: Candy Sugar Match3
data.description_full:
Complete Game Guide

Welcome to the sweet world of "Candy Wonderland"! This is a classic, vibrant match-3 puzzle game. Swap adjacent candies to form lines of three or more, complete level goals, and unlock ever more magical candy realms.

1. Game Objective
In each level, you must reach a target score or collect a specific number of mission items (such as cherries, stars, or jelly squares) within a limited number of moves. Reach the goal to win; run out of moves and you fail.

2. Basic Controls

Swap: Tap and drag a candy to exchange it with a neighboring candy above, below, left, or right.

Match: If the swap creates a horizontal or vertical line of three or more identical candies, they will be cleared and score points.

Invalid Swap: If the swap does not result in a match, the candies will bounce back. No move is consumed.

Chain Reactions: After a match, candies above will fall down to fill gaps, potentially creating new matches automatically for extra combos.

3. Special Candies & Effects
Match 4 or more candies to create powerful special candies. Combining them triggers even bigger effects!

Striped Candy (Match 4): Clears an entire row or column. The direction depends on the match shape (horizontal match → vertical stripe; vertical match → horizontal stripe).

Wrapped Candy (Match 5 in L/T shape): Explodes and clears all candies within a 3×3 radius around it.

Rainbow Candy (Match 5 in a straight line): The ultimate candy! Swap it with any candy to clear all candies of that color on the board. Combine with special candies for massive chain effects.

4. Advanced Combos

Striped + Striped (cross): Clears both the entire row and column at the intersection.

Striped + Wrapped: Expands the wrapped candy's blast to 3 rows and 3 columns, plus adds stripe effects.

Wrapped + Wrapped: Triggers two large explosions, clearing a wide area.

Rainbow + Striped/Wrapped: Turns all candies of that color into that special type and triggers them instantly.

Rainbow + Rainbow: Clears EVERY candy on the board! Ultimate power move.

5. Board Elements & Obstacles

Jelly Squares: Candies under jelly cannot move. Clear candies next to them twice to break the jelly.

Chocolate: Spreads over the board each turn. Stop it by clearing candies adjacent to it.

Ice Blocks: Freeze candies in place. Melt by matching near them.

Chains: Lock candies or special items. Unlock by matching beside them a set number of times.

data.name: Bộ Lạc 3Q
data.description_full:
Bộ Lạc 3Q là một tựa game Tam Quốc chắc chắn sẽ làm dậy sóng cho cộng đồng game thủ tại Việt Nam, khi tái hiện thế giới quen thuộc theo phong cách nguyên thủy đầy mới lạ. Dàn thần tướng được tạo hình nhí nhố nhưng vẫn rất cá tính, khoác lên mình những bộ chầy khố độc đáo. Nếu bạn đang tìm kiếm một tựa game giải trí độc nhất vô nhị, đây chính là ứng cử viên sáng giá.
⁕⁕⁕ TÍNH NĂNG ĐẶC SẮC⁕⁕⁕
1. Tam Quốc Đồ Đá – Đập Nhau Thấy Đã
Bộ Lạc 3Q quy tụ dàn danh tướng quen thuộc, nay được tái sinh trong hình hài nguyên thủy đầy mới mẻ. Không chỉ combat căng đét bằng những vũ khí được tạo bằng đá còn có các gậy gộc và cung nỏ đều được sử dụng để chiến đấu, kết hợp cùng đồ họa đẹp mắt mang đến cho người chơi trải nghiệm thích thú về một thế giới Tam Quốc bí ẩn.

2. Tặng 1000 Lượt Chiêu Mộ - Phúc Lợi Khổng Lồ
Mỗi ngày đăng nhập là được tặng nhẹ 1000 lượt chiêu mộ, say mê quay tướng thoải mái, không cần nghĩ nhiều. Cơ hội sở hữu những cái tên xịn sò như Gia Cát Lượng, Trương Phi trở nên dễ dàng hơn bao giờ hết với tỷ lệ ra tướng cực kỳ hấp dẫn. Dù là người chơi muốn cày chay, vẫn có thể thu thập được đủ các danh tướng cực mạnh, từ đó xây dựng đội hình ngon lành.
3. Tạo Hình Ngáo Ngơ – Chơi Vui Bất Ngờ
Hệ thống nhân vật được chia thành bốn phe Ngụy, Thục, Ngô và Quần Hùng, mỗi tướng đều có tạo hình và biểu cảm rất riêng, vừa sinh động vừa có chút ngáo ngơ duyên dáng. Từ những khoảnh khắc vui nhộn trong trận đấu đến phong cách chiến đấu khác biệt. Hãy chiêu mộ ngay và bố trí đội hình chiến đấu độc đáo, sẵn sàng đóng khố cầm chầy quẩy tung chiến trường.
4. Kỹ Năng Tấu Hài – Anh Tài Combat
Kỹ năng chiến đấu của các anh tài có một không hai, mỗi lần tung chiêu là một lần khiến người chơi bật cười. Mỗi danh tướng đảm nhận một vai trò rõ ràng: người mở đường cầm cung, kẻ bày mưu cầm quạt... phối hợp nhịp nhàng trong đội hình 5vs5, kết hợp tung chiêu nhanh nhẹn từ các anh tài, để tạo ra vô số màn combat rất riêng và không đụng hàng.

5. Xây Dựng Bộ Tộc – Cầm Gậy Gộc Quất Thiên Hạ
Tự tay xây dựng bộ tộc của riêng mình, và bắt đầu hành trình đánh đâu thắng đó. Từ những trận PvP liên server như Tranh Bá Cửu Châu căng thẳng, đến hoạt động PvE hào hứng. Vừa phát triển bộ tộc ngày càng mạnh, vừa chiến đấu với gậy gộc thôi cũng đủ tạo nên những trận chiến đáng nhớ.

data.name: Kanji: Japanese Word Search
data.description_full:
Kanji Search turns time with kanji into a puzzle you'll actually want to play — think classic Word Search, but with kanji.

Love Japanese, or learning it? It's a relaxing way to meet real kanji every day — and a satisfying brain-teaser if you just love puzzles.

HOW IT PLAYS
Every board gives you a set of target kanji and a grid of components. Swipe to connect the right pieces and complete each kanji — easy to pick up, satisfying to master. As you find one, you see its meaning and watch it drawn stroke by stroke, so you absorb real Japanese while you play.

WRITE IT, DON'T JUST FIND IT
Learn to write kanji — not just recognize them. Tap any kanji you've found to open the practice pad and trace it stroke by stroke over a guide, in the correct order and direction. Draw a stroke right in one clean pass and it locks in; miss and it resets — so the shape really sticks. Going from finding a word to writing it is where kanji start to feel like yours.

A QUICK EXAMPLE
森 "forest" = 木 + 木 + 木 (three trees). 休 "rest" = 亻 (person) + 木 (tree). Every kanji breaks into pieces like these — find them on the grid.

FOR ENTHUSIASTS & LEARNERS
• Real kanji with their meanings
• Stroke-by-stroke order for every kanji
• Spans JLPT levels, school grades, radicals and frequency

FOUR DIFFICULTIES
From breezy Easy boards to brain-bending Insane, there's a challenge for every level — whether you're prepping for the JLPT or just unwinding.

FEATURES
• Hundreds of kanji to discover
• Drag-to-find, word-search-style gameplay
• Trace-to-write practice — draw each kanji stroke by stroke, in order
• Meaning and stroke-order clue cards — toggle anytime
• Achievements and cloud save to track your progress
• Fully offline — no account, no internet needed
• Free to play, with an optional ad-free upgrade

Whether you're studying for the JLPT, brushing up your kanji, or simply after a calm, clever puzzle, Kanji Search makes every match a tiny lesson.

Download and start finding — and writing — kanji today.

Questions, ideas or bugs? Email us at kanji.search.en@rottzgames.com

data.name: QireOx
data.description_full:
"## Gameplay

### Game goals
The goal of the game is to eliminate all viruses from the screen. When you successfully eliminate all viruses, you can proceed to the next level.

### How to operate
There is a virtual handle below the game interface through which you can control the falling pills:
- **Directional Keys (Left/Right)**: Move the falling pill.
- **Direction Key (Down)**: Increases the pill's falling speed (soft fall).
- **A Button**: Make the pill fall to the bottom instantly (hard fall).
- **B Key**: Rotate the pill clockwise.

### Elimination rules
- Align falling pills with viruses of the same color or other pills.
- When **four or more blocks of the same color (viruses or half pills)** are connected in a line horizontally or vertically, they are eliminated.
- The pill capsule consists of half capsules of two colors, you can take advantage of this to eliminate viruses of different colors at the same time.

### Game over
If the pills pile up to the top of the screen and new pills cannot be spawned, the game will be over.

## Features

- **Increasing difficulty**: The number of viruses in each level will increase, making it more and more challenging.
- **Personalization**: In the settings menu you can:
- Turn game sound effects on or off.
- Switch between different visual themes (blue, green, black).
- **High Score Record**: The game will record your highest score, keep challenging yourself!
- **Sound Effect Feedback**: Rotation, elimination, victory, and failure all have corresponding sound effects, bringing a more immersive gaming experience.

data.name: Color Sort Solitaire

Color Sort Solitaire is a clean and engaging card game experience that combines color logic, visual sorting, and card-based strategy into a relaxing yet thoughtful puzzle. Designed for players who enjoy mind games, word games, logic puzzles, and wisely designed solitaire games, this experience turns colors into the core rule that drives every move while encouraging strategic thinking.

Your task is to activate a color category and carefully guide each card to where it belongs. While the symbols on the cards may change, their visual identity remains the same. Mastery comes from observing the board, spotting connections, understanding how elements are associated, and thinking several moves ahead.

This is not a speed game. Every decision matters. Moves are limited, paths can block each other, and the board evolves as you play. The challenge grows from observation and foresight rather than memorization, offering a challenging yet rewarding experience inspired by the calm focus of a solstice moment.

- Correctly group all cards under their matching color categories
- Use your available moves efficiently and strategically

❌ When the game ends
- No valid color moves remain
- All moves are used before the board is cleared

Different board layouts require different strategies, encouraging players to think before every move.
As you progress, larger boards and more complicated arrangements create increasingly rewarding challenges.

Hundreds of handcrafted puzzle levels.
Simple one-tap controls that anyone can enjoy.

Smooth visual effects and colorful arrow designs.

Download Path of Arrows today and discover how many arrow puzzles you can solve!

data.name: Arrows Puzzle: Unlock within
data.description_full:
Welcome to Arrows Puzzle, a captivating game that marries simplicity with deep - seated logic. In this game, every decision you make, every arrow you manipulate, is a step towards unlocking the solution.
Arrows Puzzle is a unique blend of relaxation and mental stimulation. Here, your objective is to navigate a grid filled with arrows. Each arrow has a specific direction, and your task is to ensure that all arrows find their way to a clear path. It's not just about random taps; it's about strategic thinking and keen observation.
With its user - friendly interface, vibrant graphics, and a plethora of hand - crafted levels, Arrows Puzzle offers an immersive experience that will keep you hooked. Whether you're taking a short break or engaging in a long - term gaming session, this game promises to be your perfect companion.
How to Play
Arrow Manipulation: Tap on an arrow to set it in motion along its indicated direction. But beware, an arrow can only progress if there are no obstructions in its path.
Clearing the Grid: The key to success is to create a chain reaction. Removing one arrow can open up opportunities for others, like a domino effect. Clear the entire grid of arrows to complete the level.
Level Progression: As you conquer each level, you'll unlock more complex and innovative puzzles. The challenges escalate, testing your logical prowess at every step.
Power - ups and Boosters
Hint: Stuck on a particularly tricky level? The Hint feature is your savior. It will highlight an arrow that can be removed, guiding you towards the next correct move. Use it wisely, as it can be a game - changer in your quest to solve the puzzle.
Game Features
Diverse Puzzle Levels: Boasting hundreds of meticulously designed puzzle levels, Arrows Puzzle ensures that you'll never run out of challenges. Each level presents a new layout, a fresh set of arrow arrangements, and a unique solution waiting to be discovered.
Intuitive Controls: With simple one - tap controls, anyone can pick up and play. There's no steep learning curve, making it accessible to players of all ages and gaming backgrounds.
Progressive Difficulty: As you progress, the game ramps up the difficulty. The board layouts become more intricate, and the arrow combinations more complex. This gradual increase in challenge keeps your brain engaged and your problem - solving skills sharp.
Satisfying Animations: The smooth and satisfying arrow animations add a touch of visual delight to the gameplay. Watching the arrows move and clear the board in a well - orchestrated sequence is both rewarding and entertaining.
Logic - building Puzzles: Every puzzle in Arrows Puzzle is a workout for your brain. It enhances your logical thinking, strategic planning, and problem - solving abilities.
Aesthetically Pleasing Design: The game features a beautiful minimalist design with sleek visual effects. The clean and uncluttered graphics not only make the gameplay more enjoyable but also help you focus on the task at hand.
Offline Play: Don't worry about connectivity. Arrows Puzzle supports offline play, allowing you to enjoy the game anytime, anywhere, whether you're on a long commute or relaxing at home.
All - age - friendly: Suitable for players of all ages, from young minds looking to develop their logical skills to adults seeking a relaxing yet engaging pastime.
Why Play Arrows Puzzle?
Arrows Puzzle offers a harmonious combination of strategy, logic, and relaxation. It's not just a game; it's a mental workout wrapped in an entertaining package. Whether you're looking to unwind after a long day or challenge your brain with some deep - thought puzzles, Arrows Puzzle has got you covered. With its clever level design, seamless gameplay, and continuous progression, it provides endless hours of engaging entertainment.
Download Arrows Puzzle today and embark on a journey to master the art of arrow - based puzzles!

data.name: Гиперион X
data.description_full:
Исследуй измененный мир Гиперион и открой для себя великие перемены! Жизнь никогда не станет прежней. Небо закрыл туман, звери обрели крылья, а города отодвинулись друг от друга… Отголоски древней войны настигли нас. Девять Звезд явили знак: настало время Великого созидания и героических битв.

Живи в мутировавшем мире, сражайся с межзвездными рыцарями и верни планете былое величие. Настал твой час войти в Гиперион!

- Герои

Выбирайте класс персонажа, а вместе с ним - боевой стиль, навыки и внешность.
Мечник — лучший танк в Галактике! Выбирай, если ценишь крепких ребят.
Ронин — живой ураган на поле боя Гипериона! Выбирай, если тебе нужен головокружительный крит.
Маг — молния в центре бури Гипериона! Выбирай, если хочешь парализовать врага и усилить союзников.
Лучник — тихая (или не очень) смерть с первого выстрела! Выбирай, чтобы враг умирал раньше, чем поймет почему.

- Экипировка

Множество вариантов оружия - красиво и смертоносно! Тебя ждут артефакты и камни души, крылья, святые мощи, тайное оружие и многое другое! Всё для ослабления противника и усиления себя любимого!

- Кастомизация на любой вкус

Одежда, не только красивая, но и увеличивающая твои параметры. Аватары, чтобы тебя никогда не перепутали с кем-то другим, и рамки для них. Облачка текста, звания, и много чего ещё.

- Всё для быстрого развития

Игровые механики на любой вкус - сражения с боссами и другими игроками, подземелья, битвы на арене, крафт, задания гильдий и даже парусная романтика. Одних только боссов не перечесть. Вас ждут сражения между игроками, а также битвы гильдий и даже целых серверов! Для дропа - рулетки и захватывающие ивенты, для приключений - мрачные подземелья, для созидания - мощный крафт, для коллекционеров - уникальный архив. Точно не соскучитесь!

- Воплощения

Выбирай Воплощения на высоких уровнях, чтобы стать ещё сильнее и сочетать способности разных классов в одном персонаже! С механикой воплощений лучник сможет почувствовать себя воином или даже магом. Головокружительные сочетания откроют новые возможности!
Также будут доступны два поистине непобедимых сабкласса (а ещё эти сабклассы невероятно красивы!)

- Невероятные ивенты

Расписание на неделю будет плотным! Банкет гильдии и работа в Шахте, подъем по этажам Обелиска и безжалостная война Афритов, ежедневная Арена и гильдейская Одиссея… Всего не перечислишь, но все сражения - за добро против зла.

- Новые знакомства

Объединяйтесь в кланы, общайтесь в личных сообщениях или общих чатах, найдите новых друзей и побеждайте врагов еще успешнее! Общие завоевания сплотят вас в межсерверных битвах, хранилище снаряжения позволит обменяться вещами, а гильдейские усиления сделают вас непобедимым. И, конечно, множество разнообразных активностей гильдии не даст заскучать!

- Многоуровневая система достижений и рейтингов

Ты никогда не устанешь развиваться и стремиться к цели!

- Прекрасная графика

Невероятный мир заворожит и не отпустит, заставляя вновь и вновь возвращаться!

До встречи в Гиперионе!

data.name: 9a999
data.description_full:

The app opens with a bold dark interface accented in gold and deep green. A sticky header, slide-out menu, and decorative banner set the tone for portrait play.

Navigation includes Play, About, Rules, and Rewards sections. The core game renders on a canvas grid with on-screen arrow controls and swipe support. Gold bars award ten points. Rubies award twenty-five points. Each item extends the snake length.

Wall collisions and self-collisions end the run. A game over overlay shows your final score. Your best score is saved locally. Restart instantly to beat your record.

About explains the treasure-collection snake concept with a feature illustration. Rules cover scoring values, collision penalties, and growth mechanics.

Rewards includes a rank system: Golden Master for two hundred or more points, Ruby Collector for one hundred or more, Bar Hunter for fifty or more, and Novice Explorer below fifty.

9a999 combines reflex-driven arcade gameplay, rising challenge, and a bold gold-and-green visual style in one compact app.

data.name: Stock Clean Quest
data.description_full:
✨ Game Overview
This game centers on container sorting, adopting the addictive match-clearing mechanics of hit puzzle games with a compelling level progression rhythm. Free of complicated controls, it delivers relaxing, satisfying tidying fun. Set in a warehouse filled with multi-layer stacked clutter, its rules are straightforward: tap stacked goods, gather three identical items into one container slot to clear them automatically, and remove all clutter to pass each level. Featuring clean visuals and soothing sound effects, it’s perfect for short breaks, bedtime unwinding and fragmented leisure time—you’ll get hooked instantly!

🎮 Core Gameplay
The rules are ultra-easy for new players to grasp with zero entry barriers:
1. The main screen displays multi-layer storage containers loaded with various goods. Top items block those underneath; only uncovered surface items can be tapped and selected.
2. Tap a good, and it will move to an empty slot below. Once three identical items fill the same slot, they vanish instantly to free up storage space.
3. After top-layer items are cleared, the previously blocked underlying goods become accessible for further sorting.
4. You fail the level if all slots are full and no triplets can be matched. Clear every single clutter item across all containers to beat the stage.
5. Levels unlock sequentially. Later stages feature taller container stacks, more item types and messier layouts, testing your observation and planning skills.

🌿 Game Features
- Addictive Classic Mechanics with Smooth Controls: Built on popular match-clearing gameplay reimagined as warehouse sorting. Simple one-tap operations bring gratifying, stress-relieving elimination effects. Veterans pick it up right away, while new players learn effortlessly.
- Realistic Warehouse Art Style for OCD Relief: Clean minimalist warehouse scenes paired with lifelike container models, distinct item designs and soft eye-friendly colors. Immerse yourself in sorting to ease stress and anxiety.
- Gradually Scaling Difficulty: Early levels have few layers and simple items for laid-back fun. Later stages add mixed items and staggered stacks to blend casual relaxation with strategic thinking.
- Lightweight & Hassle-Free: No registration, no in-app purchases, minimal ads and tiny storage footprint. Play offline anytime to sort containers and tackle levels.
- Immersive Sorting Theme: Authentic warehouse organizing logic satisfies tidying enthusiasts, letting you enjoy the fulfilling rush of clearing messy containers for pure relaxing fun.

data.name: NN567Aether
data.description_full:
A spatial strategy puzzle where you place energy modules on a continuously rotating ring to achieve balance.

Each session presents a ring of twelve nodes turning at a steady speed. You have thirty seconds to select from red, blue, and green energy modules and place them on the ring so that neighboring nodes satisfy the active balance formula. A node lights up when it forms a valid color pair with at least one adjacent node, giving you immediate visual feedback on every placement.

The game starts with simple two-color formulas and a slow rotation, giving you time to learn the rules and plan your layout. As you progress through levels, the ring spins faster and the formulas become more demanding, eventually introducing three-color cycles that require every node to sit beside a different color. At higher levels, blocker shields appear on certain nodes, toggling on and off so you must time your placements to catch the window when a shield is down.

Win a session by balancing all twelve nodes or by reaching at least eight balanced nodes before the timer ends. Complete five sessions in a row with a full twelve-node balance to unlock Boost Mode, which increases the ring speed and raises the challenge further.

Every win counts toward unlocking additional node light effects, from a gentle stardust glow to flowing streams and prismatic pulses. Your records screen tracks your highest balance count, fastest full-balance time, win rate, and current level, so you can see your improvement over time.

The entire experience is designed for short, focused sessions of about a minute each. No account is required, no internet connection is needed, and all progress is stored locally on your device. Sound effects can be toggled in settings, and you can reset all records at any time.

Features:
- Rotating ring with twelve placeable nodes
- Three energy module colors with limited counts per session
- Progressive level system with increasing rotation speed
- Two-color and three-color balance formulas
- Blocker shields at advanced levels for added timing pressure
- Boost Mode unlocked after five consecutive full-balance clears
- Local records tracking highest balance, fastest time, and win rate
- Collectible node light effects unlocked through accumulated wins
- Built-in how-to-play guide, about, and privacy policy dialogs
- Fully offline play with no account or cloud sync
data.description_short: Balance energy modules on a rotating ring in fast spatial puzzle sessions.

data.name: Chameleon Game: Color Paint
data.description_full:
Chameleon Game: Color Paint is a relaxing color puzzle with one goal — paint to hide, and match the background so exactly that the Eye scans right past you.

Real chameleons are nature's painters, famous for changing color to hide in plain sight. That is your job here. Grab the color off the wall, paint the chameleon part by part, and fill the camouflage meter to green. Then vanish before the Eye looks.

🎨 GRAB THE EXACT COLOR
Tap a paint jar to pick a color, or hit GRAB to steal the exact shade straight off the wall — a perfect match, every time. Need something in between? Open the spectrum and tune hue, saturation and value until the color is right.

🦎 PAINT YOUR CHAMELEON
Swipe over your chameleon and paint each part to match the wall right behind it. Different parts, different colors. Keep tuning your chameleon color, then watch your chameleon hide into the background. This is coloring with a purpose: precision.

🔍 ZOOM IN TO CHECK
Not sure your green is THE green? Open the magnifier and compare your shade with the wall side by side. Tiny adjustments make the difference between close and perfect.

👁️ BEAT THE EYE
The Eye scans every hideout and rates your camouflage to the percent. Hit the target and you are HIDDEN; leave a bare spot and you are CAUGHT. Three difficulty tiers raise the bar from 80% to 90%, and the closer you paint, the more stars you keep. Some hideouts run against a countdown, so paint fast and paint right.

🎯 EVERY PART COUNTS
Your outline stays faintly visible the whole time, and a single unpainted patch gives you away. A perfect hiding place is always earned, never given.

🏆 TROPHIES & LEAGUES
Win trophies as your camouflage improves and climb the weekly leagues against other hiders. Only the top of each league promotes.

📅 A NEW HIDEOUT EVERY DAY
Today's hideout brings a fresh wall, a fresh palette, and a new color challenge. Clear it to keep your streak alive and bank the coins for a harder hide.

🖼️ HUNDREDS OF COLORFUL HIDEOUTS
Sunset Hills, Color Blocks, Study Desk, Pastel Pop, the Gallery — every themed pack brings a new background, a new palette, and a new way to hide. Every wall you clear becomes a painting you can hang in your gallery.

HOW TO PLAY
1. Tap the wall to study the color you need to match.
2. Grab a color, then paint the chameleon part by part.
3. Zoom in and compare the two shades.
4. Fill the meter, then vanish before the Eye finds you.

FEATURES
- Hundreds of handcrafted hideouts in colorful themed packs
- GRAB eyedropper — steal any color straight off the wall
- Full color picker: grid, spectrum and HSV sliders

data.name: Titanite: Mecha Survival Game

Titanite is a post-apocalyptic Mecha survival game that fuses free-form building with competitive PvP action. In a world where rust and steel collide, you'll command powerful Mechas, carve your own path between the deadly Warzone and the absolute safety of your Base World, and forge your own rules of survival through strategy and gunfire!

Rogue Mechas once ruled the wilds, but now we fight back. Override their systems, seize control, and upgrade them into powerful war machines. Industrial types turbocharge your gathering, mobility units let you blaze across the wasteland at breakneck speed, and combat Mechas bring devastating firepower to suppress enemies and demolish fortifications. Then teleport your spoils back to your Base World, a completely safe zone where you trade on the open market, upgrade your gear, and plan your next run. Risk it all for the big score or grind safe and steady? Your strategy, your survival.

Construct your base anywhere in your Base World, fortify it with walls and defensive turrets, and store your hard-earned loot. But survival isn't just about defense—team up with friends to design everything from a crude shelter to a sprawling steel fortress with automated defenses. Your base is your kingdom. Build it smart, or watch it burn.

Combat in the wild isn't just about firepower—it's about how you move, react, and strike. data.name: Orbit Grove
data.description_full:
Welcome to Orbit Grove, a fresh twist on color-matching puzzles that will challenge your spatial thinking and reward your strategic planning.

HOW TO PLAY
- Tap any tile on the board to activate an orbit: the entire row AND column connected to that tile will slide one position around the grid simultaneously.
- Each gem is a colorful diamond shape (gold, green, or pink) and each tile background glows with a portal color.
- Your goal: align every gem with the tile whose portal matches its color before your move counter reaches zero.
- Think carefully — a single tap moves multiple gems at once, so every action has cascading consequences across the board.

ORBITAL SLIDING MECHANIC
Unlike traditional match-three games, Orbit Grove introduces a unique orbital mechanic. When you tap, gems do not simply swap — they rotate around the grid in loops. This creates deeply satisfying chain reactions when you plan ahead, and surprising outcomes when you experiment.

PROGRESSIVE CHALLENGE
Start with simple 3x3 boards and a generous move allowance to learn the orbital mechanic. As you advance, boards grow larger, portal patterns become more complex, and the move limit tightens. Every level is a handcrafted puzzle with at least one elegant solution path waiting to be discovered.

STRATEGIC DEPTH
Success requires you to visualize how rows and columns intersect. A single well-planned tap can resolve three mismatched gems at once, while a hasty move may scatter your progress. Use the hint system wisely — it highlights a tile that moves you closer to the solution without giving away the full answer.

PRO TIPS
- Always scan the board for gems that are already one orbit away from their matching portal — solve those first.
- Work from the corners inward; corner gems are only affected by two orbit paths, making them easier to lock in place.
- Save your hint tokens for levels where the move limit is tight — they become invaluable in later stages.
- Watch the orbital trail preview before tapping to anticipate where every gem in that row and column will land.

WHY PLAYERS ENJOY IT
- Unique orbital mechanic that feels unlike any other puzzle game on the market.
- Hundreds of handcrafted levels with satisfying difficulty progression.
- Quick sessions that fit into any break — most levels take under two minutes.
- No pressure timers — take your time to think and strategize within the move limit.
- Vibrant cosmic art style with smooth animations and satisfying sound effects.

Ready to put your spatial logic to the ultimate test? Download Orbit Grove now and discover the joy of orbiting gems into perfect alignment!

data.name: Sultan's Game
data.description_full:
Play the first 30 turns for free. Unlock full version if you like the game. Sultan’s Game features complete content with UI and controls optimized for mobile devices.

2025's narrative strategy hit lands on mobile—uncut and optimized. A game of power, deceit, and deadly choices lies in your hands.

Inspired by One Thousand and One Nights, Sultan's Game is a narrative-driven survival card RPG set in an exotic court where deadly wagers, moral choices, and resource strategy collide in a tense, ever-shifting battle of wit and will.

The Sultan, capricious and cruel, has devised a deadly game. As his minister, every card you draw must be fulfilled within seven days. Fail... and you lose your head. Indulgence, luxury, conquest, murder... each card embodies a dangerous desire, a ticking death sentence that also grants the freedom to act without consequence. Will you commit forbidden acts in its name... or cling to your principles in the face of ruin? In a court warped by power and human weakness, you must shape your own destiny with wisdom and foresight as your tools.

There are no simple answers here, and every choice reshapes the story. Will you rise as the Sultan's favored confidant, or plot his assassination in the shadows? Will you remain loyal to love in desperate times, or surrender to forbidden desire? Will you stand tall as a fearless adventurer, or heed the whispers of dark gods? The game does not reward reckless indulgence—extreme cruelty breeds extreme hatred, and extreme consequences. Remember well, only those who hold fast to their own code can truly master their fate.

As a turn-based resource management game, you'll deploy cards to command allies and assets, complete objectives, and build your power, accumulating wealth, intelligence, and equipment as you go. Recruit allies, expand your influence, and seize control—every run is different, with card order reshaping each playthrough, while both success and failure unlock new allies, gear, and strategies.

Multiple endings await, each shaped by the choices you make. Will you seize absolute power, or rise to overthrow a tyrant? Will you retreat into a peaceful life with your beloved, or summon dark forces to bring the world to its knees? Even the same ending can be reached in countless ways, with hidden paths and secrets lying in wait for those bold enough to uncover them. Step forward... and let the game begin.

data.name: Shapezzle - Shape Logic Puzzle
data.description_full:
Shapezzle is a relaxing shape logic puzzle where you fill every grid with the right shapes.

Use the clues on the board to place squares and rectangles. Each clue tells you something important: the size of the shape, its type, or both. Your goal is simple — cover the whole grid with no gaps and no overlaps.

It feels easy at first, but every level becomes a satisfying logic challenge.

HOW TO PLAY

Fill the entire grid with shapes.
Each shape must include exactly one clue.
Numbers show how many cells the shape covers.
Icons show the shape type: square, tall rectangle, wide rectangle, or unknown.
Shapes cannot overlap.
No empty cells can remain.

WHY PLAY SHAPEZZLE?

Shapezzle is made for players who enjoy calm but clever brain games. There is no rush, no luck, and no random guessing — just clean spatial logic.

You will like Shapezzle if you enjoy:
• shape puzzles
• logic puzzles
• grid puzzles
• rectangle puzzles
• Shikaku-style puzzles
• brain teasers
• spatial reasoning games
• relaxing puzzle games

A NEW TWIST ON RECTANGLE LOGIC PUZZLES

Classic Shikaku puzzles are about dividing a grid into rectangles by using number clues. Shapezzle adds another layer: shape clues.

Some clues show a square.
Some clues show a tall rectangle.
Some clues show a wide rectangle.
Some clues hide the shape type, so you need to figure it out yourself.

This makes every puzzle feel clear, visual, and satisfying to solve.

PURE LOGIC, CLEAN DESIGN

Shapezzle is built around simple rules and smart levels. Look at the clues, find where each shape can fit, and complete the board step by step.

No gaps.
No overlaps.
No guessing.

Just shapes, grids, and logic.

Download Shapezzle and start solving shape logic puzzles today.
data.description_short: Fill grids with shapes using pure logic. No gaps, no overlaps.

data.name: Uv666Ghostly
data.description_full: Uv666Ghostly is a vertical casual baking reaction game, centred around the core gameplay of 'collect the bread before it burns'. At the bottom of the screen is a cosy bread-dispensing area, where golden croissants keep popping up and floating towards the top of the screen. Players need to tap the bread quickly to collect it. Each piece of bread has a countdown ring around it, changing colour from green to yellow to red, clearly showing the remaining baking time. Clicking after the bread is burnt or letting it burn counts as a mistake, and three mistakes end the game. As your score increases, the bread appears more frequently, baking windows shorten, and the popping speed rises, with up to three pieces of bread appearing simultaneously, making the pace more intense. The game supports pause, restart, high score recording and vibration feedback. The rules are simple and easy to pick up, yet the continuous acceleration tests your focus and reaction skills, making it perfect for challenging yourself in short bursts.

data.name: Lucky Arrow Blast
data.description_full:
🚀 Lucky Arrow Blast – The Arrow Escape Puzzle 🚀
Tap any arrow → it blasts straight along its direction (↑↓←→ or diagonal) until it leaves the screen. But if that moving arrow touches any other arrow – even slightly – you lose. Your goal: clear every arrow from the board without a single collision.
🎯 Why “Lucky”?
Because finding the perfect tapping order takes both skill and a little luck. Some arrows point to empty edges – safe. Others aim into crowded clusters – dangerous. You must plan your sequence carefully. One wrong tap and the whole board flashes red.
💥 Game Modes
Classic – 150 hand‑crafted levels, from 5 arrows to 25.
Blitz – 60‑second timer. How many can you clear?
Lucky Draw – one random arrow clears a small radius around it when tapped first.
Daily Puzzle – a fresh challenge every day.
🎨 Visuals & Sound
Neon arrows on dark backgrounds, smooth animations, crisp blast sounds, and a gentle chime for perfect clears. Collisions buzz – you’ll learn to avoid that sound.
🧠 Helpful Tools
Hint – shows the next safe tap (earn more via optional ads).
Undo – rewind one move without restarting.
Collision Preview – dangerous arrows glow faintly red.
Move Counter – track your taps and aim for 3‑star solutions.
📈 Progression
Levels are grouped into worlds. New twists appear: rotating arrows, moving obstacles, and arrows that change direction. Replay old levels to improve your score.
🌟 Why You’ll Love It
One‑thumb control, no timers in Classic, sharpens your spatial thinking, and feels incredibly satisfying when the last arrow escapes cleanly.
🔮 Tips
1️⃣ Always check edges – border‑pointing arrows are safest.
2️⃣ Diagonal arrows cross multiple lanes – save them for later.
3️⃣ Sometimes tapping a “blocked” arrow first opens a path.
4️⃣ Use Undo to experiment freely.
🎁 Bonuses
Every 10 levels, unlock a random gift – extra hints, new colour themes, or fun stickers.
📱 Download Now
Free to play, no intrusive ads during gameplay, offline supported. Coming soon: Level Editor, Global Leaderboard, and new arrow types (split, warp, shield).
Can you blast every arrow off the screen without a single crash?
Tap smart, trust your luck, and enjoy the ride. 🍀🏹💨

data.name: Bus Simulator Master
data.description_full:
Welcome to Bus Simulator Master the most immersive, realistic, and feature-packed bus driving simulator ever built for mobile! Whether you dream of cruising through a bustling city, conquering scenic countryside highways, or going head-to-head with players from around the world, Bus Simulator Master delivers a one-of-a-kind driving experience that puts you behind the wheel of powerful, real-world-inspired buses like never before.
From the moment you start your engine, you'll feel the weight of the road, the rumble of the machine, and the responsibility of the driver's seat. Bus Simulator Master isn't just a game it's a virtual world where your passion for buses, driving, and exploration comes to life. Bus Simulator Master has been engineered from the ground up to deliver console-quality gameplay on your mobile device. With ultra-realistic physics, jaw-dropping 3D environments, a rich progression system, and four distinct game modes, there's always something new to discover. No other bus game on the Play Store offers this level of depth, realism, and pure driving fun.
Whether you're a longtime fan of bus simulator games, a casual mobile gamer looking for thrilling driving action, or someone who has always wondered what it feels like to navigate a massive double-decker through traffic-heavy streets — Bus Simulator Master is your answer.
MISSIONS MODE - Think you have what it takes to be the best bus driver in the city? Missions Mode puts your skills to the ultimate test with a wide variety of structured, story-driven challenges that push you to your limit. Accept routes from your dispatch center, pick up passengers from designated stops, and deliver them safely to their destinations all while managing time, traffic, weather conditions, and passenger satisfaction. Each successfully completed mission earns you coins and exclusive rewards that unlock the most powerful buses and premium customization options in the game.
FREE ROAM MODE - Sometimes you just want to drive. No schedules, no pressure, no passengers demanding you hit every stop on time. That's exactly what Free Roam Mode is built for. Jump into any bus from your garage, choose your favorite map, and explore a massive open world at your own pace. Cruise along scenic coastal highways, tear through downtown intersections, climb winding mountain passes, or simply park at a viewpoint and soak in the stunning visuals. The world of Bus Simulator Master is yours to explore — every road, every lane, every shortcut.
TOUR MODE - Tour Mode is the crown jewel of Bus Simulator Master a beautifully crafted experience that transforms bus driving into a sightseeing adventure. Designed for players who want to experience the world of Bus Simulator Master at a slower, more immersive pace, Tour Mode takes you on breathtaking journeys through some of the most visually stunning locations in the game. Guide passengers through real-inspired scenic routes from coastal cliff-side roads overlooking the ocean to ancient city centers filled with historical landmarks. Act as both driver and tour guide as you navigate these spectacular environments while keeping your passengers comfortable and engaged.
MULTIPLAYER MODE - Bus Simulator Master takes mobile multiplayer to a whole new level.Multiplayer Mode connects you with real players from around the globe for competitive and cooperative driving experiences that you simply can't find anywhere else.Join multiplayer lobbies, compete in timed route challenges, race to complete missions faster than your rivals, or work together in co-op convoy events where teamwork is the key to victory.
GARAGE — BUILD YOUR ULTIMATE DREAM BUS
Your bus is more than a vehicle it's an extension of your personality, your style, and your identity as a driver. That's why Bus Simulator Master's Garage is the most comprehensive bus customization system ever built into a mobile game Spend hours perfecting every detail of your fleet.
