Khi đô thị quen thuộc bỗng biến thành bãi săn của Ác Linh... “Cộc cộc cộc”, tiếng gõ cửa bí ẩn vang lên...

“Suỵt, khẽ thôi, không được mở cửa.”

Tất cả Ác Linh trong truyền thuyết đang phá vỡ chiều không gian, sẵn sàng tông sập cửa phòng bạn bất cứ lúc nào. Việc bạn cần làm là khóa chặt cửa, cùng dàn Anh Hùng khai hỏa trận chiến bảo vệ [Cánh Cửa] cực kỳ phấn khích nhưng cũng đầy kịch tính!

Từ trường học, bệnh viện, khách sạn đến phố xá hay văn phòng – mỗi bối cảnh đời thường đều trở thành một màn chơi Thủ Thành đầy kích thích. Tận hưởng niềm vui kép về cả thị giác lẫn thao tác chỉ với 5 phút mỗi trận!

[5 ĐIỂM ĐẶC SẮC – ĐỊNH NGHĨA LẠI DÒNG GAME THỦ THÀNH HẮC ÁM]
※ Chọn phòng, khóa cửa, nằm yên và thăng cấp!
Ác Linh đến rồi phải làm sao? Không thể chạy thoát? Vậy thì nằm xuống thôi!
Chọn đúng [Căn Phòng] của bạn, khóa chặt [Cánh Cửa], chỉ cần nằm xuống là có thể thăng cấp ngay trong mơ, đồng thời triệu hồi Anh Hùng xây dựng tuyến phòng thủ! Liệu bạn có trụ vững trước tiếng gõ cửa giữa đêm khuya hay không, tất cả phụ thuộc vào cách dàn trận của bạn.

※ Đảo ngược chiến thuật, đấu trí tâm lý
Không cần “đánh cược mạng sống”, cũng không cần trốn chạy! Giường có thể nâng cấp, Cửa có thể nâng cấp và Anh Hùng cũng vậy. Căn phòng chính là pháo đài của bạn. Hãy kết hợp đội hình và chiến thuật chuẩn xác để đối phó với mọi thử thách. Mỗi lần bảo vệ cửa thành công sẽ đem lại cảm giác thỏa mãn tột độ.

※ Trải nghiệm thị giác độc đáo
Phong cách nghệ thuật Gothic Chibi mang đến bầu không khí hắc ám nhẹ nhàng đầy lôi cuốn. Trong ly của ma cà rồng là rượu vang hay là một loại "chất lỏng bí mật" nào khác? Tại sao gã sát thủ cầm cưa máy lại đeo mặt nạ thỏ đáng yêu? Với hàng trăm thiết kế Anh Hùng và Ác Linh riêng biệt, bạn sẽ thấy chúng vừa đáng sợ, lại vừa dễ thương.

※ Hóa thân đa dạng, thách thức mọi bản đồ
Hóa thành thành viên của [Hội Gan Dạ] để thám hiểm những địa danh kỳ bí, từ đoàn tàu đầy Ác Linh, ký túc xá vang vọng tiếng hát đêm, đến hang động ngầm bí ẩn. data.name: ShinEire
data.description_full:
Game Overview: Number Puzzle is a classic sliding block game where you arrange numbered blocks in the correct order by sliding them into empty spaces. The goal is to complete the following sequence in the fewest moves:

1-2-3
4-5-6
7-8-(Empty)

Gameplay: Basic Rules:
Objective: Arrange the numbered blocks from 1 to 8, with the empty space in the bottom right corner.

Movement: Tap the block adjacent to the empty space to slide.

Level Objective: Complete the level within the target number of moves.

Level Progression: Progressively challenge 15 levels of increasing difficulty.

Game Controls:
Tap: Move a block to an empty space.

Restart: Reset the current level to its initial state.

Next Level: Unlock and proceed to the next level after completing the current one.

Visual Feedback System:

Green Block: Movable (adjacent to an empty space)

Purple Block: Immovable (not adjacent to an empty space)

Highlighted Block: Temporarily highlighted when tapped.

Step Counter: Displays the current number of moves and the target number of moves.

Game Features
15 Challenging Levels
Beginner (5 moves) - Learn the basic gameplay
Easy (10 moves) - Simple layouts to boost confidence
Normal (15 moves) - Introduces more complex arrangements
Hard (20 moves) - Requires some strategic thinking
Expert (25 moves) - Advanced puzzle solving
Master (30 moves) - Master-level challenge

늘 도와주는 스터디원들과 방해하는 세력 사이에서, 나만의 방식으로 나의 운명을 선택해보세요! 엄청난 이야기가 여러분을 기다리고 있을지도 모릅니다.

[국내 최고 연봉자 타이틀을 향해 ‘취업경쟁 모드’]
방대한 스토리 대신 그저 모든 기업이 탐내는 인재가 되는 걸 추구하는 이들을 위한 모드!
매일 바뀌는 다양한 뉴스를 살피고, 상황에 따라 나만의 전략으로 최고 연봉을 획득해야 합니다
그 누구보다 빠르게, 남들과는 다르게 최고의 기업에 입사해보세요!

추가로 자랑하고 싶은 우리 게임의 특징들!
1. 낮은 확률을 뚫고 자격증에 합격했을 때, 너무 기뻐서 소리를 지를 수도 있습니다!!!!!!
2. 취업경쟁모드에서는 각 회사들의 가상 직원들이 남겨놓은 회사 리뷰를 읽는 맛이 쏠쏠합니다.
3. 스토리 모드의 각 단계별로 특이한 게임 시스템들이 하나씩 숨어있습니다. 그래서 질리지가 않아요!
4. 이제 입사 1년차가 넘은 바삭한소프트 스토리 기획자의 폼이 아주 좋습니다.
5. 강이현, 신서아 등 수험생 키우기에도 등장했던 캐릭터들을 중간중간 찾아보는 재미가 있습니다.
6. 300개가 넘는 다양한 회사들의 명함을 수집하고 친구들에게 자랑할 수 있습니다.
7. 지금 이 글을 쓰는 순간에도 개발진이 자정까지 야근을 하고 있습니다🥲 늘 그렇듯 게임에 정성을 담았습니다!
8. 바삭한소프트의 개발자 박현호군의 입대 전 마지막 작품입니다. 이 게임이 출시되고 일주일이 지나면 그는 논산훈련소로 떠납니다.
9. 리뷰를 통해 이 게임의 장점을 알려주신다면 이 뒤에 더 추가하겠습니다!

data.name: CelRes
data.description_full:
## Application Features

- **Modern Interface Design** - Dark theme, clean and beautiful interface

- **Multiple Calculator Types** - Supports multiple calculation modes including basic, scientific, and unit conversion

- **Complete Calculation History** - Automatically saves calculation records, supports historical viewing and reuse

- **Internationalization Support** - Fully English interface, easy to understand and use

- **High-Performance Computation** - Supports complex mathematical expressions and scientific function calculations

## Main Functions

### 1. Basic Calculator

- **Four Arithmetic Operations**: Addition (+), Subtraction (-), Multiplication (×), Division (÷)

- **Decimal Calculation**: Supports decimal point operations

- **Percentage Calculation**: One-click percentage conversion

- **Position Toggle**: ± buttons quickly change the sign of the value

- **Clear Function**: AC buttons clear all input

### 2. Scientific Calculator

#### Trigonometric Functions

- **Basic Trigonometric Functions**: sin, cos, tan

- **Inverse Trigonometric Functions**: asin, acos, atan

- **Angle Mode Switching**: RAD (radians) / DEG (degrees)

#### Logarithmic and Exponential Functions

- **Common Logarithm**: log (base 10)

- **Natural Logarithm**: ln (base e)

- **Exponential Function**: exp (e raised to the power of x)

- **Power of 10**: 10^x

#### Advanced Mathematical Functions

- **Power Operation**: x^y (arbitrary power)

- **Square Root**: √x

- **Factorion**: n! (supports integers from 0 to 20)

data.name: Order Chamber
data.description_full:
Welcome to Order Chamber.Step into a world of stacked 3D color cubes where every tap matters. The arena is quiet at first glance, but beneath the surface lies a layered structure of hidden relationships, blocked paths, and shifting possibilities. Your goal is simple in appearance: pick cubes by color, follow the correct order, and clear the entire structure. But nothing stays simple for long — every wrong move fills your limited buffer space, and every correct move reshapes what comes next. What begins as a calm sorting task quickly evolves into a deep spatial reasoning challenge where every decision carries weight, and every step forces you to think ahead.
What Makes Order Chamber Special:
A 3D Color Sorting Challenge Built on Structure and Depth Order Chamber is not a flat matching game — it is a fully three-dimensional logic puzzle where cubes are stacked in layered formations that must be understood from multiple perspectives at once. You are not only reacting to colors, but constantly interpreting depth, hidden accessibility, and structural dependency. Each cube you remove changes the shape of the puzzle itself, opening some paths while closing others, which means no two decisions are ever isolated. Every tap becomes part of a larger unfolding system where small choices can completely reshape the entire board.
The Buffer System That Changes Everything Instead of ending the game immediately when mistakes happen, Order Chamber introduces a buffer system that stores incorrect selections in a limited space. This transforms failure into pressure rather than punishment. As the buffer fills, tension increases, forcing you to constantly evaluate risk versus progression. Do you take a safe move now, or gamble on a deeper path that might collapse later? This system creates a persistent sense of strategic tension that runs through every level, turning even simple actions into meaningful decisions.
Simple Interaction, Deep Strategic Thinking The controls are deliberately minimal — just tap to select cubes — but beneath this simplicity lies a highly strategic puzzle framework. As the structures become more complex, you must begin planning multiple steps ahead, predicting how removing one cube will affect accessibility across the entire stack. What looks like an easy match often hides long-term consequences, and success depends on your ability to visualize future states rather than just react to the present moment.
A Satisfying Puzzle Flow That Rewards Mastery Each level is carefully designed as a structured spatial puzzle with no randomness, only intention. The satisfaction comes not from luck, but from understanding — slowly decoding the structure until the correct sequence reveals itself. When a difficult stack finally collapses under your logic, the result is a strong sense of clarity, control, and progression that makes every solved level feel earned rather than given.
Order Chamber is for you if:
• You enjoy deep logic and spatial reasoning puzzles
• You like sorting and matching mechanics with strategy
• You prefer calm but mentally engaging gameplay experiences
• You enjoy solving structured challenges step by step
• You like games that reward planning over reaction speed
Tap Smart. Think Ahead. Clear the Stack.

data.name: Potion Sort: Water Sort Game
data.description_full:
Pour, sort, and relax with Potion Sort, a colorful puzzle game that turns simple sorting into a soothing brain workout. Each level hands you a set of bottles filled with mismatched potions. Your job is to pour them carefully from bottle to bottle until every flask holds a single, perfectly matched color. It sounds simple, but as the colors multiply and the bottles fill up, every pour becomes a small puzzle of its own.

THOUSANDS OF LEVELS TO EXPLORE
Potion Sort comes packed with 1000 handcrafted levels, each one designed to test your planning and patience in a fresh way. Early levels ease you in with just a few colors, while later ones challenge you to think several moves ahead before you commit to a single pour.

A WORLD BUILT FROM 100 MAGICAL ZONES
Your journey is organized into 100 themed zones grouped across ten magical arcs, from the cozy classrooms of the Academy and the untamed Wild Lands, through the blazing Elemental Fire and the mysterious Deep Ocean, all the way to the icy Frozen Wastes, the sweeping Desert Expanse, the floating Sky Kingdom, the eerie Shadow Realm, the secretive Ancient Mysteries, and finally the legendary Master's Domain. Each zone has its own look and feel, giving your progress a real sense of place as you advance.

DAILY CHALLENGES AND REWARDS
Come back every day for a brand new daily challenge puzzle. Complete it to earn coins and bonus boosters, build up your streak on the calendar, and keep your collection of helpful tools stocked for the levels ahead.

HANDY BOOSTERS WHEN YOU NEED THEM
Stuck on a tricky pour? Reach for one of four boosters to keep things moving: Undo to take back your last move, Shuffle to rearrange a stubborn board, Flask to add an extra bottle for more breathing room, and Crystal to give yourself a helpful nudge in the right direction. Use them wisely, or earn more by playing daily challenges and leveling up.

SPECIAL MYSTERY LEVELS
Every so often you will come across a mystery level, where part of the puzzle stays hidden until you reveal it. These add a welcome twist of curiosity and surprise to your sorting routine.

DESIGNED FOR EVERYONE
Potion Sort includes a colorblind assist mode that adds clear pattern markers to every potion color, so the puzzles stay enjoyable and fair no matter how you see color. The game is built to be calm and unhurried. There are no timers pressuring your every move, so you can play at your own pace, whether you have a spare minute or a long relaxing session ahead of you.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Potion Sort is free to download and play. A small shop lets you pick up extra coins, lives, and boosters if you would like to speed up your progress, and you can remove ads entirely if you prefer an uninterrupted experience. None of this is required to enjoy the full game from start to finish.

WHY YOU WILL LOVE IT
Potion Sort blends the satisfying click of a perfect match with the gentle pull of just one more level. The pastel art style, soft sound design, and steady stream of new zones make it easy to lose track of time in the best possible way. Whether you are looking for a quick mental reset between tasks or a long evening of relaxing puzzle solving, Potion Sort is ready whenever you are.

Download Potion Sort now and start pouring your way through a thousand colorful puzzles, one perfectly sorted bottle at a time.

data.name: Arrow Cash Go
data.description_full:
Welcome to Arrow Cash GO!

Arrow Cash GO is a fast-paced, addictive puzzle game where your goal is to clear the board by tapping on directional markers to remove them. Every successful tap earns you in-game cash, which you can accumulate and eventually withdraw as real money!

How to Play

The game presents you with a board filled with multiple lines, each marked with a direction indicator pointing either horizontally or vertically. Your task is to tap on these indicators to make the lines slide out of the board in the direction they point.

However, it's not as simple as it sounds! Lines can block each other. If the path a line needs to take is blocked by another line, it gets "stuck." A line can be blocked up to three times—if it gets blocked three times, the level is failed. You'll need to think strategically about which markers to tap first to clear the board successfully.


Earn & Withdraw Real Cash

Every time you successfully tap and clear a marker, you earn in-game bills. The more levels you complete, the more bills you collect! These bills can be exchanged for real cash withdrawals.

How to Withdraw:

Accumulate enough in-game bills to meet the minimum withdrawal threshold.

Navigate to the wallet or cash-out section within the app.

Select your preferred withdrawal method and follow the instructions to transfer your earnings to your account.

It's that simple—play, earn, and cash out!

Key Features

Easy to learn, hard to master – Simple tap mechanics with increasingly challenging puzzles.

Earn real money – Every tap brings you closer to a real cash payout.

100% free to play – No upfront costs, just pure gaming fun.

Vibrant graphics & smooth animations – Enjoy an immersive experience with colorful visuals and satisfying sound effects.

Why You'll Love It

Arrow Cash GO combines the thrill of puzzle-solving with the excitement of earning real rewards. Whether you have a few minutes to spare or want to dive into a longer session.

data.name: Arrow Slide Match
data.description_full:
"Arrow Slide Match" is an addictive logic puzzle game. The game screen is a grid filled with colorful arrows, each pointing in a different direction. Your goal is to tap these arrows, causing them to slide in the direction they point, until all arrows are off the screen. Sounds simple? Don't underestimate it — the difficulty increases as you progress!
Game FeaturesBasic Controls: Tap to select an arrow, and the arrow will slide in the direction it points. If an arrow collides with another arrow in its path, it will lose one health point. You have three health points; once you run out, you must start over.Guidance: Each arrow in the game has an extension line indicating its slide direction.Four different game color schemes are available to suit different gaming preferences.
Slide Rules:Arrows can only move in the direction they point.Only one arrow can be moved at a time.Arrows cannot pass through other arrows.Winning Condition: Win the level when all arrows on the board are off the screen.
How to PlayStart from the Edges: Focus on arrows near the edges first — they have fewer obstacles and are easier to slide off the board.Clear the center last: Arrows in the middle are trapped by others. Free them only after the edges are clear.Watch for collisions: Each collision costs a health point. Plan your slides carefully to avoid hitting other arrows.Think in sequences: Sometimes sliding one arrow frees up another. Always look for chain opportunities.
Why you'll love it:You'll love it for its clean, minimalist visual design paired with vibrant arrow colors. Relaxing background music and satisfying sliding sound effects. Hundreds of progressively challenging levels. Suitable for all ages — the perfect choice for commuting, mental training, or relaxation.
Ready to match?
Whether you want to kill time on your commute, exercise your logic, or simply enjoy a light yet challenging puzzle game, Arrow Slide Match is for you. Research shows that playing these spatial reasoning puzzles helps improve planning skills and mental agility!
Challenge yourself — how fast can you clear them all?

Đồng Quy Giới ĐTCL là một không gian luôn biến đổi, nơi trí tưởng tượng thành hiện thực. Điều đó có nghĩa rằng mỗi bản cập nhật mới sẽ đi cùng chủ đề và cơ chế mới!
Từ học viện phép thuật, những thành phố bị quái vật khổng lồ tàn phá cho đến các lễ hội âm nhạc sôi động, luôn có một thế giới mới đầy hấp dẫn để bước vào chiến đấu.

ROLL CÙNG SỰ HỖN LOẠN
Xây dựng một đội hình trong mơ cùng với những vị tướng từ một bể tướng chung, nơi những lựa chọn táo bạo, xoay bài giây cuối, và sự tình cờ bất ngờ có thể thay đổi cục diện trận đấu. Chiến đấu qua từng vòng để trở thành Chiến Thuật Gia trụ lại cuối cùng, vận dụng sự sáng tạo và mưu lược để biến những đội hình khó lường và các tình huống thay đổi cục diện thành chiến thuật để chiến thắng.

ĐƯA BẠN BÈ TỚI
Thách đấu bạn bè và đối đầu trên cả PC, Mac, và thiết bị di động. Tham gia hàng chờ cùng nhau và xem chiến lược xuất sắc (hoặc chút may mắn) của ai sẽ giúp họ vươn lên vị trí dẫn đầu.

VƯƠN HẠNG TRÊN ĐẤU TRƯỜNG
Với hệ thống thi đấu cạnh tranh đầy đủ và ghép trận PvP, bạn sẽ luôn có đối thủ xứng tầm để kiểm chứng sức mạnh đội hình của mình. Đưa những chiến thuật xịn sò để leo từ Sắt lên tận Thách Đấu, và nhận những phần thưởng Xếp Hạng độc quyền cuối mỗi mùa giải!

PHONG CÁCH CỦA BẠN
Khoe Linh Thú yêu thích của bạn trên đấu trường, hạ gục kẻ địch một cách đầy ấn tượng với các chưởng lực cùng hiệu ứng kết liễu, và di chuyển thật phong cách giữa các thế giới qua những cổng dịch chuyển. Chơi game để mở khóa những vật phẩm mới từ Vé hoặc Vé+, hoặc mua chúng trong cửa hàng ĐTCL.

"하늘이 우리를 버렸다면, 이 심연으로 창공을 다시 벼려내겠다!"
조회수 폭발! 동명의 화제작 무빙툰 IP, 마침내 모바일 게임으로 완벽 환생!
찬란했던 천공의 성, 그러나 믿었던 동맹의 잔혹한 배신으로 왕국은 하루아침에 무너졌고 왕좌는 강탈당했다.
겨우 살아남은 왕국의 마지막 후예는 천공을 향한 복수를 다짐하며, 그동안 누구도 발을 引起지 못했던 금기된 영역, '심연의 바다'로 뛰어든다.
그곳에서 조우한 신비로운 심해의 주인 '인어족'과 압도적인 위엄을 지닌 '용족'.
오직 복수라는 하나의 목적을 위해, 서로 다른 종족들이 피로 맺은 '금기된 혈맹'.
애니메이션 속 주인공이 되어 심연의 군대를 이끌고, 저 높은 천공의 왕좌를 다시 피로 물들여라!

■ 화제의 애니 드라마, 게임으로 이어지는 대서사시 ■
완벽한 서사적 몰입감: 조회수를 휩쓴 동명 애니 드라마의 감동과 촘촘한 스토리 라인을 고화질 그래픽으로 재현했습니다.
초호화 성우진의 풀 보이스: 애니메이션 속 주인공들의 명대사와 감정선을 게임 내 퀘스트와 컷신을 통해 생생하게 느껴보세요.

■진정한 오픈월드의 시작■
육·해·공의 완벽한 확장: 익숙한 대지를 넘어 저 높은 하늘과 깊은 심해까지, 3대 영역으로 확장된 거대한 입체적 오픈월드를 자유롭게 탐험하세요.
차별화된 심해 전용 탈것: 흔한 날개와 육지 펫에서 탈피! 오직 심해 탐험만을 위해 특화 설계된 해양 전용 탈것과 함께 독보적인 모험의 재미를 선사합니다.

■혈맹의 이름으로 시작되는 보스전■
심연의 거대 보스 레이드: 혈맹원들과 함께 거대한 드래곤과 심해의 괴수에 맞서 치열한 전략 전투를 펼치세요.
상상 그 이상의 드랍률: 멈추지 않는 성장의 쾌감! 필드와 던전 어디서나 터지는 역대급 드랍률로 신화급 장비를 획득하고 한계 없는 고속 성장을 경험하세요.

■전장을 뒤흔들 백인의 혈투■
초대형 100vs100 실시간 전장: 평면적인 전투는 끝났다. 육·해·공 전역을 무대로 펼쳐지는 압도적 스케일의 대규모 집단 RvR!
완벽한 최적화와 타격감: 끊김 없는 완벽한 서버 최적화를 기반으로, 모바일의 한계를 초월한 하드코어한 액션과 짜릿한 승리의 영광을 느껴보세요.

■통제 없는 완벽한 자유 경제■
100% 비귀속 자유 거래소: 고정된 시세와 억압적인 시스템에 얽매이지 마세요. 던전에서 파밍한 모든 희귀 아이템은 귀속 없이 즉시 거래 가능합니다.

Every board is a newly formed structural puzzle:
Maze-like blocked paths
Collapsing tower-like layers
Compressed fragments of memory

Not because it is simple—but because you always feel:

data.name: Color Hexa Factory!
data.description_full:
Color Hexa Factory is a fresh take on color sorting puzzles where strategy matters more than speed. Instead of simply matching tiles, you manage a living factory floor: choosing which boxes to pull from a grid, timing them against a conveyor belt of colored cards, and clearing everything with limited sorting slots. That single tension between what's flowing and what's waiting turns every level into a test of planning, timing, and observation. Tap a box to collect it, watch the conveyor deliver its matching cards, and clear your slots before they fill up. Simple to pick up, surprisingly deep to master.
How to Play
Tap a colored box on the factory grid to send it to one of your limited sorting slots. A looping conveyor belt continuously carries colored cards past your slots; when a card's color matches an active box, it flies in automatically. Fill a box completely and it clears from the slot, making room for the next one. Clear every box from the grid to finish the level.
Features

Conveyor belt card delivery: a continuous loop of colored cards flows past your sorting slots; cards match automatically, your job is choosing the right boxes at the right time
Strategic grid with path-based access: boxes sit on a factory grid and you can only tap boxes with a clear path to the front edge; blocked boxes must be freed first by removing others around them
Obstacles that layer up: frozen boxes, chained pairs, tunnel spawners, hidden colors, and key-lock gates, each one introduced gradually with its own tutorial
Side rail feeds: additional cards enter the conveyor from branching side rails, injecting fresh colors into the loop at specific junction points
Limited sorting slots that create real strategic pressure on every move
Combo system: clear boxes in quick succession to build combos with escalating visual effects, satisfying feedback for efficient play
One-tap controls: no dragging, no swiping, just clean single-tap input for every action
Hundreds of hand-crafted levels with designer-tuned conveyor paths, grid layouts, and obstacle combinations
Offline play: every level works without an internet connection
Why Play Color Hexa Factory?
Most color sorting games give you a static board and ask you to match things one by one. Color Hexa Factory adds a factory that never stops, a conveyor delivering cards whether you're ready or not, and obstacles that force you to think several moves ahead.
The core challenge is slot management: deciding which box to pull and when, balancing the belt against the grid. Pick too many at once and you're stuck. Pick the wrong color and cards pile up with nowhere to go. Every tap matters.
Free to Play
Color Hexa Factory is free to play with optional in-app purchases. Download now and start sorting.

data.name: Find the Way!
data.description_full:
Overwhelmed by scattered daily distractions and looking for rush-free leisure time?

Arrow Clear is a minimalist arrow puzzle for all ages, playable with zero puzzle experience.
With clean visuals and progressive logic levels, this game steps away from intense timed races. Observe arrow layouts, determine tapping sequences and clear grids with soft taps to block outside distractions and enjoy peaceful focus.

🧩 Delightful Arrow Escape Gameplay
Colorful arrows interlace on grids and only move along their pointing directions, blocking each other's paths. You need to examine the whole layout and predict blocking relations to find proper tapping sequences. Difficulty rises smoothly: simple grids for quick relaxation, intertwined arrows to train spatial vision, geometric levels for multi-step planning. You will feel soothing satisfaction as messy grids gradually clear up and ease daily weariness.

🎨 Distraction-free Immersive Audio & Visuals
Soft matte backgrounds match vivid arrows, with no flashy effects or pop-ups. Gentle colors reduce eye strain during extended play sessions. Mellow soundtrack and subtle haptic feedback are available, and you can toggle audio and vibration freely to customize your gaming vibe.

🧘 Handy In-game Assistance Tools
No full restart needed when stuck. Practical aids support you gently without ruining puzzle fun:
• 💡 Hint: Highlight arrows ready to exit to simplify your next move
• 🧽 Eraser: Remove single blocking arrows to adjust solving plans
• 🪄 Magic Wand: Trigger chain clearing to eliminate multiple unobstructed arrows
• 📏 Full Grid Zoom: View the whole board to check all exit paths clearly

✨ Core Game Highlights
• Flexible leisure gameplay: No timers or penalties, pause and resume anytime
• Carefully crafted levels: Varied grids and geometric shapes for diverse puzzle fun
• Offline support: Play without Wi-Fi during spare moments
• Low-interruption interface: Few pop-ups for continuous immersive play
• Gentle brain training: Improve spatial awareness and sequential planning casually
• Short-session friendly: Compact levels fit all small daily gaps

🌌 Balanced Experience of Relaxation & Thinking
Many casual games are either repetitive or overly challenging. This game strikes a balanced approach between relaxation and light thinking. Sorting arrow paths calms messy thoughts. It is perfect for killing spare time, easing stress or light daily brain exercise. Plan each tap carefully and enjoy stress-free puzzle fun.

Download Arrow Clear and start your gentle relaxing puzzle journey.

Step into the wood manufacturing industry and draw up development blueprints for your entire industrial park. Transform a tiny workshop into a large-scale industrial kingdom through facility upgrades and regional expansions, and unwind with casual idle management gameplay.

Trucks and forklifts are responsible for raw material storage, inter-workshop transportation and finished goods delivery. Regularly upgrade and inspect your transport vehicles to smooth material circulation across all zones, ensuring your factory maintains stable full-capacity operation around the clock.

Refined Order & Market Management！
Expand your customer base via diversified marketing campaigns to attract buyers from all regions. Arrange order schedules reasonably to balance production and delivery, steadily boost overall revenue and achieve long-term growth for your timber trading business.

Permanent Industrial Boost System！
You will gain exclusive industry points upon every completed order. Allocate these points wisely to unlock global buffs that permanently lift your factory’s productivity and profit ceiling. Expand your professional workforce and optimize every production link to keep enlarging your timber business territory.

Grow from a humble small sawmill into a sprawling industrial complex with complete forest, manufacturing, logistics and trading systems. Create your unique timber business empire and enjoy the laid-back fun of construction and idle management.

data.name: 777 Qcan Lrure
data.description_full:
"## Basic gameplay
- The blocks will fall one after another from the top of the screen, and players need to arrange them at the bottom through operations.
- When a row is completely filled with blocks, the row is eliminated and points are awarded.
- The game ends when the blocks can no longer fall and stack to the top.

## Features
- **Pixel retro style UI**: All interfaces, buttons, dividing lines, and pop-up windows are in pixel style, giving it a nostalgic feel.
- **Multiple skins and backgrounds**: Supports multiple sets of block skins and multiple gradient backgrounds, switch at will.
- **Hell Mode**: Reverse operation and inverted display, extreme challenge.
- **Elimination Animation**: There is a cool pixel animation for each elimination.
- **Leaderboard**: Supports normal/hell dual mode leaderboard, automatically records high scores.

## Operation instructions
- **Move left/right**: Click the ""<"" or "">"" button.
- **Rotate**: Click the ""R"" button to rotate the current block.
- **Accelerated Fall**: Click the ""V"" button to make the block fall quickly.
- **Pause/Resume**: Click the ""||"" button to pause or resume the game.
- **Restart/Return to Homepage**: After the game is over, you can choose to restart or return to the homepage.

## Settings and customization
- **Skin Switch**: Select different block skins on the settings page to experience the colorful pixel style.
- **Background switching**: A variety of gradient backgrounds are available, and the preview area displays the effect in real time.
- **Next Block Preview**: The next block preview function can be turned on or off.
- **Settings auto-save**: All settings are automatically saved and automatically applied next time you enter.

## Ranking description
- After the game is over, the scores are automatically recorded to the corresponding mode leaderboard.
- The rankings are divided into two categories: "Normal Mode" and "Hell Mode".
-Only record scores with scores greater than 0, and automatically generate English nicknames (such as Tetris_AB12).
- Ranking data is saved locally and persistently. "

data.name: Break Bang：Smash Carnival
data.description_full:
Welcome to Physics Cannon. The arena is set, the targets are waiting, and it's all up to you. Pick your angle, dial in your power, and fire. What happens next is pure physics: real-time collisions, crumbling structures, flying debris, and the most satisfying chain reactions you've ever triggered.
What Makes Physics Cannon Special:
- A Destruction Engine Built on Real Physics This isn't a game where things just disappear when you hit them. Every object — every jar, every stone, every block — responds to force and collision in real time. Glass shatters into fragments. Stone cracks and crumbles. Heavy objects tumble and knock into others, setting off cascades that feel alive and unpredictable. Every shot is a physics experiment, and every hit is a reward.
- Master Your Shot There are no fixed solutions here. Every level is a spatial puzzle that asks you to read the environment and figure out the one shot — or the perfect sequence of shots — that brings it all down. Adjust your angle with precision, set your power with care, and time your release. The difference between a near miss and a perfect hit is a degree of angle or a fraction of power. And when you nail it, the results are spectacular.
- A Carnival of Destruction Each level is a lovingly crafted diorama built to be destroyed: stacked crates, precarious towers, jars lined up like dominoes, stone fortresses waiting for the perfect breach. The festival setting brings color and personality to every scene, with lively decorations, cheerful banners, and a vibrant atmosphere that makes the chaos feel like celebration.
- Easy to Pick Up, Deep to Master The controls are simple and intuitive: aim, power, fire. Anyone can pick it up and start having fun in seconds. But mastering the game takes real skill. Understanding how different materials break, how objects interact, and how to set up the perfect chain reaction is a satisfying journey that rewards patience, observation, and practice.
Physics Cannon is for you if:
• You love the satisfaction of watching something break in the most satisfying way possible.
• You enjoy games that reward precision and skill, not just speed.

data.name: 3D Bubble Pop：Relaxing ASMR
data.description_full:
🦦 Game Overview
*3D Bubble Pop: Relaxing ASMR* is a stress-relieving gift brought to you by a perpetually chill capybara.
In this fresh take on the classic bubble shooter, there is only one thing to do: aim, shoot, and pop. The slightly tilted 3D perspective makes the trajectory of every bubble clearly visible. As colorful bubbles collide and burst in mid-air, you’re treated to more than just a rising score; finely tuned ASMR sound effects provide a dual relaxation experience for both your fingertips and your ears.
No complex storylines or maps to unlock here—just a capybara hanging out with you, a pristine 3D bubble world, and a journey of popping bubbles that lets your mind completely unwind.

---
🎮 Gameplay
Core Rules: Match colors to pop groups of three.
The rules are simple, though the shooting angle requires a bit of thought.
- Shoot Bubbles: A colored bubble is loaded into the launcher at the bottom of the screen. Aim at the cluster of bubbles above and fire.
- Clear Bubbles: When your shot connects with a group of three or more bubbles of the same color, that group pops and falls away.
- Clear the Level: Eliminate all the suspended bubbles to advance to the next level.
Strategy & Tips
- Use Ricochets: Bubbles bounce off the side walls. If a direct path is blocked, use the walls to bank your shot—this requires a little quick mental geometry.
- Watch for Gravity: When a group pops, unsupported bubbles will fall due to gravity; these falling bubbles count toward your score too. Targeting key support points first can trigger a satisfying chain reaction of falling bubbles. ---
🎨 Clean 3D Visuals
- Slightly Tilted Perspective: The game employs a slightly tilted 3D view, allowing you to clearly see the depth and layering of the stacked bubbles without making aiming difficult due to an extreme angle. This design preserves the classic bubble-shooter field of view while adding a sense of realistic spatial depth.
- Minimalist Background: There are no complex theme changes; the game features a single, soft, gradient background with a frosted-glass texture. All visual elements serve the gameplay—free of superfluous decorations—letting you focus entirely on the joy of shooting.
- Bubble Texture: Each bubble boasts a translucent, glossy sheen with light playing across its surface, accompanied by subtle expansion and contraction animations upon impact.
🧘 Stress-Free, Pure Gameplay
- No Time Limits: No countdown timers rush you through levels; take your time adjusting your aim to find the perfect shot trajectory.
- No Forced Tasks: There are no daily missions to complete, nor stars or keys to collect. Simply open the game, start popping, and pick it up or put it down whenever you like.

---
✅ Summary
"Aim, shoot, and listen to the bubbles pop. Let the Capybara keep you company during a gentle, leisurely break."
*3D Bubble Pop: Relaxing ASMR* is a bubble-shooting game that returns to the classics with a focus on stress relief. It strips away complex progression and collection systems, leaving only the core fun of aiming, bouncing, and popping. Exquisite ASMR-quality sound effects, a calm Capybara companion, and clean 3D visuals combine to create a tranquil space where you can relax your mind anytime, anywhere.
Whether you are a veteran bubble-shooter player or simply looking for a way to unwind and find some peace, you’ll find your own rhythm here.
Open the game, adjust your angle, and join the Capybara in watching the bubbles bloom in the air.

We hope you enjoy the game! If you have any thoughts or suggestions, please feel free to contact us.
data.description_short: Experience the thrill and precision of 3D bubble popping!

data.name: Война за трон
data.description_full:
«Война за трон» — это инновационная средневековая idle-игра на выживание, сочетающая стратегический игровой процесс с обилием подробностей, которые только и ждут, чтобы вы их исследовали.

Когда внезапный мятеж резко меняет судьбу целой династии и разжигает уровопролитную войну, бесчисленное количество человек теряют дома. В этом мире, разрываемом на части дезорганизацией общества, вторжениями мятежников, свирепствующими болезнями, а также монстрами, отчаянно жаждущими ресурсов, сложнейшая задача — это выживание. Как раз в эти смутные времена вы и становитесь губернатором, и именно от вас зависит, сможете ли вы провести своих людей через все опасности, продумывая внутренние и дипломатические стратегии, которые помогут вам вновь раздуть искру цивилизации.

[Ключевые функции]

Защищайтесь от вторжений
Оставайтесь начеку и будьте готовы в любой момент отразить вторжение. От этого зависит ваш город, последний бастион надежды человечества. Собирайте ресурсы, улучшайте оборону и готовьтесь к бою, чтобы обеспечить выживание ваших подданных в эти сложные времена.

Управляйте кадрами
Наслаждайтесь уникальной игровой механикой, которая позволяет вам назначать выживших на такие позиции, как рабочий, охотник или повар. Следите за здоровьем и счастьем выживших, чтобы они работали продуктивно. Быстро реагируйте на заболевания, чтобы все вовремя получали доступ к лечению.

Устанавливайте законы
Кодексы законов чрезвычайно важны для любой цивилизации и станут ключом к росту и силе вашего города.

[Стратегический игровой процесс]

Борьба за ресурсы
Ввиду внезапного падения государства весь континент усыпан нетронутыми ресурсами. Беженцы, мятежники и жадные до власти губернаторы все как один хотят заполучить эти драгоценные материалы. Приготовьтесь к бою и используйте каждую каплю стратегии в вашем распоряжении, чтобы забрать эти ресурсы себе!

Сражайтесь за силу
Соревнуйтесь с другими игроками за высшую честь: звание сильнейшего губернатора в этой грандиозной игре-стратегии. Взойдите на трон и правьте королевством!

Создавайте альянсы
Сделайте задачу выжить в этом хаотичном мире проще, создав альянс или вступив в существующий. Работайте сообща с союзниками, чтобы восстановить цивилизацию!

Нанимайте героев
В игре присутствует множество уникальных героев, которых вы сможете нанять. Составьте свою команду героев с разными навыками и талантами, чтобы перехватить инициативу и обеспечить своему городу толику безопасности в эти отчаянные времена.

Соревнуйтесь с другими губернаторами
Оттачивайте навыки своих героев, собирайте отряды и сражайтесь с другими губернаторами. Победа не только принесёт вам ценные очки, но и даст доступ к редким предметам. Возглавьте рейтинги и продемонстрируйте взлёт великой цивилизации.

Продвигайте технологии
Мятеж уничтожил практически все прежние технологические достижения, так что одно из ваших самых важных дел — это восстановить и возродить фрагменты утерянных технологий. Гонка освоения новейших технологий может определить, кто будет доминировать в этом новом мировом порядке!

data.description_full: Rak Movk is a classic 7x7 gem match-3 puzzle game. The gameplay is simple and easy to learn: tap to select a gem, then tap an adjacent gem to swap them. When three or more gems of the same color align in a row or column, they are cleared and award points. After matches are cleared, the gravity system causes gems above to fall and fill the gaps, while new gems generate from the top. The game detects deadlock situations and automatically reshuffles when no valid moves remain, ensuring players can continue playing. Beautiful gem visuals and smooth clearing animations make the game highly satisfying. Whether you're a casual player or a puzzle enthusiast, Dovarian offers engaging entertainment for everyone.

data.name: Cor Pulk
data.description_full: Cor Pulk is a challenging match-3 puzzle game set in a frosty arctic world. The game features a 6x6 grid filled with adorable animal icons. Players swap adjacent animals by sliding the screen, and when three or more identical animals line up, they disappear and award points. After matches are cleared, new animals fall from above to fill the gaps, with the gravity system ensuring the board stays complete. The scoring system rewards players based on the number of animals cleared, testing strategic planning skills. When no valid moves remain, the game automatically reshuffles the board to keep the experience fresh. Beautiful arctic-themed graphics and smooth animations make this game both relaxing and engaging.

📦 Clear Every Bus
Your goal is to drive every bus out of the lot, each one loaded with its matching passenger(s). Just a smooth, collision‑free operation.

Can you untangle the bus jam and get everyone to their ride? Tap, match, and roll out — but don’t let them crash! 🚦🚍🔴🔵🟡🟢

data.name: Tile Classic Ha
data.description_full:
Welcome to Tile Classic Ha, a relaxing tile puzzle game where every level takes you through colorful places, charming scenes, and carefully designed tile layouts.

Tap matching tiles, place them into the queue, and match 3 identical tiles to clear them from the board. The rules are simple, but every move matters. Your queue has limited space, so you need to think carefully before choosing each tile. If the queue becomes full, the level is lost.

Explore peaceful villages, flower fields, sunny beaches, mountain valleys, starry nights, and many other charming areas. As you complete levels, you will unlock new regions with fresh tile sets, new layouts, and more interesting puzzles.

Tile Classic Ha is easy to learn, but it becomes more challenging as you progress. Some tiles are hidden under others, so you need to clear the top layers first and plan your moves ahead. Each level has a different layout that tests your observation, memory, and strategy.

Enjoy a wide variety of cute tile icons, including food, animals, flowers, souvenirs, traditional objects, and colorful items from different themes. The clean cartoon style, bright visuals, and calm atmosphere make the game suitable for casual players who enjoy puzzle games at their own pace.

When you are stuck, helpful boosters can give you another chance. Use undo, shuffle, and special tools to fix mistakes, open new matching opportunities, and complete difficult levels more easily.

Game features:
* Simple and satisfying tile puzzle gameplay
* Match 3 identical tiles to clear them from the board
* Limited queue space for more strategic choices
* Many levels with different shapes and tile layouts
* New areas unlocked as you progress
* Cute cartoon tiles and relaxing backgrounds
* Helpful boosters for tricky situations
* Easy to learn, fun to master
* Great for short breaks or daily puzzle sessions

If you enjoy tile puzzle games, match 3 challenges, relaxing brain games, and colorful casual puzzles, Tile Classic Ha is ready for you.

data.name: Colordoku: Logic Puzzle
data.description_full:
Welcome to Colordoku: Logic Puzzle, a fresh experience for queen games. This mobile game mixes the gameplay of Sudoku, the solving of minesweeper, and the classic style of the queens puzzle game.
If you love the daily killer sudoku or minesweeper, Colordoku is the suitable game for you. There are no numbers and no math, making it a fresh choice among traditional math games.

How to play 🎮
The board in these queen games has colored areas. Your goal is to place exactly one crown in each colored area, a core rule for n queens games. However, these crowns need space. No two crowns can be in the same row or column. Also, crowns cannot touch each other.
To solve these queens logic puzzles, you can use notes to cross out wrong tiles. When you are sure, double tap to place a crown. In these color games, every move matters, and every grid has only one correct answer.

Main Features 🌟
- Logic Mix: Enjoy a great mix of killer sudoku thinking, minesweeper logic, and queen games rules.
- Lots of Levels: Enjoy easy warm ups and hard queens puzzle game challenges with the balance of n queens gameplay, and master the 8 queens setup.
- Mind Training: Keep your brain active and enjoy a smart queendoku brain puzzle every day. It is a fresh choice alongside classic math games and queens logic puzzles.
- Clean Design: Enjoy a modern look with bright color games and a clean killer sudoku style. It is a beautiful queens puzzle game that is easy on the eyes.

It is a true queendoku brain puzzle, that is easy to learn but offers an exciting 8 queens challenge. Solve the modern version of 8 queens and see how fun color games can be.
If you want to master n queens logic, improve your skills in math games, or just want to try the engaging queendoku brain puzzle available, download Colordoku: Logic Puzzle now and start your queens logic puzzles journey today!

data.name: Findoku: Logic Puzzle
data.description_full:
Findoku – Sudoku × Minesweeper × Cute Puppies

This game perfectly combines the logical deduction of classic Sudoku with the inferential thrill of Minesweeper. Say goodbye to boring numbers – instead, you’ll find lively, adorable dogs. Your only mission: find that unique little territory for every dog on the grid.

🎮 How to Play

Easy to learn: Dogs need their absolute personal space. They can never appear in the same row, same column, or touch each other – not even diagonally.

Minesweeper-style deduction: The game incorporates Minesweeper-like reasoning. It tests not only your placement skills but also your ability to deduce using the clues provided.

💡 Features & Mechanics

Risk & reward: Double‑tap a cell to place a dog. Guess right and enjoy a satisfying sense of accomplishment – but you only have 3 mistakes in total. Use them all and you’ll have to start over.

No blind guessing: Random guesses will quickly lead to failure. Only logical reasoning – using borders and the relationships between cells – will help you lock down safe spots and succeed.

Rich levels & difficulty: From beginner to expert, hundreds of cleverly designed logic puzzles await. Every level is carefully crafted to keep your brain sharp and engaged.

🐕 Dog Theme – Designed for Dog Lovers

Unlike traditional number Sudoku, each dog has its own unique look. Every time you complete a level, you’ll hear a cheerful “Woof!” and see a paw‑raising dog celebrating your victory!

🧠 A fresh take on classic puzzles
Break the routine – replace dull numbers with cute dog characters and make solving puzzles even more fun.

🐩 A unique dog collection
From Golden Retrievers and Corgis to Huskies, unlock and collect a wide variety of adorable dogs as you progress.

🎨 Easy on the eyes
Bright, warm colors and a friendly, intuitive interface let you enjoy the game anytime – whether you’re relaxing after noon or during a short commute.

❤️ Stress‑free brain training
A wholesome puzzle game for all ages. Exercise your mind and unwind wherever you are.

🐾 Download Findoku now and start a fun brain adventure with your clever canine companion!

2. Đoàn Kết & Chiến Lược, Sức Mạnh & Vinh Quang
Tránh né sát thương, khống chế đối phương, và cứu giúp đồng đội! Hoá thân thành Đỡ Đòn, Pháp Sư, Xạ Thủ, Sát Thủ, Hỗ Trợ... để cân đối đội hình và sở hữu danh hiệu MVP của cả trận đấu! Các vị tướng mới sẽ được ra mắt định kỳ!

3. Tranh Tài Cực Công Bằng, Gánh Team Và Chiến Thắng
Giống như các tựa game MOBA cổ điển khác, các vị tướng ở đây không có chuyện nâng cấp để khoẻ hơn. Thuần thục kỹ năng và tư duy chiến lược mới là chìa khoá giúp bạn chiến thắng các trận đấu trong tựa game công bằng và cân đối này. Càng Luyện Càng Giỏi, chứ không phải Càng Nhiều Tiền Càng Tốt.

4. Thao Tác Giản Đơn, Điều Khiển Dễ Dàng
Với nút di chuyển bên trái và nút kỹ năng bên phải, chỉ cần 2 ngón tay để tôi luyện thành cao thủ! Tự động khoá và chuyển đổi mục tiêu cho phép bạn bứt phá khả năng của bản thân. Nhắm đâu cũng trúng! Đi kèm là một hệ thống chạm-để-dùng cực kỳ thuận tiện, cho phép bạn mua trang bị ở bất cứ đâu trên bản đồ, tăng sự tập trung vào diễn biến trận đấu!

5. 10 Giây Ghép Đội, 10 Phút Tranh Đấu
Ghép đội chỉ mất 10 giây mà thôi, và một trận đấu diễn ra chỉ trong 10 phút. Hãy bỏ qua sự im ắng đầy nhàm chán ở đầu trận và hướng sự chú ý về những đợt giao tranh đầy gay cấn. Đừng chờ đợi và farm khắp nơi, hãy cố gắng áp đảo đối phương để dễ dàng chiến thắng. Mọi lúc mọi nơi, cứ cầm điện thoại lên, thổi bùng ngọn lửa trong bạn, và hoà minh vào những trận đấu MOBA hồi hộp đúng nghĩa.

6. AI Hỗ Trợ Thông Minh
Sự cố mất mạng có thể khiến đội của bạn thất thủ trong một trận đấu đang trên đà gay cấn, nhưng với hệ thống kết nối lại cực hữu ích của Mobile Legends: Bang Bang, nếu gặp vấn đề về đường truyền, bạn vẫn có thể quay lại chỉ trong vài giây. Và trong khoảng thời gian bạn offline, hệ thống AI của game sẽ tạm thời điều khiển tướng của bạn để tránh xảy ra tình trạng 4-đấu-5.

CHÚ Ý! Mobile Legends: Bang Bang là một tựa game có thể tải về và chơi miễn phí, nhưng vẫn sẽ có một vài vật phẩm trong game cần được mua bằng tiền. Nếu bạn muốn sử dụng tính năng này, hãy cài đặt bảo mật mật khẩu mua hàng trong phần cài đặt ở ứng dụng Cửa Hàng Google Play. Đồng thời, như đã ghi trong Điều Khoản Dịch Vụ và Chính Sách Bảo Mật, độ tuổi tối thiểu của người chơi phải là 12 tuổi để có thể chơi hoặc tải xuống Mobile Legends: Bang Bang.

Liên Hệ Với Chúng Tôi
Nếu gặp bất cứ khó khăn nào khi chơi game, bạn có thể nhờ hỗ trợ từ bộ phận CSKH bằng cách ấn vào nút [Liên Hệ] trong game. Bạn cũng có thể liên hệ với chúng tôi thông qua các nền tảng bên dưới. Chúng tôi luôn chào đón những đề xuất, góp ý từ những người chơi Mobile Legends: Bang Bang

data.name: Minicraft: Craftarena Block 3D
data.description_full:
Minicraft: Block Craft 3D is a professional sandbox adventure game that allows players to explore a vast block-based world filled with creativity, survival challenges, and endless possibilities. It is designed for players who enjoy crafting, building, and discovering new environments.

1. Open World Exploration
The game features a large, procedurally generated open world where every area feels unique. Players can explore forests, mountains, caves, deserts, and oceans, making each journey exciting and unpredictable.

2. Creative Building System
With its flexible block-based building system, players can construct anything they imagine. From simple houses to massive cities and detailed structures, creativity has no limits.

3. Survival Mode Challenges
In Survival mode, players must collect resources, craft tools, and defend themselves against hostile creatures. The day and night cycle increases difficulty, as enemies become more dangerous after sunset.

4. Creative Mode Freedom
Creative mode provides unlimited resources and the ability to fly. This mode is perfect for players who want to focus entirely on building and design without survival restrictions.

5. Mining and Crafting Mechanics
Mining plays a central role in the game. Players gather ores and materials to craft tools, weapons, armor, and other useful items using an easy-to-learn crafting system.

6. Enchanting and Brewing Systems
As players progress, they can unlock enchanting and potion brewing features. These systems enhance tools and equipment with special abilities, improving survival and exploration.

7. Mobs and Creatures
The world is filled with a variety of mobs, each with unique behaviors and challenges. Players must adjust their strategies to survive encounters with different creatures.

8. Biomes and Special Dimensions
Multiple biomes offer diverse landscapes, climates, and resources. Special dimensions introduce rare items, tougher enemies, and exciting new adventures.

9. Redstone Engineering
The redstone system allows players to create automated machines, traps, and mechanisms. From basic switches to advanced circuits, it adds depth and creativity to gameplay.

10. Multiplayer Experience
Multiplayer mode enables players to connect, collaborate, or compete with others. Build together, explore new areas, or engage in PvP battles for a more social gaming experience.

In essence, Minicraft: Block Craft 3D stands out through its perfect balance of creative freedom, open-world exploration, and engaging survival challenges. Supported by an active and growing community, the game continues to evolve with new possibilities. Whether you choose to play alone or team up with friends, the blocky world offers endless opportunities for fun and imagination.

data.name: IndonesianToTo
data.description_full:
"Gameplay Design
Core Gameplay:
The player clicks on two identical tiles. If the line connecting them is no more than three zigzags (i.e., two turns), the connection is successful and the tiles are removed.

The empty space after removal can be filled with surrounding tiles, or the entire tile remains unchanged.

Clearing all tiles within the specified time wins.

Game Interface Design
The main interface includes the following elements:
Game Area: A grid layout (e.g., 8x10), with an icon displayed per grid.

Top Bar:

Timer (e.g., 60-second countdown)

Score

Number of remaining hints (e.g., 3)

Back/Pause button

Bottom Bar:

Rearrange button

Hint button

Sound control

Game Logic Design
Tile Generation:
The number of tile types varies based on difficulty (6 for beginner, 8 for intermediate, and 10 for advanced).

Ensure that all tiles are matched at the beginning to prevent unsolvable puzzles.

Connection Verification:
Implement a ""path-finding algorithm"" to determine whether two tiles can be connected (with 0-2 turns).

You can use BFS (Breadth-First Search) with direction indicators.

Determine whether the two points can be ""traversed"" within the current grid state.

Removal Animation:
Use a connection effect (line drawing animation), and then gradually make the two tiles transparent.

Add special sound effects and a score-bouncing animation for each connection.

⚙️ Difficulty Design
Difficulty Grid Size Icon Type Time Limit Rearrangement
Easy 6x8 6 Types 90 Seconds ✅
Medium 8x10 8 Types 75 Seconds ✅
Hard 10x12 10 Types 60 Seconds ✅

UI/UX Style Recommendations
Keep fresh colors. Icons can use cartoon fruits, animals, or symbols.

Tile borders can have a slight shadow to enhance the three-dimensional effect.

Connection effects can be set to colored light or trails with particle effects.

Sound Effects and Special Effects
Background Music: Light and lively.

Sound Effects:

Clicking Sound

Clearing Sound (can simulate refreshing sounds like ""ding"" and ""click"")

Combo Sound for consecutive successful connections"

data.name: Card Jam: Word Puzzle
data.description_full:
🌸 Sort It Out — Moves Matter, Categories Grow! 🌸

Flowers, fruits, animals, toys, fairies… all mixed up in one big pile. Your job? Drag every card into its matching category. Sounds easy? Wait until you see the move counter.

🎯 How It Works
Each level gives you a limited number of moves. Every time you drag a card to a category, that’s one move. You need to sort every single card before your moves run out. No pressure… right?

🧠 One Done, More Appear
Here’s the twist: as soon as you finish sorting one category, new cards of a random new type pop onto the board. Just when you thought you were done, the game says, “Oh, by the way, here come the vegetables / robots / unicorns…” You’ll have to keep adapting.

🔄 Limited Moves, Endless Thinking
You can’t just throw cards around. A wrong move wastes precious attempts. You’ll need to plan ahead: which category to finish first? Which new type might appear? Should you leave a few cards unsorted to prepare for the surprise?

🌈 More Categories, More Chaos
As you level up, the board gets more crowded. Some categories look almost identical — are those cherries or tiny red balloons? Is that a fox or a dog? Your eyes and brain will get a real workout.

🏆 Beat the Move Limit
Every level is a new puzzle. Finish within the moves, and you move on. Exceed the moves, and you’ll have to try again. No timers, just careful thinking and satisfying clicks.

Ready to become a sorting master? Grab those cards, watch those moves, and tame the ever‑growing pile! 🌸🍎🐱🧸✨

data.name: Spear Stretch

HOLD, STRETCH, RELEASE
The runner moves forward automatically and stops at the edge of each platform.
Hold the screen to extend the spear, then release to drop it across the gap.
A good length creates a safe bridge; a bad length sends the runner into the canyon.

FLOATING TEMPLE PLATFORMS
Each run moves through a bright sky-ruin world filled with stone platforms, deep gaps, and glowing relic targets.
Platform widths and gap distances change throughout the run, so every crossing asks for a fresh timing decision.

CROWN RELIC DASH REWARDS
Golden crown relics create a special reward moment.
Hit one with the spear to trigger a burst of energy, bonus scoring, and a dash that carries the runner across five platforms.

ANCIENT MECHANISM TARGETS
Some platforms hold glowing mechanism cores.
Landing the spear on these targets grants extra points and rewards precise control beyond simple survival.

PERFECT FOR PLAYERS WHO LOVE

One-touch arcade games
Bridge timing challenges
Distance judgment gameplay
Crown relic rewards
Short score-chase runs

Step into the role of a professional police officer, patrol a massive crime city, and take down criminals before they take over the streets. Whether you are a fan of cop games, crime city simulators, or open world driving adventures, this game delivers it all in one package. data.name: Город грехов: Путь босса
data.description_full:
Добро пожаловать в Город грехов: Путь босса!

Здесь власть не дают просто так. Её забирают силой, хитростью и верными людьми. Улицы полны денег, предательства и опасных сделок, а каждый район ждёт того, кто сможет подчинить его себе.

Начните путь с самых низов и станьте боссом криминальной империи. Нанимайте людей вне закона, головорезов, карателей и главарей, собирайте сильный отряд, усиливайте персонажей, забирайте ресурсы и расширяйте своё влияние. В этом городе вы либо правите, либо становитесь чьей-то добычей.

[Соберите свою банду]
Нанимайте мафиози, уличных бойцов, гонщиков, байкеров и подпольных боссов со всего Города грехов. У каждого персонажа своя роль, стиль боя и набор навыков. Комбинируйте урон, защиту, контроль и поддержку, чтобы собрать отряд, который сможет разнести любого противника.

[Сражайтесь без лишней рутины]
Автобой берёт грязную работу на себя. Развивайте персонажей, подбирайте состав команды, усиливайте экипировку и грамотно распределяйте ресурсы, а ваша банда сама разберётся с теми, кто встанет у неё на пути. Уличные стычки, войны за территорию и ежедневные подземелья станут проще и быстрее.

[Забирайте добычу каждый день]
Улицы щедры к тем, кто не боится драки. Проходите ежедневные испытания, побеждайте противников и получайте ресурсы для прокачки команды. Каждая победа усиливает вашу банду, расширяет влияние и приближает вас к вершине криминального мира.

[Постройте преступную империю]
Казино, ночные клубы, подпольный бизнес и грязные деньги: всё это может работать на вас. Развивайте свою организацию, объединяйтесь с другими игроками, укрепляйте синдикат и превращайте уличную банду в настоящую мафиозную империю.

[Живите как настоящий босс]
Дорогие машины, роскошные особняки, горы налички, эффектные спутницы и власть над городом. Наслаждайтесь жизнью на вершине, но помните: чем выше вы поднимаетесь, тем больше желающих сбросить вас вниз.

[Пройдите путь власти и предательства]
Вас ждёт история амбиций, мести, опасных союзов и жестокой борьбы за влияние. Вы встретите союзников и противников, примете непростые решения и сами определите свою судьбу. Останетесь мелким уличным головорезом или станете главным боссом Города грехов?

Войдите в Город грехов: Путь босса прямо сейчас. Призывайте людей вне закона, усиливайте банду, проходите испытания, захватывайте улицы и постройте собственную криминальную империю!

data.name: Print Sort: Color Puzzle
data.description_full:
What if a puzzle game could stretch your brain, calm your nerves, and let you watch adorable little ducks take shape right before your eyes?
That's Print Sort: Color Puzzle.
Moving beyond traditional color-sorting mechanics, Print Sort brings together two unexpected worlds: path-solving puzzles and 3D printing. You're not just clearing a static grid — you're fueling a fleet of 3D printers, each one hungry for its own color.
🖨️ More Than a Puzzle — It's a Print Lab
When you open the game, here's what you'll see:
In the workspace above, a few 3D printers sit quietly, each holding an empty mold, ready to bring a duck to life.
Below, a maze of vibrant lines twists and crisscrosses the board. Each one acts as a tube of 3D printing filament, and along every line you'll find directional arrows — waiting for your command.
Your mission: tap the right arrows, route each color along its path, and deliver the material into the matching printer. With every line delivered, your duck grows a little more — collect them all, and it's complete.
That moment — watching a tiny duck slowly take shape — feels a little like childhood, the same joy as watching clay come alive.
🧠 Where's the Challenge?
It looks simple. It isn't:
- Multiple colors weave through each other — one wrong tap, and you'll lose a life. You only get three.
- Short routes often block longer ones — plan your order, or stay stuck.
- In later levels, a single arrow can change the flow of an entire line.
- Stuck? Hint bulbs light up a safe move when you need one.
Every level feels like unraveling a colorful ball of yarn — find the right thread to pull, and the whole puzzle opens up.
🌿 Designed for Calm Minds
We built Print Sort to be the little reset button in your day — for commutes, lunch breaks, or those last quiet minutes before sleep:
- No timer — think as slowly as you like.
- No energy system — play for one minute or even for one hour.
- Play offline — works on planes, subways, anywhere.
- Soft visuals — neon lines on dark backgrounds, easy on the eyes.
- Soothing sounds — every successful print rewards you with a gentle chime.
✨ Who Will Love It?
- Puzzle fans who want a brain workout without time pressure.
- Suckers for cute, soothing visuals.
- Busy people looking for a mindful pocket of calm.
- Gamers wanting an accessible puzzle that all skill levels can play together.
- Curious players who just couldn't resist the idea of a 3D-printing duck game.
🌈 Start Your Print Sort Journey
Tap your first arrow. Watch the color start to flow. The moment your first little duck takes shape, you'll know — this one's different.

A shattered life. A mother’s courage. A puzzle to rebuild it all. Experience an emotional story-driven puzzle game where every merge and split brings hope back from the ashes.

Her Jigsaw Story weaves deep narrative with innovative puzzle gameplay. You follow a brave woman who loses everything—her family, her home, and most painfully, her daughter. But she refuses to break. Through hardship and heartbreak, she rises again, rebuilds her life with relentless strength, and journeys toward the one moment that matters most: reuniting with her child.

The story is told through artistic jigsaw puzzles—each piece of art captures a key emotion: loss, struggle, resilience, and love.


Unique Puzzle Mechanic:
Each picture is divided into blocks on a grid. Move these blocks to reassemble the full image. When matching blocks touch, they automatically merge into larger pieces. When you need to rearrange, blocks can split apart. Find the perfect arrangement to restore each memory.

Every completed puzzle unlocks a new chapter of her journey. The scattered pieces of her life slowly come together—just like the puzzles you solve.

Can you help her piece everything back together?


Key Features:

Emotional storytelling of rebirth and motherly love;
Innovative merge & split puzzle mechanics;
Beautiful art tied directly to the story;
Relaxing yet thoughtful gameplay;


Rebuild her world. One puzzle. One memory. One hug.

data.name: Cuộc Đời Gấm Vóc
data.description_full:
Giấy phép phát hành trò chơi điện tử: 113/GCN-SVHTT do Sở Văn hóa và Thể thao thành phố Hà Nội cấp ngày 17 tháng 3 năm 2026.

Chào mừng bạn đến với *Cẩm Tú Nhân Sinh*, tựa game mô phỏng cuộc đời gia tộc phong cách cổ trang đầy lôi cuốn. Với tư cách là gia chủ, bạn sẽ nâng cao năng lực của mình như thế nào? Bạn sẽ dẫn dắt gia tộc đi về đâu? Bạn sẽ chọn ai là người bạn đời đồng cam cộng khổ, và bạn sẽ dạy dỗ con cái ra sao? Tất cả đều nằm trong *Cẩm Tú Nhân Sinh*.

1. Thiết kế nhân vật và đồ họa phong cách cổ trang tối giản
Sử dụng phong cách cổ đại tươi mới, mộc mạc cùng những thay đổi tinh tế trên gương mặt nhân vật, mang đến cho người chơi trải nghiệm về sự thay đổi và trưởng thành của cuộc đời trong một bầu không khí nhẹ nhàng, thư thái.

2. Quản lý gia tộc và những lựa chọn định mệnh
Mục tiêu của bạn là xây dựng một gia tộc hưng thịnh. Sự trưởng thành của mỗi thành viên và lựa chọn của bạn trong từng sự kiện đều sẽ ảnh hưởng đến sự phát triển và vận mệnh của gia tộc. Bạn sẽ liên tục đưa ra các quyết định để thúc đẩy sự thay đổi của gia tộc, từ đó tạo dựng nên một cơ nghiệp vạn đời.

3. Bối cảnh thời đại
Bạn đang sống trong thời đại cổ xưa, nơi bạn có thể lựa chọn nhiều loại ngành nghề khác nhau. Mỗi nghề nghiệp đều có lộ trình thăng tiến và phẩm cấp tương ứng, đồng thời còn có các ẩn phẩm cấp có thể kích hoạt các nhiệm vụ bí mật giúp thay đổi cả triều đại.

4. Tích lũy tài sản
Người chơi có thể điều hành nhiều loại cửa hàng (như cửa hàng tạp hóa, tiệm rèn, hiệu thuốc, tiệm cầm đồ, v.v.), thông qua việc chiêu mộ gia nhân quản lý cửa hàng để tăng thu nhập, hoặc có thể thông qua việc buôn bán đường xa (thương nhân gia đình) để gia tăng đáng kể thu nhập cho gia tộc, từ đó giúp các thành viên có nhiều lựa chọn hơn khi đối mặt với các sự kiện phát sinh.

5. Cốt truyện phong phú và sự kiện ngẫu nhiên
Trong game, các sự kiện ngẫu nhiên sẽ liên tục xuất hiện (như đi học, bệnh tật, của cải bất ngờ, sự kiện nghề nghiệp, v.v.), thử thách khả năng ra quyết định của bạn. Những suy nghĩ khác nhau sẽ mang lại những ảnh hưởng khác nhau, tác động đến từng chỉ số cơ bản của bạn. Ngoài ra còn có vô vàn kỳ ngộ thú vị, khiến mỗi lần trải nghiệm đều là một hành trình hoàn toàn mới mẻ.

data.name: Slide Arrows Match
data.description_full:
"Slide Arrows Match" is an addictive logic puzzle game. The game screen is a grid filled with colored arrows, each pointing in a different direction. Your goal is to tap these arrows, causing them to move in the direction they point, until all arrows are off the screen. Sounds simple? Don't underestimate it—the difficulty increases as you progress!

Game Features
Basic Controls: Tap to select an arrow, and the arrow will move in the direction it points.If an arrow collides with another arrow in its forward direction, it will lose one health point. You have three health points; once you run out, you must start over.
Guidance: Each arrow in the game has an extension line indicating its forward direction.
Four different game color schemes are available to suit different gaming preferences.

Slide Rules:
Arrows can only move in the direction they point.
Only one arrow can be moved at a time.
Arrows cannot pass through other arrows.
Winning Condition: Win the level when all arrows on the board are off the screen.

How to Play

data.name: Vita Sort
data.description_full:
Vita Sort - Exclusive Puzzle, Strategic Categorization
Vita Sort is an exclusive Mahjong tile categorization puzzle game. We are thrilled to present this fresh title that blends classic Mahjong visual art with innovative gameplay. Featuring clear, large Mahjong tiles and a user-friendly interface compatible with phones, our goal is to provide a relaxing yet mentally engaging experience for all players, particularly focused on older adults.
How to Play Vita Sort:
Playing Vita Sort is intuitive, with its core mechanics centered around your meticulous observation, clever categorization, and strategic tapping to effectively manage the tiles and collection areas.
1. Tap to Collect: Tap any available Mahjong tile on the board, and it will first move into the temporary tray at the bottom.
2. Activate & Categorize:
- The top of the screen features 3 main category slots, displaying active Mahjong tile categories and their collection progress (e.g., "Characters 2/4").
- When a Mahjong tile enters the temporary tray, if it belongs to a category already represented in one of the main category slots, all matching tiles in the tray will automatically categorize and count towards that main slot's progress.
- If the tile belongs to a new major category and there's an empty main category slot at the top, that new category will be activated and occupy a slot.
3. Complete & Clear: Once the number of Mahjong tiles in a main category slot reaches its target requirement, that category will be fully collected and disappear from the slot, freeing up space for new categories.
4. Strategic Planning: The temporary tray has limited space. You need to plan your taps in advance, ensuring each tap effectively contributes to completing a main category. Avoid filling the tray with too many un-categorizable tiles, which could lead to a stalled game.
5. Clear the Board Challenge: Your ultimate goal is to use your wisdom to gradually clear all Mahjong tiles from the board, successfully completing each level!
Exclusive Vita Sort Game Features:
- "Tile Fusion Sort" Innovative Gameplay: Moving beyond traditional matching, we introduce the unique "Tile Fusion Sort" innovative gameplay. This is more than just simple sorting; it's a comprehensive test of your ability to quickly identify, precisely categorize, and strategically plan your moves.
- Classic Mahjong Art Style: The game features classic Mahjong tile visuals, paired with hundreds of meticulously designed board layouts, offering a familiar yet fresh visual feast.
- Large-Scale, Easy-to-Read Design: Designed with players in mind, we use large, clear, and easy-to-read Mahjong tiles and text, allowing you to say goodbye to the strain of small fonts and fully enjoy a comfortable game.
- Mentally Engaging Levels: Each level is thoughtfully designed to activate your mind, helping you enhance your categorization thinking, observation skills, concentration, and short-term memory in a relaxed and enjoyable atmosphere.
- Super Combo Experience: When you cleverly strategize to trigger a continuous collection and elimination of many Mahjong tiles in one go, you'll unlock a thrilling Super Combo, gaining extraordinary game satisfaction and rewards!
- Helpful Auxiliary Tools: The game provides free and useful tools, such as the Undo function to correct mistakes, and the Shuffle tool to open up new possibilities, helping you overcome challenging situations.
- Offline Mode: Full offline support lets you immerse yourself in the fun of Vita Sort anytime, anywhere, without needing an internet connection.
Vita Sort is a meticulously crafted puzzle masterpiece designed for players who love strategic categorization and visual puzzle-solving games.
Note: This is a puzzle game in the style of Mahjong tiles, focused on categorization. It does not contain the rules of traditional Mahjong, Mahjong Solitaire, or other types of card games. The term “Mahjong” here refers solely to the visual style of the tiles.
data.description_short: Vita Sort: Mahjong tile sort puzzle. Plan, categorize, relax & train brain.

data.name: Arrow Lock
data.description_full:
Welcome to ArrowLock: Color Burst – the most vibrant, playful, and brain-teasing puzzle adventure designed for kids, families, and casual gamers of all ages!

Embark on a magical journey through starry skies and fairytale landscapes as you solve cute arrow grids, launch colorful paths, and burst matching lock bubbles! ArrowLock combines spatial logic, playful physics, and charming cartoon graphics into a delightful game that is easy to learn but offers hours of engaging fun.

🎯 THE ULTIMATE PUZZLE GAMEPLAY
In ArrowLock, the goal is simple: clear the grid to unlock the fun! The screen is split into two exciting zones:
• The Bottom Grid: A maze of colorful, interconnected C-shaped and line-shaped cartoon arrows that block each other's path.
• The Top Bouncing Zone: A matching grid filled with colorful lock bubbles that must be popped!

HOW TO PLAY:
1. Tap to Untangle: Find an arrow that has a clear path forward and tap it!
2. Launch & Fly: Watch the arrow smoothly slide out of the grid and fly into the bouncing zone.
3. Burst the Locks: The launched arrow will reflect and bounce off the walls, popping every lock bubble that matches its color!
4. Clear the Board: Pop all the locks to complete the level, unlock new areas, and collect shiny coins!

✨ A MAGICAL EXPERIENCE FOR KIDS & FAMILIES
• Whimsical Fairy-Tale Theme: Play over a beautiful hand-crafted backdrop featuring a cozy cartoon village, bridges, castles, clouds, and starry nights designed to inspire children’s imaginations.
• Gorgeous Glossy 3D Art: Clean vector designs, bright juicy pastel palettes (vibrant oranges, yellows, blues, and greens), and bubbly pop animations that look premium and satisfying on every screen.
• Play & Learn: A fantastic logic game that boosts kids' spatial reasoning, hand-eye coordination, and strategic problem-solving skills in a friendly, stress-free environment.
• Cozy & Relaxing: No strict timers, no high pressure, and no stressful penalties. Play at your own pace whenever and wherever you want!

🚀 DISCOVER AMAZING POWER-UPS & FEATURES
• Epic Special Skills: Stuck on a tricky level? Unleash the "Color Bomb" to burst multiple locks instantly, or trigger the "Snake Rush" for a fast and satisfying cleanup!
• Key & Lock Mechanics: Discover special locked regions on the grid. Find the key on the lock board, pop it, and release the locked arrows to solve the ultimate maze!
• Infinite Levels: Hundreds of unique puzzle configurations that grow gradually in complexity to keep your brain active and entertained.
• Complete Rebranding & Quality Assurance: Enjoy high-performance gameplay, highly responsive touch controls, and smooth cartoon animations built with maximum care.

Are you ready to untangle the colorful arrows, explore the magical castle village, and pop all the locking bubbles?

Download ArrowLock: Color Burst today and let the playful popping adventure begin!

data.name: Lumberjack Simulator 3D
data.description_full:
Become a real woodsman in Lumberjack Simulator 3D — a realistic first person logging simulator and a relaxing game about chopping trees, processing timber and building your own forest industry from the ground up.

Step into a huge forest world and begin your journey with only an axe in your hands. Explore the wilderness, choose which trees to chop and develop your own logging operation at your own pace. Enjoy calm and satisfying tree chopping with no idle automation — every tree is harvested manually.

Chop trees with realistic axe mechanics and experience immersive wood cutting gameplay. Shape the notch, control the direction of tree felling and process timber step by step. Remove branches, cut trunks into logs, transport materials and turn raw wood into valuable products.

Carry logs by hand, load your transport and move timber through the forest. Restore an abandoned pickup truck, repair it and use it to haul logs across rough terrain. Load the cargo bed, drive along forest roads and expand your production faster. The pickup also features visual damage mechanics for a more immersive offroad experience.

Build and expand your sawmill piece by piece. Unlock machines, processing stations and industrial equipment. Debark logs, process timber, create beams and boards, and transform raw resources into valuable finished products.

data.name: Mahjong Crush: Tile Match
data.description_full:
Mahjong Crush: Tile Match puts a new spin on the classic: instead of tapping pairs, you slide tiles across the board and match them on collision. It sounds simple — and it is to pick up — but clearing a full board takes real planning.

🀄 Slide to match
Push a tile and watch it glide. When two matching suits meet, they disappear. The satisfying click of a clean collision never gets old.

🧩 Think a few moves ahead
Each slide shifts the whole board. A good move creates a chain; a careless one closes off your options. Levels start approachable and gradually ask more of you — planning a sequence, setting up combos, working around the layout.

🌿 Play at your own pace
No countdown timers. Take your time to read the board, line up the right push, and feel the quiet satisfaction of a well-played level. If you get stuck, hints and shuffle are there when you need them.

✨ Clean visuals, clear tiles
Large, sharp tiles that are easy to read — especially on bigger screens. Smooth animations and subtle feedback on every match, without going overboard.

data.description_full:
เกมปลูกดอกไม้สุดฮิตที่ผู้เล่นทั่วโลกหลงรัก เตรียมเปิดให้บริการในไทยอย่างเป็นทางการวันที่ 3 มิถุนายน!
กิจกรรมเล่นเกมลุ้นรับดอกไม้จริงเปิดให้ร่วมสนุกได้ตลอด พร้อมจัดส่งตรงถึงบ้านสำหรับผู้เล่นในประเทศไทย!

โลกสวนดอกไม้ของฉันเป็นเกมจำลองสถานการณ์ที่ผ่อนคลายและเยียวยาจิตใจ ที่นี่คุณจะได้พบเพื่อนรักดอกไม้มากมาย และสร้างสังคมเพื่อนรักดอกไม้ของคุณเอง
เกมนี้เล่นง่าย เริ่มต้นได้ทันที ทุกครั้งที่ปลูกดอกไม้ก็มีความตื่นเต้นเล็กๆ รอคุณอยู่ เราอยากมอบความโรแมนติกจากโลกเสมือนมาสู่มือคุณจริงๆ!

〓 โชคดีมาแล้ว ‧ ดอกไม้สดส่งฟรีถึงบ้าน 〓
ความโรแมนติกสุดพิเศษสำหรับคุณ! เพียงปลูกดอกไม้ในเกม เมื่อเก็บเกี่ยวดอกไม้ที่โตเต็มที่ คุณมีโอกาสได้รับการ์ดอวยพรดอกไม้ และแลกเป็นช่อดอกไม้สดส่งตรงถึงบ้านฟรีเลย!

〓 ปลูกดอกไม้สบายๆ ‧ สร้างสวนเฉพาะของคุณ 〓
ในสวนเฉพาะของคุณ ปลูกดูแลกล้วยไม้ ลีลาวดี ดอกมะลิ และดอกไม้มากมายด้วยมือคุณเอง เพลิดเพลินกับช่วงเวลาการปลูกที่ผ่อนคลายและบำบัดใจ ปล่อยวางความเครียดทีละนิด พร้อมสัมผัสความอบอุ่นจากเพื่อนดอกไม้ที่อยู่เคียงข้าง

〓 สนุกกับเพื่อน ‧ คลายเครียดด้วยสังคมเกม 〓
ในสวนไม่มีคำว่าเหงา! ผูกมิตรกับเพื่อนซี้ เข้าร่วมกิลด์ เยี่ยมชมสวนเพื่อน หรือแม้แต่ "แอบขโมย" ดอกไม้จากเพื่อนได้ด้วย! สัมผัสประสบการณ์การเล่นที่สนุกสนานและผ่อนคลาย ทุกการพบเจอคือความประหลาดใจ

〓 ศิลปะการจัดดอกไม้ ‧ สร้างสรรค์ชีวิตมีระดับ 〓
ดอกไม้ที่เก็บเกี่ยวไม่ได้มีไว้ชมเท่านั้น แต่ยังจัดแต่งได้อย่างอิสระ ผสมผสานแจกันและดอกไม้หลากหลายชนิด สร้างสรรค์ผลงานจัดดอกไม้ของคุณเอง ตั้งแต่เลือกสีสันไปจนถึงสไตล์ ออกแบบสุนทรียภาพที่เป็นเอกลักษณ์เฉพาะตัว

〓 บริหารร้านดอกไม้ ‧ สัมผัสชีวิตเจ้าของร้าน 〓
รับออเดอร์ จัดทำ ขาย ขยายร้านดอกไม้ของคุณทีละขั้นตอน สร้างร้านดอกไม้ยอดนิยมของคุณอย่างค่อยเป็นค่อยไป ใช้กลยุทธ์การบริหารเพื่อเพิ่มรายได้ ให้สวนและร้านค้าเติบโตไปพร้อมกัน

data.name: Vạn Thắng Nam Đế
data.description_full:
Vạn Thắng Nam Đế là sản phẩm game Việt đầu tiên lấy cảm hứng từ thời kỳ Loạn 12 Sứ Quân trong lịch sử. Thuộc dòng game chiến thuật đỉnh cao (SLG), trò chơi tái hiện những trận chiến công thành quy mô lớn, nơi người chơi tự do bày mưu định kế, điều binh khiển tướng để dẹp loạn cát cứ, nhất thống sơn hà.

1. ĐẮP LUỸ XÂY THÀNH - RÈN QUÂN MỞ CÕI
Khởi đầu từ mảnh đất hoang sơ giữa thời loạn, bạn sẽ hóa thân thành một vị Thủ Lĩnh trẻ tuổi và lựa chọn xuất thân của mình: Nông Dân, Thương Nhân hoặc Thợ Săn - mỗi lựa chọn mở ra lối phát triển riêng biệt. Hành trình dựng xây cơ đồ sẽ bắt đầu từ việc tích lũy tài nguyên, chắt chiu từng hạt gạo, rèn gươm luyện giáp, từng bước phát triển lực lượng và mở rộng lãnh thổ.

2. QUY TỤ DANH TƯỚNG - DẸP LOẠN SỨ QUÂN
Trong Vạn Thắng Nam Đế, các hào kiệt và danh tướng thời Loạn 12 Sứ Quân như Lê Hoàn, Trần Lãm, Phạm Bạch Hổ, Nguyễn Bặc… được tái hiện rõ nét từ diện mạo, binh khí cho đến khí chất anh hùng. Binh chủng tinh nhuệ cần người tài dẫn dắt, hãy quy tụ những bậc danh tướng để cùng sát cánh, trực tiếp thống soái các cánh quân tham gia dẹp loạn.


3. TRẬN MẠC TỨC THỜI - TIẾN THOÁI TUỲ BIẾN
Bản đồ mở thời gian thực cho phép tự do điều quân và tập kết lực lượng trực tiếp trên chiến trường. Thủ Lĩnh có thể chủ động thay đổi hướng hành quân, quyết định tấn công, rút lui hoặc mai phục ngay lập tức tùy theo cục diện.

4. TẬP KẾT LIÊN QUÂN - CÔNG PHÁ QUAN ẢI
Hệ thống Liên Minh là nơi các Thủ Lĩnh hội quân, kết tình đồng minh để định hình các thế lực trong Vạn Thắng Nam Đế. Thủ Lĩnh trong cùng Liên Minh có thể hỗ trợ nhau tăng tốc thời gian xây dựng công trình và viện trợ quân sự để bảo vệ căn cứ. Chung tay đánh chiếm các thành trì sẽ giúp mở rộng Lãnh Thổ Liên Minh, mở khóa quyền khai thác các nguồn tài nguyên cao cấp.

5. BÀY BINH BỐ TRẬN - LẤY MƯU ĐỊNH THẮNG
Hệ thống binh chủng đậm chất Việt cổ với cơ chế tam giác tương khắc kinh điển: Bộ Binh khắc Kỵ Binh , Kỵ Binh khắc Cung binh, Cung Binh khắc Bộ Binh, tạo nên những chiến thuật đặc sắc tại Vạn Thắng Nam Đế. Thủ Lĩnh linh hoạt điều binh và lựa chọn đội hình tối ưu trong từng trận chiến.
