data.name: Duckdoku: Sudoku Puzzle Game
data.description_full:
🦆 Duckdoku — A Brain-Teasing Puzzle with a Twist! 🦆

Think you know Sudoku? Try this adorable and clever challenge! Instead of numbers, you're hunting for hidden ducks. Instead of plain grids, you get colorful blocks. And every move matters.

🎮 How to Play

Tap once to mark a safe spot (no duck there).

Double-tap to flip a tile and reveal a duck — but be careful, because rules are strict!

🧩 The Rules
Every row and every column must contain exactly one duck.
Each color zone (a group of same-colored tiles) must also contain exactly one duck.
And here’s the kicker — ducks cannot be next to each other!

🌈 Colorful & Tricky
As you level up, the board gets bigger, the color zones get more complex, and the puzzles become seriously mind-bending. You’ll need logic, patience, and sharp observation to find the perfect spot for every duck.

🧠 Train Your Brain
This isn’t just a matching game — it’s a pure logic puzzle that makes you think step by step. One wrong tap, and you might trap yourself with no place left for a duck.

Can you find all the hidden ducks without breaking the rules?
Jump in and put your puzzle-solving skills to the test! 🦆🔴🔵🟡🟢
data.description_short: Analyze Sudoku gameplay and find the hidden duck.

data.name: Indian Dress Up: Bride Stylist
data.description_full:
Pick the perfect lehenga, layer on the jewels, and go head-to-head against rival stylists to claim the Lovely Bride crown. Indian Bride Dress Up Games puts you in full control of every bridal look, from the skincare routine all the way to the final bindi. Can you out-style the competition?

This is a dress up Indian wedding experience built around real fashion choices. Every outfit, every accessory, and every makeup detail you pick feeds into a live competition score. Style smart, style fast, and walk your bride down the ramp in a look that judges cannot ignore.

What you actually do in the game:

Skincare first. Before a single jewel goes on, you run a relaxing skincare routine to give your bride a glowing base. It sets up the canvas for everything that follows.

Bridal outfit selection. Browse a wide collection of lehengas, sarees, and fusion bridal looks. Mix silhouettes, fabrics, and embroidery styles to build a look that fits the brief for each round.

Makeup studio. Choose eye shadows, lashes, liners, and lipstick shades from a full makeup kit. Subtle daytime bridal or full-on heavy glam, the call is yours.

Hair and color. Match the hairstyle and hair color to the outfit. A messy bun reads differently than a sleek updo, and the judges notice every choice.

Jewelry and accessories. Stack bangles, drop earrings, maang tikka, and nath to complete the look. Even the bindi placement is part of your score.

Fashion fight rounds. Once the look is locked in, your bride walks the ramp and competes directly against other styled brides. Win rounds to unlock pretty outfit categories, lovely jewelry sets, and late amazing makeup palettes.

Why players keep coming back:

The competition format means no two sessions feel the same. Each round brings a different style brief, so the lehenga look that scored high last time might not cut it against an evening reception theme. You have to read the brief, adapt your choices, and execute fast.

The item depth is real. Indian girl dress up games often recycle the same ten outfits. Here, the wardrobe spans traditional bridal red, pastel mint, deep jewel tones, and even indo-western crossover pieces, so there is always a combination you have not tried yet.

The progression is satisfying. Early rounds are forgiving and teach you how makeup layers and outfit pairings interact. Later rounds demand precision, and unlocking a rare jewelry set after a tough win feels genuinely earned.

If you enjoy indian girl makeup games, wedding stylist challenges, or any bridal dress up experience, this game gives you all of that inside a single competitive loop. Get Indian Bride Dress Up Games and show the ramp what real bridal styling looks like.

data.name: Idle Flight Manager
data.description_full:
One small airplane. One route. $120,000 in the bank... That's how every aviation empire starts.

Idle Flight Manager is a live-world airline management game where you draw routes on a real map, buy real aircraft, and watch your fleet grow from a single regional prop plane into a global operation of Boeing 747s and Airbus A380s. Earn revenue around the clock, even while you're offline.

What you do:
Tap airports to design multi-stop routes. Assign a plane and it begins flying the circuit immediately: carrying passengers, landing, turning around, and flying again. The map fills with glowing route lines as your airline expands. Revenue ticks up with every completed leg.

Key features:
📍 Live world map: real-time plane icons move along your routes on a global map that grows as you unlock regions.
✈️ 50+ real aircraft across 10 tiers. From ATR turboprops and Embraer regional jets to Boeing 777s, Airbus A380s, and exotic premium aircrafts.
🌍 9 unlockable world regions. Expand from US domestic routes to international routes: Canada, Europe, Asia, Africa, and Oceania.
💰 Make money while you sleep: flights complete and income accumulates offline; return to a fully loaded airline fleet!
🎯 Random events: crew strikes, tourism booms, fuel price drops, and government subsidies keep operations unpredictable
🚁 Reward drones: spot drone icons flying across the map and tap to collect bonus cash or miles!
🤖 Auto Flight Manager: assigns planes, creates routes, and re-optimizes your entire network automatically.
🛒 Daily used-plane market, 8 rotating listings at steep discounts or spot-buy a rival's plane directly off the live map.

Progression and Fleet Management:
- Level up by completing route circuits and unlock the next tier of aircraft. Manage plane condition carefully. Let it fall below 50% and revenue drops noticeably. Let it fall below 30% and costs stack heavily.
- Set pricing per route to match your strategy. Economy fills every seat at lower fares. Luxury charges almost double per passenger but risks flying half-empty.
- Build hub airports where multiple routes converge to earn a network revenue bonus. Take bank loans to fund bold expansion. Spend miles to unlock countries, each opening new airports and longer, more profitable routes.

The aircraft catalog:
- Start with regional turboprops on short domestic hops. Work through narrow-bodies like the Boeing 737 MAX and Airbus A320neo. Progress into wide-bodies such as the Boeing 787 Dreamliner and Airbus A330neo.
- Finally unlock the legendary flagships: the 747-8, the A380plus, and rare premium aircraft for the most ambitious operators. Collect exclusive variants like the Stealth 787, the Golden A380, the Concorde Neo, and the Zero-G Orbiter.

Your airline, always working: Over 150 NPC airlines populate the skies with ambient traffic. Speed boosts let you accelerate to 2x or 10x speed. Every 7 in-game days, a weekly report delivers claimable cash, miles, and route credits. Your fleet never stops, with or without you.

Start your first flight. The world map is waiting.

An open-source plan is in place for this application. You can check the progress of the open-source initiative via the link: https://aenu.cc/ax360e/

> **Note** This application is still under active development and may not be compatible with all your favorite games.

This is the free, ad-supported version of aX360e. You can purchase the ad-free version to support the ongoing development of the emulator.

**Important Notice**: This installation package does not contain any game resources. Please export content from your physical Xbox 360 game discs, convert them to **GOD/ISO format files** for use, or directly load files in the supported formats.

---

Key Features
- Supports GOD/ISO game formats (more formats will be added in future updates)
- Vulkan graphics acceleration support
- Talkback accessibility feature compatibility
- Customizable virtual button layout

---

Minimum Hardware Requirements
- Android 9 or higher
- Vulkan graphics API support
- arm64 processor architecture

Dual-authorized by the original anime and novel, the first-ever 3D Open-World MMORPG of the "Soul Land" IP is now available across all platforms! It's time to reshape the massive world of Soul Land and redefine the absolute pinnacle of IP quality!

The moment of awakening has arrived. Welcome to Soul Land: Awakening World! From the instant the first spark of Soul Power stirs within you, your destiny is set: to stand at the heart of the storm and become the legend itself.

The old laws have crumbled, and a tide of new power is rising. From tranquil forests to hidden lakes, every unique Spirit and Spirimon awaits. Meet the legendary Seven Monsters and the formidable Spirit Temple Elders—their stories are yours to discover. Now, it is time to carve your name into your own divine epic.

Redefine the Soul Land Universe!

Beyond Boundaries: Explore the Breathtaking Realm of Soul Land

From the humble fields of Saint Village to the eternal frost of the Icebound Forest; from the untamed wilds of Aster Forest to the crashing tides of Isle of Poseidon—the world is yours to command. Every corner holds a secret. Scout for hidden treasures, delve into ancient caves to hunt Spirimon, or challenge the Spirimasters at Spirit Temple. In this boundless world, your journey has no limits!
Shatter the Chains: Master the Art of Limitless Combat

Experience a faithful recreation of the original Soul Land combat system, featuring non-targeted mechanics, precise dodges, aerial maneuvers, and fluid skill execution. Seamlessly switch between Spirits, customize your tactical loadouts, and exploit attribute advantages to suppress your foes. Transform every encounter into a masterclass of skill and strategy. Experience the true rush of high-octane battle and the unique charm of Spirimaster duels!
Hunt Unbound: Carve Your Legend as the Strongest Spirimaster

Warning! Spirimon spotted ahead! Prepare for an authentic hunting odyssey as you face off against formidable creatures in thrilling, high-stakes showdowns. Defeat these Spirimon to absorb Halos and Spiribones, unlocking a vast array of powers. Ascend to godhood with ease!
Supreme Quality: Immerse Yourself in a Flawless Anime Recreation

Experience the definitive Soul Land journey, authentically adapted from the original novels and animation. With breathtaking, high-fidelity visuals and a narrative faithful to the source, your "Road to Douluo" begins now. Relive the most iconic memories of Tang San and Xiao Wu, grow alongside them, and uncover brand-new chapters on your path to divinity.

Join us now and embark on an epic Soul Land adventure fueled by passion and glory!

data.name: Icy Arrow: Save the Family

In Icy Arrow: Save the Family, every level is a clever arrow puzzle where your path is defined by direction. Tap, follow, and navigate through a maze of arrows to reach the frozen family—but don’t expect it to be easy.

Break through icy barriers, master the arrow mechanics, and find your way through increasingly challenging escape puzzles. Every level is a new test of precision and strategy.

Can you solve every path and save them all?
Download now and experience the ultimate arrow puzzle escape! ❄️

data.name: Virtual Villagers 7
data.description_full:
Virtual Villagers 7 is a deep village simulation game where you guide a tribe, grow your village, explore Isola, and experience a real-time life simulator where villagers live even while you're away.

In Virtual Villagers 7, your tribe arrives in a mysterious new region of Isola after a devastating storm. Beneath the jungle canopy lies the forgotten valley of a lost civilization, filled with enormous machines, ancient inventions, and a powerful energy known as Spark.

Lead your villagers, rebuild your tribe, and experience a deep life simulation game where every villager has their own role in the survival of your village.

Grow your community, unlock inventions, explore the island, and uncover the secrets of Isola.

Build and Grow Your Village
Start with a small group of survivors and build a thriving community in this immersive village simulator. Gather resources, construct buildings, and help your villagers develop new skills to grow your tribe.

A Real-Time Life Simulation
Your villagers live their lives in real time, even when you're away. This unique life simulation game allows your tribe to work, learn, build families, and grow while you're offline.
Return to see how your village has evolved.

Discover Ancient Inventions
Harness the mysterious energy known as Spark to power incredible inventions left behind by a lost civilization. Activate ancient machines, solve puzzles, and restore balance to the island.

Explore the World of Isola
Travel across the island to uncover new lands and hidden secrets. Use new transportation to explore distant regions, sail the skies in an airship, cross deserts in a dune buggy, and descend into ancient mineshafts.

Encounter Rival Tribes
Meet the mysterious Dwellers, a corrupted tribe who guard the ancient machines. With the help of your guide Esplora, bring peace to the island and unite the tribes of Isola.

Face the Cogfather
A powerful leader known as The Cogfather stands between your tribe and the ancient machines needed to save the island. Outsmart rival factions and unlock powerful invention abilities to overcome him.

Solve Mysteries and Restore the Island
Clear toxic swamps, restore frozen glaciers, rebalance scorching deserts, and repair ancient machines that once powered the island.
Every discovery helps your tribe rebuild civilization.

If you love simulation games, village simulators, or life simulation games, you’ll love guiding your tribe in Virtual Villagers 7.
Download now and begin your next village adventure.

data.name: Pocket Horse: Racing Champions
data.description_full:
A horse game with heart, depth and legacy.

Design and raise your own horses, bond with them through care and training, and prove your skills across barrel racing, dressage, show jumping and more. Build a growing stable, breed adorable foals, shape bloodlines, and restore Oakmeer’s name as a champion horse region.

Oakmeer was once famous for its legendary Friesian horses and world-class riders. After facing a betrayal, the town’s dominance collapsed. Now, with a small ranch and your first horse, it’s up to you to prove Oakmeer still has champion potential.

DESIGN YOUR DREAM HORSE
Bring your very own dream horse to life combining coat patterns, face markings, mane and tail styles, even socks on individual legs! Make each horse unique and special to you.

RAISE, CARE & BOND
Horses have their own personalities, moods, and traits, and the way you care for them affects how they develop. Feed nutritious treats, prepare longer lasting feed mixes, groom, wash and play with them to keep them healthy and happy. A horse that feels loved and well looked after will perform better in races.

COMPETE IN FOUR RIDING DISCIPLINES
Put your training to the test in exciting skill-based events:
Barrel Racing
Dressage
Flat Racing
Show Jumping

Horse racing also tests the speed, stamina and training of your horse.
Each discipline rewards different strengths, so make sure you bring the right horse to the right equestrian event!

BREED FOALS AND BUILD STRONGER BLOODLINES
Breed adorable foals and discover inherited looks, stats, personality, and valuable breeding advantages passed down from their parents. Raise each foal from youth to adulthood, guide their development, and create future champions through smart breeding decisions.

BUILD A LEGACY ACROSS GENERATIONS
As your horses grow, they can develop learned traits that shape future generations, allowing you to build stronger, rarer, and more specialized horses over time.

EXPAND YOUR STABLE
Expand your ranch as you collect more horses and discover how they interact together. Unlock new championships, trophies, traits and horses as you play.

A HORSE GAME WITH REAL DEPTH
Whether you love horse care, stable management, breeding strategy, competition, or are just a lover of virtual pet or animal games, you will want to keep this horse game in your pocket. In Pocket Horse, every horse matters and every decision shapes your future.

Your horse. Your stable. Your legacy.

data.name: Conquian: Classic Card Game
data.description_full:
Conquian is a card game played with a 40-card deck, where the goal is to form melds (sets or runs) of cards. Its name derives from the Spanish phrase "con quién," meaning "with whom," reflecting its interactive and competitive nature. Over the centuries, Conquian has evolved into various forms, including the popular Rummy games we know today.

Step into the world of Conquian, the legendary ancestor of modern Rummy games! Originating in 17th-century Mexico, this traditional card game combines strategic depth with simple rules, making it a timeless favorite across generations.

Key Features:
🌟 Historical Roots: As the precursor to Rummy, Conquian preserves the essence of classic card gameplay while offering a unique cultural experience rooted in Mexican heritage.
🎓 Easy to Learn, Hard to Master: New players can grasp the basics in minutes with our intuitive tutorial. Perfect for quick matches or extended sessions!
🎨 Elegant Visual Design: Enjoy a clean, minimalist interface with vibrant card illustrations and smooth animations, ensuring a visually pleasing and distraction-free experience.
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 All-Ages Fun: Whether you’re a seasoned card enthusiast or a casual player, Conquian’s balanced mechanics appeal to men, women, and children alike. Gather the family for a round of strategic fun!
🌍 Global Popularity: From its origins in Mexico to its spread across Latin America and beyond, Conquian has captivated players worldwide. Known as Cooncan in the Southern United States and Coon Can in other regions, this game has adapted to local cultures while retaining its core charm.

📲 Download now and rediscover the charm of a game that has stood the test of time!
data.description_short: Enjoy Conquian, the classic Mexican card game of skill and luck!

data.name: Make It 10: Solitaire Puzzle
data.description_full:
Welcome to Make It 10: Solitaire Puzzle, where the timeless charm of Solitaire meets a fresh number puzzle twist!

Make It 10 is a free card game that combines classic solitaire flow with clever puzzle mechanics. Match two open cards that add up to 10, clear the board, and use strategy to complete each level.

The rules are simple, but the challenge is deeply satisfying: if two cards total 10, they can be matched and removed. Face cards add an extra layer of strategy — J, Q, and K can only be matched with their own kind. Plan carefully, reveal hidden cards, and make every move count.

Easy to learn but hard to master, Make It 10 offers a rewarding mix of logic, math, and solitaire-style progression. Whether you want a relaxing puzzle session or a real brain challenge, each level brings a new opportunity to test your strategy.

Play through a wide range of beautifully designed layouts, from Pyramid and Flower to Snake and more. With limited moves, changing board setups, and helpful boosters, every level feels fresh and engaging.

HOW TO PLAY:
● Clear the Board: Remove all cards to complete the level.
● Match Cards: Drag one open card onto another. If their values add up to 10, both cards disappear.
● Use the Stock & Bench: Out of moves on the board? Draw from the Stock pile and use the Bench slots wisely to create new matches.
● Plan Ahead: Every level has a limited number of moves, so smart decisions are the key to victory.

GAME FEATURES:
● Match card pairs that add up to 10
● Match J, Q, and K cards with their own kind
● Explore hundreds of unique levels and creative board layouts
● Enjoy a satisfying blend of solitaire, puzzle, card, and logic gameplay
● Reveal hidden cards and discover new strategies with every move
● Use powerful boosters like Hint and Joker when you need help
● Earn Perfect Match bonuses for extra move rewards
● Play relaxing levels or take on harder challenges with limited bench slots
● Smooth controls and elegant visuals for a clean, enjoyable experience
● Easy to play, challenging to master
● Play offline anytime, anywhere
● Compete with players around the world on the leaderboards
● Automatically save your progress and continue anytime

If you love solitaire, puzzle, card, match, math, brain, logic, classic, zen, and number games, Make It 10 is your next addictive challenge.
Download now and see if you can clear every board!

data.description_full:
🧪 Get Color Pack: Sort Puzzle - A Fresh Take on Color Sorting Puzzles! 🧪
Dive into a deeply soothing and incredibly satisfying puzzle game where logic meets fluid mechanics. Your objective is crystal clear:
meticulously separate vibrant, mixed liquids so that each beautiful glass bottle contains only one unified color. With every single level you
conquer, the challenge deepens - and so does the immense satisfaction of getting that final pour just right. If you love brain teasers, color
matching, and relaxing offline games, you have found your next puzzle addiction!
💧 Simple Concept, Smart Challenges
You’re presented with an array of beautifully crafted bottles filled with chaotic, layered colors. To solve this mesmerizing water sort puzzle,
you must carefully pour liquid between the bottles, adhering to strict color-matching rules:
• Pour liquid only onto the exact same color, or into a completely empty bottle.
• Stack identical colors together until the tube is full.
• Use your available empty space strategically to maneuver trapped liquids.
• Complete the level by achieving perfectly sorted, single-color bottles.
As you progress, new layers, hidden colors, and tighter layouts appear, meaning every single decision counts.

🧠 Strategy Over Speed
Forget stressful countdowns! There’s absolutely no timer in this game - just you, your mind, and the puzzle. Take a deep breath and think
carefully before each pour. Because you are given a limited number of empty bottles, you cannot simply move colors around endlessly. To
become a master sorter, you’ll need to:
• Anticipate your future moves and visualize the flow of the puzzle.
• Uncover and free trapped colors at the bottom of the tubes.
• Prevent frustrating dead ends by planning your bottle usage.
• Reorganize efficiently with minimal space to keep your board clean.
It’s a magnificent game of foresight, clever rearranging, and cognitive training that will keep your brain sharp.
🎧 Designed to Unwind (ASMR Experience)
Step into a world of ultimate relaxation. Enjoy stunning, fluid animations and beautifully rendered, vibrant colors that make every successful

retreat after a long day.

data.name: 오늘도 환생 2 : 방치형 디펜스 RPG
data.description_full:
방치형 RPG × 영웅 키우기 × 성 디펜스!
3천만 글로벌 유저가 사랑한 《오늘도 환생》의 정식 속편, 《오늘도 환생 2》가 돌아왔습니다.

끝없이 몰려오는 웨이브를 막고, 영웅을 소환하고, 환생을 통해 훈장을 모아 더 강해지세요.
방치만 해도 성장하고, 환생할수록 강해지는 정통 방치게임!
세계의 마지막 요새 ‘발키온’을 지키기 위한 새로운 모험이 시작됩니다.

▣ 게임 특징 ▣

■ 방치만 해도 성장하는 키우기 RPG
게임을 계속 조작하지 않아도 영웅은 성장합니다.
출근길, 업무 중, 잠자는 동안에도 자동 전투로 골드와 보상을 획득하세요.
바쁜 일상 속에서도 부담 없이 즐길 수 있는 정통 방치형 RPG입니다.

■ 끝없이 이어지는 웨이브와 성 디펜스
심연의 군단이 끝없는 웨이브로 몰려옵니다.
영웅을 배치하고, 스킬을 활용하고, 성을 강화하여 적의 공격을 막아내세요.
단순한 자동 전투를 넘어, 영웅 배치와 성장 전략이 중요한 디펜스 RPG의 재미를 느낄 수 있습니다.

■ 환생과 훈장으로 무한 성장
강한 적에게 막혔다면 환생하세요!
환생을 통해 획득한 훈장으로 영웅과 성을 영구적으로 강화할 수 있습니다.
환생을 반복할수록 더 높은 웨이브에 도전할 수 있으며, 당신의 기사단은 점점 더 강력해집니다.
방치형 RPG의 핵심 재미인 무한 성장을 제대로 경험해보세요.

■ 다양한 영웅 소환과 수집
인간, 엘프, 언데드, 오크 — 네 종족의 영웅들이 당신의 소환을 기다립니다.
각 영웅은 고유한 능력과 스킬을 가지고 있으며, 조합에 따라 전투 스타일이 달라집니다.
영웅 소환, 캐릭터 수집, 전략 배치를 통해 나만의 최강 기사단을 완성하세요.

■ 성을 키우고 전장을 지배하세요
성은 전장의 중심이자 마지막 방어선입니다.
성의 내구도, 공격력, 공격 속도, 사거리 등을 강화하여 더 오래 버티고 더 강하게 반격하세요.
영웅 키우기와 성 키우기가 함께 어우러진 새로운 방치형 디펜스 게임입니다.

■ 승리를 돕는 비술과 유물
종족별 비술로 전투를 더욱 빠르고 강력하게 진행하세요.
퀘스트 자동 완료, 웨이브 스킵, 스킬 쿨타임 감소, 웨이브 당기기 등 다양한 효과가 성장 속도를 높여줍니다.
던전에서 획득한 재료로 유물을 강화하면 기사단의 능력을 더욱 극대화할 수 있습니다.

■ 지루할 틈 없는 다양한 콘텐츠
강력한 보스가 기다리는 던전!
시즌제로 운영되는 무한 랭킹전!
매일 새로운 기록에 도전하는 일일 랭킹전!
전 세계 유저들과 경쟁하며 더 높은 순위와 보상을 노려보세요.

■ 바쁜 유저를 위한 편의 시스템
자동 전투, 배속 시스템, 일괄 레벨업, 웨이브 당기기 등 빠른 성장을 돕는 기능을 제공합니다.
짧은 시간만 접속해도 성장의 재미를 느낄 수 있으며, 오래 플레이할수록 더욱 깊은 전략을 즐길 수 있습니다.

▣ 이런 분들께 추천합니다 ▣

- 《오늘도 환생》을 재미있게 즐기셨던 분
- 방치형 RPG, 방치게임, 키우기 게임을 좋아하는 분
- 영웅 소환과 캐릭터 수집형 RPG를 좋아하는 분
- 디펜스, 성 지키기, 웨이브 전투를 좋아하는 분
- 자동 전투와 오토 플레이로 가볍게 즐길 게임을 찾는 분
- 무과금, 소과금으로도 꾸준히 성장하는 게임을 원하는 분
- 짧게 접속해도 보람 있는 성장형 RPG를 찾는 분

▣ 왜 《오늘도 환생 2》인가? ▣

- 3천만 글로벌 유저가 사랑한 원작의 정식 속편
- 10년 이상 축적된 방치형 RPG 개발 노하우
- 환생, 훈장, 무한 성장의 깊이 있는 성장 구조
- 영웅 키우기와 성 디펜스를 결합한 전략적 재미
- 자동 전투와 편의 시스템으로 누구나 쉽게 플레이 가능
- 원작 팬과 신규 유저 모두 즐길 수 있는 정통 방치형 RPG

잠든 영웅들을 깨우고, 세계의 봉인을 지켜내세요.
끝없는 웨이브, 강력한 영웅, 무한한 환생 성장!

data.name: Pixel Blast - Color Shooter
data.description_full:
Pixel Blast is a colorful, mesmerizing action-puzzle matching game where strategy meets one-tap simplicity. Match colorful marble shooters to their pixel cubes, manage a dynamic conveyor belt, and clear the board with satisfying precision. Quick to play, hard to put down—it's a short-break relaxer for killing free time and a fun way to train your mind, delivering challenging, colorful, flowing happy moments.

How to play: Conveyor loaded, shooters locked in. Tap to launch a shooter onto the belt—it’ll rain balls onto pixel cubes of the same color. The number above its head is its ammo count: that’s how many strikes it can land. Empty the ammo and the shooter exits; otherwise, it slides into 1 of 5 standby slots, ready to hop back on the conveyor with another tap for a fresh round.

Highlights

One‑tap gameplay: Quick rounds, easy one‑handed play.

Auto‑color match: Shooters only strike their own color—no aiming needed.

Conveyor limits: Timing and queue control add a snack‑sized strategy bite.

Ammo‑based shooter system: 5 conveyor capacity limits.

Quick‑session design: No manual targeting, light strategy layer.

Perfect cleanup system: Satisfying pixel clean‑up and a captivating loop flow.

“Just one more run” vibe: Ideal for micro‑breaks.

Remember that the conveyor has limited space—exceed the limit and you’ll have to wait. Deploy shooters in the right sequence, manage their flow, and blast cubes to clear the board step by step. Clean mechanics, a captivating loop: tap → stream → repeat.

For fans of fast action‑puzzles, timing, and flow‑management games.
data.description_short: Pixel Block Blast Flow Game

• Chassis & Frames — Affect weight, structure, and durability during hard landings.
• Wheels & Engines — Improve acceleration, speed, and control on the track.
• Rocket Boosters — Add powerful mid-air thrust to help you fly over gaps, obstacles, and difficult terrain.

• Physics-Based Launching: Build, launch, boost, crash, and upgrade in a fun arcade car adventure where every run feels different.

data.name: Patch Panic: Merge Harvest
data.description_full:
Welcome to a fresh and challenging vegetable-themed puzzle game set on your dining table!

This game uses classic match-3 mechanics: match three identical vegetable blocks to clear them from the board. But there’s a twist — the blocks are stacked in multiple overlapping layers, and only the topmost visible blocks can be matched and removed. Carefully plan and clear upper layers to reveal and access the blocks underneath.

You must also manage a limited number of placeholders at the bottom of the screen where matched blocks are placed before clearance. If these placeholders fill up before you can clear the blocks, the game ends. This combination of layered blocks and finite placeholders creates a thrilling challenge that exercises both your strategic thinking and quick decision-making skills.

Dive into this addictive puzzle, match crunchy carrots, leafy greens, and more to clear levels and unlock surprises.

data.name: Mesozoic Dawn
data.description_full:
The Miracle of Life Begins Here

In MESOZOIC DAWN, you don't just play a multiplayer dinosaur survival game—離ou live an evolutionary journey spanning hundreds of millions of years. Start as a vulnerable juvenile, then forage, stalk, and grow in a perilous prehistoric wild. Breakthrough your genetic limits via the core "Egg Evolution" system to claim your place at the top of the food chain!

---

✨ Core Features

🦖 A Massive Ecosystem
A unique Low Poly style brings over 70+ prehistoric species to life across sea, land, and air. Every creature possesses its own distinct survival instincts.

🧬 Unique Evolution System
Forget tedious XP bars. Progress through "Growth + Nesting = Evolution." Consume nutrient-rich food and breed to unlock more powerful prehistoric apex predators.

🫀 Hardcore Survival Mechanics
Stomach, lungs, and heart are interconnected. Hunger, stress, or injury directly damage organs and lower efficiency. Temperature, humidity, oxygen, and energy create a strict survival web where every choice matters.

⚔️ Strategic Combat
Featuring skill buffs, penetration, resilience, and a Locational Damage System. Striking different body parts yields unique damage multipliers and defensive returns. True Damage bypasses armor to deplete health and inflict trauma—high trauma will leave even fully armored players in despair by blocking heart health recovery.

🐣 Nesting and Breeding
• Diverse Paths: Choose parthenogenesis or find a mate. Temperature determines the offspring's gender; males naturally possess size and combat advantages.
• Build Your Nest: Gather stone and wood to build a nest that serves as your safe haven and respawn point. Defend it, as hostile players can destroy it.
• 🆕 Enhanced Brooding: Manually brooding eggs doubles hatching speed and stacks across generations to secure the strongest bloodline.

🧬 Genetic Inheritance
Offspring inherit traits from parents, with stats randomly breaking through limits. Shape a unique, peak bloodline through generations and selective brooding bonuses.

🤖 🆕 AI Companion & Offspring System
• Tame Wild Mates: Interact with opposite-sex wild dinosaurs of your species to build favorability and tame them as your exclusive AI mate.
• AI Offspring Management: Hatch eggs into AI offspring that follow your commands as loyal combat followers and territory guardians.
• Combat Commands: Issue orders like Follow, Attack Target, Standby, Defend, Protect, and Evade. AI companions assess threats and execute tactics independently.

🤖 Dynamic AI Herds
Encounter neutral and hostile AI herds with distinct behaviors. During special seasons, witness epic, massive migrations—a thrilling spectacle that brings both extreme danger and unmatched opportunity.

🌡️ Dynamic Climate Zones
The world is divided into distinct climate zones. Different species require specific temperature and humidity levels. Finding your ideal zone ensures survival and accelerates growth.

🌐 Online Multiplayer
Hunt with allies or clash with rival player clans over territory, water, and food. Full community server support lets you forge your own prehistoric world.

---

data.name: My Fairy Garden

“My Fairy Garden” — การเดินทางที่อบอุ่นใจที่ผสมผสานการจัดการสวนเกษตร ศิลปะการจัดดอกไม้และการมีภูตน้อยเป็นเพื่อนคู่ใจ ทุกเมล็ดพันธุ์ที่นี่ล้วนซ่อนเรื่องราว ทุกการพบกันล้วนอบอวนไปด้วยความอบอุ่น

[สร้างบ้านในฝัน จากเมล็ดพันธุ์สู่ดอกไม้บาน]
เริ่มจากพื้นที่เล็กๆ ในการทำสวน ถางที่ดิน หว่านเมล็ด รดน้ำ ใส่ใจดูแลพืชแต่ละต้นอย่างดี ค่อยๆ ขยายสวนของคุณออกไป ออกแบบทางเดินคดเคี้ยว ทิวทัศน์ลดหลั่น สร้างดินแดนวิเศษในป่าที่ดอกไม้เบ่งบานตลอดทั้งสี่ฤดูด้วยมือของคุณเอง

[รวบรวมเมล็ดพันธุ์ดอกไม้พิเศษ สร้างของขวัญศิลปะจากดอกไม้]
สำรวจและรวบรวมดอกไม้หลากหลายชนิดที่เป็นเอกลักษณ์ ปลดล็อกคอลเลกชันสมบูรณ์ ปลดปล่อยความคิดสร้างสรรค์ทางศิลปะของคุณ ผสมผสานดอกไม้ที่เก็บเกี่ยวได้อย่างอิสระ ออกแบบเป็นช่อดอกไม้ แจกันดอกไม้ และของตกแต่งจากดอกไม้งามๆ หลากหลายแบบ เปลี่ยนของขวัญจากป่าเป็นของขวัญที่เก็บรักษาได้

[พบกับภูตน้อยน่ารัก สร้างความผูกพันอันอบอุ่น]
ในป่าอาศัยอยู่ด้วยเพื่อนคู่ใจภูตน้อยผู้บริสุทธิ์ร่าเริงมากมาย ตามหาและชวนพวกเขามาที่บ้านของคุณ พวกเขาไม่เพียงช่วยดูแลพืชผลเท่านั้น ภูตแต่ละตัวยังมีบุคลิกและเรื่องราวเฉพาะตัว รอให้คุณใช้ความอบอุ่นและการดูแลเพื่อปลดล็อก

[ตกแต่งพื้นที่ส่วนตัว กำหนดสไตล์ที่เปลี่ยนแปลงได้ร้อยแบบ]
มีเสื้อผ้าและเฟอร์นิเจอร์มากมายให้คุณเลือกผสมผสาน! จากเสื้อคลุมทำสวนสดชื่นสู่ชุดป่าสวยหรู จากของตกแต่งภายในอบอุ่นสู่ชิ้นส่วนลานบ้านโดดเด่น กำหนดรูปลักษณ์ส่วนตัวและสไตล์บ้านได้อย่างอิสระ แสดงรสนิยมที่ไม่ซ้ำใคร

[แบ่งปันเวลาอันเงียบสงบ สนุกกับสังคมแห่งการช่วยเหลือ]
เยี่ยมเยือนบ้านในป่าของเพื่อน ช่วยกันดูแลพืชผล แลกเปลี่ยนแรงบันดาลใจในการตกแต่ง หรือร่วมกันทำภารกิจพิเศษ แบ่งปันความสุขจากการเก็บเกี่ยวในการโต้ตอบที่เบิกบานและผ่อนคลาย ทำให้การเดินทางไม่เหงาอีกต่อไป

ผืนป่าที่ทอผสานด้วยความฝัน ดอกไม้และความอบอุ่นนี้ กำลังรอเจ้าของของมันอยู่เงียบๆ เริ่มต้นการเดินทางของคุณตอนนี้ หว่านเมล็ดพันธุ์แรกของคุณ พบกับเพื่อนภูตตัวแรก สานเทพนิยายอันอบอุ่นที่เป็นของคุณเองด้วยมือของคุณเลย! มาเลย!

data.name: Theme Association: Sort Puzzle
data.description_full:
Theme Association: Sort Puzzle is a relaxing puzzle game that challenges your brain to recognize patterns, discover connections, and organize objects into meaningful groups.

In every level, you are presented with a collection of items that belong to different categories. Your goal is to study each object carefully and place it with others that share the same category. Some puzzles are simple, while others require deeper thinking to identify the correct relationships.

Unlike traditional sorting games that focus only on colors or shapes, Theme Association encourages players to think conceptually. The challenge comes from recognizing how objects relate to one another and understanding the category they belong to.

This unique puzzle mechanic turns each level into a small logic challenge. You must analyze the objects, eliminate incorrect matches, and gradually organize everything into clear categories.

The gameplay is designed to be relaxing and enjoyable for players of all skill levels. Simple controls allow you to move objects easily, while the gradually increasing puzzle complexity keeps the game engaging.

As you progress, new puzzles introduce more objects, more categories, and more interesting combinations. This keeps the experience fresh while providing a steady sense of improvement and mastery.

One of the most satisfying aspects of Theme Association is the moment when a puzzle finally becomes clear. What first appears as a random collection of items slowly reveals its hidden structure as you begin to organize everything correctly.

The clean visual design helps players focus on the puzzle itself. Bright icons, simple layouts, and smooth interactions make every level easy to understand and enjoyable to solve.

Theme Association is perfect for players who enjoy brain training games, relaxing puzzles, and thoughtful challenges that reward observation and logical thinking.

Whether you want to exercise your mind for a few minutes or relax with a longer puzzle session, Theme Association offers a calm and satisfying experience.

Key Features of Theme Association: Sort Puzzle

• Category based puzzle gameplay
• Discover connections between objects
• Organize items into logical categories
• Relaxing brain puzzles with no time limits
• Simple controls and clear visuals
• Increasing challenge across many levels
• Perfect for casual puzzle players
• Designed for relaxing and thoughtful gameplay

Train your brain, sharpen your observation skills, and enjoy the satisfaction of solving clever puzzles.

Download Theme Association: Sort Puzzle and experience a new kind of relaxing logic puzzle.

data.name: Muse Gallery
data.description_full:
Muse Gallery
A casual puzzle game that combines stacked match-3 gameplay with a progressive story video unlock mechanism. By clearing levels, you can gradually unlock exclusive story content for multiple muses with different styles. While enjoying a relaxed puzzle-solving experience, you will gain a clear sense of in-game progression and long-term motivation to play.
Classic Stacked Match-3 Gameplay
The game centers on the popular stacked tile match-3 mechanism. In each level, tiles are stacked in multiple layers on the screen, and you need to carefully select and collect three identical tiles to clear them. As you progress through the levels, the tile layouts become more complex, requiring sharper observation, more thorough planning, and more prudent decision-making.
Each level is designed to be both easy to pick up and progressively challenging. The key to clearing levels lies not only in speed but also in understanding the tile structure and planning each move in advance.
Practical Boosters for Strategic Level-Clearing
To help you overcome difficult levels, Muse Gallery offers three practical boosters:
Undo: Undo your last move and correct critical mistakes
Remove: Directly eliminate selected tiles to open up new matching paths
Shuffle: Rearrange the remaining tiles to discover new matching solutions
Using boosters at the right time can greatly increase your chances of clearing levels, allowing you to successfully overcome difficulties without feeling frustrated.
Muse Characters and Story Unlock Mechanism
The game features dozens of unique muses, each with a series of story videos that can be unlocked in sequence. The progression system is designed to be both rewarding and well-paced:
Reach specified level milestones to unlock early story videos for free.
Watch a short video ad to unlock the final exclusive reward story videos.
New muses can only be unlocked after reaching a certain level of progress.
This layered unlock mechanism ensures that every level you complete brings you closer to new content and valuable rewards.
Progressive Level Difficulty
The difficulty of the levels increases steadily, making it suitable for both casual players and those who are keen on strategic puzzle challenges. Even if you fail a level, you can retry with adjusted strategies or optimize the use of boosters, maintaining the fun of the game throughout without severe penalties.
Special Mechanisms for Long-Term Gameplay
In addition to the core gameplay, Muse Gallery also includes a variety of mechanisms to support long-term gameplay:
Daily Check-In Rewards: Encourage players to log in daily with stable benefits.
Achievement Goals: Record every step of your growth and milestone moments.
These mechanisms provide continuous reward feedback and maintain your motivation to play in the long run.
Who Is This Game For?
Muse Gallery is especially suitable for players who:
Love match-3, tile-matching, and various puzzle games
Enjoy games with clear progression and unlockable reward mechanisms
Prefer casual games with a free rhythm that can be played on demand
By combining relaxed puzzle-solving gameplay with structured story unlock content, Muse Gallery creates a balanced gaming experience—easy to pick up, yet worth investing in for the long term. Clear levels, unlock new muse stories, and embark on a pleasant exploration journey through progressively challenging puzzles.

Enjoy real-time chat during your Mancala games. Talk to friends in private matches or interact with opponents while playing live.


📝 THE RULES OF MANCALA
Mancala (Kalaha) is a classic two-player strategy board game played on a board with twelve pockets and two stores. At the start of the game, each pocket contains four stones. Players take turns picking up all stones from one of their pockets and distributing them counter-clockwise, placing one stone in each pocket and their own store while skipping the opponent’s store.

If the last stone lands in your store, you earn an extra turn. If the last stone lands in an empty pocket on your side and the opposite pocket contains stones, you capture those stones and move them to your store. The game ends when one player has no stones left in their pockets or when a player concedes. The player with the most stones in their store wins.

Mancala is known around the world by many different names, including Congklak, Mangala, Sungka, Ô ăn quan, Congkak, Igisoro, Kalaha, Oware (Awale), Pallanguli, Dakon, Bao, Bohnenspiel and more.

data.name: 青丘世界：緣起
data.description_full:
下一次遇見，在青丘世界。
2026 年旗艦級 3D 仙俠大作《青丘世界：緣起》，以超高精度建模與動態光影系統，重構東方仙俠的浪漫與壯闊。
你將化身守令一脈的末代弟子，執掌殘缺的御妖令。朱雀精魄蠢動，上古封印將破——斬妖除魔之外，更要揭開塗山氏一族世代守護的禁忌真相。諸神不臨，仙妖對峙，你的每一次選擇，都將改寫這場劫數的終局。
踏入青丘，一草一木皆靈韻，一顰一笑盡風華，在仙霧縈繞的山海間，展開屬於你的緣起之旅。

【四大職業・各具其風采】
靈狐、劍仙、逐月、龍槍——四大職業各擁獨特的戰鬥美學。
每個宗門皆配備專屬技能與覺醒造型，並可自由搭配祕法絕技，讓你創造屬於自己的仙俠風骨。

【遇見青丘・尋覓大世界】
這是一個兼具絕美風景與溫暖人情的開放仙界。你將與好友一同御劍乘風、踏雲尋蹤，一步一景，處處驚鴻，在湖邊共許願，在秘境中探險。
告別單機式修仙，讓每一次相遇，都成為牽絆的開端。

【靈韻天成 · 一顏一世界】
高自由度捏臉系統，從眉眼輪廓、衣飾妝容皆由你親手定製。從清冷仙君到嬌萌靈狐，你所思念的模樣，從此躍然於指尖。
一顏一鏡，照見獨一無二的你。

【百妖通靈・掌馭由汝心】
遊戲內藏匿著形形色色的妖靈——或憨態可掬，或威風凜凜，各具性情。你將邂逅、馴化並與牠們共生，結下獨一無二的羈絆。
每一隻妖靈皆擁有獨立的養成與進化路線，你將攜同心愛的妖靈並肩作戰，縱橫仙魔戰場。

【霓裳玉羽・纖毫畢現之美】
極致畫質，為每一件時裝賦予靈魂。綢緞的流動、輕紗的透光、金屬的冷冽、羽翼的豐盈——材質細膩到每一縷絲線。
數千款時裝配件自由搭配，更支援百萬種自由染色，隨心搭配，告別撞衫。在青丘世界，你可以比世界更多彩。

【繁花為禮・情深到家】
遊戲內外，好禮相連。在預約活動頁參與「繁花大賽」活動，或與心上人在遊戲中結成情緣，即可額外獲得真實鮮花豪禮——百萬鮮花宅配到家，讓浪漫從虛實之間綻放於眼前。

※ 本軟體因涉及暴力、戀愛交友 、性（遊戲角色穿著凸顯性特徵之服飾），依遊戲軟體分級管理辦法分類為輔12級。
※ 本遊戲為免費使用，遊戲內另提供購買虛擬遊戲幣、物品等付費服務。
※ 長時間進行遊戲，請注意使用時間，避免沉迷於遊戲。

Welcome to the wonderful colorful world of Water Sort: Master Colors – a creative water sorting game that reinvents the classic bottle design! Here, timeless water sorting gameplay meets adorable, unique bottles, delivering a great mix of visual delight and brain-teasing fun!

Say goodbye to plain, ordinary glass bottles! In this game, you'll unlock a huge collection of uniquely shaped bottles: cute pigs, elegant peacocks, funny ducks, giant whales, sweet hearts, corns, festive pumpkins, Santa Clauses, fluffy bunnies, playful turkeys and so much more. From animals, fruits and plants to holiday themes, every bottle is a carefully crafted work of art that's both eye-catching and fun!

Enjoy the classic, addictive color sorting mechanics while exercising your logical thinking and admiring these charming bottles – every pour feels fresh and exciting. This isn't just water sorting; it's a creative bottle adventure! Enjoy a stunning visual experience that makes color sorting anything but boring. Every pour feels like interacting with cute characters, and every logical move brings something new!

The core gameplay revolves around precise color sorting and strategic planning: pour and separate the mixed colored liquids until each bottle holds only one pure color. Levels progress gradually, putting your spatial reasoning, foresight and systematic puzzle-solving skills to the test. From easy beginner stages to tricky brain teasers, both new and experienced players can enjoy immersive sorting fun with these unique bottles.

Game Features
🐷 Tons of creative, beautifully designed bottles!
💧 Classic water sorting gameplay – relaxing & brain-training!
🧠 Wide variety of challenging levels to boost logical thinking!
🎨 A feast for the eyes – every level is visually delightful!
🎮 Easy to learn, endlessly fun to play!
💖 Calming, stress-relieving experience to unwind your mind!
🌟 No time limits, no penalties – play at your own pace!

Come and try Water Sort: Master Colors – whether you're a casual player or a puzzle fan, you'll find tons of joy and a great sense of achievement in this cute, colorful adventure.

Ready to start your logic and color journey? Give your brain a break! Sort colors with lovely and unique bottles! Download Water Sort: Master Colors now and begin your creative bottle puzzle adventure. Dive into a world of vibrant colors and lovely bottles, outsmart every challenge, and enjoy colorful sorting fun with all your favorite bottles!
data.description_short: Water Sort: Master Colors is a sorting puzzle game with many creative bottles!

data.name: Arrows World

- Remove every arrow to clear the level!

- Thousands of handcrafted levels — each one a brand-new challenge!
- Progress from easy to mind-bending puzzles that test your planning skills.

Every level is a fresh logic test, and every victory provides that satisfying "click" of a perfectly executed plan. Whether you have 5 minutes or an hour, Arrows World is the perfect companion to keep your mind sharp and your soul calm.

🌟 Ready to take on the challenge?Download Arrows World now and start your arrow-pulling adventure! Use your logic to plan the perfect path, conquer thousands of levels, and complete every puzzle without a single collision!

data.name: Sky Build
data.description_full:
Feel the thrill with Sky Build and test your reaction speed! 🏗️⚡ Your task is to fill all three slots with the same symbol before time runs out.

The slots with three symbols quickly and cyclically change icons 🔄 Tap on a slot to lock the current symbol and tapping again will unlock it, but it will cost you 2 seconds ⏳ Plan your actions carefully, because every second counts.

Once all three slots are locked, the result is checked 🎯 If the symbols match, you win! If not, the slots will automatically unlock, giving you a chance to try again. For the daring, there is a “build” button 🚀 that locks all slots at once — a risky but sometimes very profitable move.

When the time runs out, the symbols are fixed where they stopped ⏱️ If they are the same, you win; if they are different, the game is over. Each level has a different time limit and the first stages are a little easier to start with. Sky Build is all about speed, strategy and excitement in every round!

data.name: Narco Empire
data.description_full:
Pull yourself up from the gutter and take control of the underground in Narco Empire. Step into a raw, cinematic underbelly of secret labs, risky shipments, and bloody turf clashes — every choice about trust, risk, and ambition pushes you from a nobody on the block to a leader people fear.

From corner deals to the throne
Begin with small trades and tough calls. Make allies, collect favors, and turn tiny wins into real standing. As your influence grows, neighborhoods fall under your control, and each decision opens new chances — and new dangers.

Run the underground supply
Hunt down scarce materials across contested blocks and hide workshops that slowly turn into full operations. Close-up, hands-on lab scenes let you sharpen your product and raise its value on the black market. Improve how you work, bring in trusted hands, and scale from cramped benches to full factories.

Plot dangerous smuggling runs
Plan routes, prepare convoys, and react fast when things break down. Send guarded loads through hostile zones, pick stealth or force, bribe contacts, or sabotage rival narco crews — and always watch for checkpoints. Each successful run opens new trade corridors and extends your reach.

Turn goods into clout
Use distribution to build power: run street deals, land big wholesale contracts, and launder dirty cash into a respectable front. Oversee retail chains, pressure or partner with rivals, and plant investments that keep your empire hidden from view.

Keep the crown — and survive
Power draws betrayal. One mistake can wipe everything out. Recruit loyal lieutenants, sharpen your enforcers, and flush out moles before they strike. Diplomacy, threats, and targeted strikes are all in your playbook — but loyalties can flip overnight. Will you rule from the shadows, or become just another name in a police file?

Disclaimer: This game is a work of fiction. All substances, events, and characters portrayed are fictional. Please play responsibly.

data.name: Going Balls
data.description_full:
Going Balls: The Ultimate Speed and Balance Challenge!

Are you ready for a high-speed runner game that tests your reflexes and mastery of physics? Download Going Balls today and experience the most thrilling arcade adventure on mobile! Join millions of players worldwide in this addictive hyper-casual hit.

What is Going Balls?

Going Balls is an exhilarating, fast-paced ball game where your main goal is to control a rolling ball and guide it safely to the finish line on increasingly difficult tracks. It’s the perfect blend of a precision puzzle game and a heart-pounding speed challenge.

How to Play:
Swipe your screen to control the speed and direction of your ball. Master the art of balance as you navigate narrow paths, dodge unexpected obstacles (challenge!), and collect coins to unlock new balls and environments.
The simple controls hide a deep, skill-based arcade experience!

Key Features: The Ultimate Rolling Adventure!

* Dozens of Challenging Levels: Race through diverse worlds, from sky-high platforms to treacherous industrial zones. Each level offers a unique challenge that will keep you coming back for more!
* Realistic Physics Engine: Feel the thrill of true physics-based gameplay. Every roll, jump, and acceleration feels incredibly smooth and responsive. Balance is key to surviving!
* Customize Your Ball: Collect thousands of coins and unlock a massive collection of cool, colorful, and unique balls. Personalize your runner experience!
* Intuitive One-Finger Control: The ultimate pick-up-and-play hyper-casual design. Simple to learn, but incredibly hard to master - perfect for quick bursts of fun or long endless sessions.
* Tons of Obstacles: Avoid swinging hammers, tricky ramps, massive wrecking balls, and unexpected gaps. Your speed and precision are your only allies!

Why You'll Love Going Balls!

Going Balls is more than just a runner - it's an immensely satisfying experience. The rush of barely making a jump, the joy of collecting a huge stack of coins, and the feeling of accomplishment after conquering a nearly impossible challenge makes this game highly addictive.

We’ve optimized the gameplay for pure fun!
* Instant Thrills: Short, intense levels make it ideal for quick breaks.
Skill Progression: You can feel yourself getting better at speed and balance with every attempt.
* High Replayability: The pursuit of the perfect, flawless run is endless!

data.name: Arrow Knot: Brain Puzzle Game
data.description_full:

Arrow Knot is a minimalist brain puzzle game where every level is a tangle of arrows waiting to be unraveled. Tap an arrow with a clear path and it slides off the board, unblocking lanes for the next move. Plan the sequence, keep every route open, and clear the whole grid to solve the puzzle.

Most puzzle games bury you in flashy effects and noise. Arrow Knot takes the opposite path: a clean grid, focused mechanics, and pure logic. Every level is a small tangle to unpick — a satisfying brain workout that fits into any moment of your day. If you love block puzzle games, tap away games, or unblock-style brain teasers, this arrow puzzle will feel instantly familiar.

— HOW TO PLAY —

Look at the grid. Each arrow points in one direction. Tap an arrow whose path to the edge is unobstructed — it slides off the board. That unblocks lanes for the remaining arrows. One wrong move can block everything, so plan the order carefully.

• Tap an arrow with a clear path to launch it off the grid
• Each removed arrow opens new routes for others
• Clear the entire board to complete the level
• Long-press for Guidance mode to preview available paths
• Use hints when the sequence gets tricky
• Wrong taps cost a heart — aim for perfect clears

Simple to learn. Deeply strategic to master.

— FEATURES —

Hundreds of Brain Puzzle Levels
Handcrafted arrow puzzles ranging from relaxing warm-ups to mind-bending tangles. New levels added regularly so the grid always has a fresh knot for you.

Timed Challenges
Race the clock through gorgeous themed pattern boards — every shape a puzzle you'll want to screenshot. Beat the timer to unlock the next design and climb the challenge ladder. Beautiful, tense, and endlessly replayable.

Clean & Focused Design
A distraction-free interface designed to reduce visual noise. Soft colors, smooth animations, and zero clutter let you focus entirely on the arrow puzzle in front of you.

Satisfying Tap-Away Feedback
Watch arrows whoosh off the board with responsive tap controls and clear path feedback. The final arrow leaving the grid delivers a deeply satisfying mental reset — like ASMR for puzzle solvers.

Guidance & Hints
Stuck on a knot? Long-press any arrow to preview its route, or spend a hint to reveal the next best move. No level is unsolvable.

Brain Training Benefits
Every session exercises spatial reasoning, sequential planning, and pattern recognition. Short bursts of arrow puzzle play sharpen focus and quiet a busy mind — cognitive fitness in bite-sized rounds.

— TWO WAYS TO PLAY —

Endless mode: solve at your own pace, no timer, pure logic puzzle flow.
Timed Challenges: race through beautiful themed pattern boards for a shot of adrenaline.

Pick the mood, pick the mode.

— PERFECT FOR THE IN-BETWEEN MOMENTS —

Ten minutes before a meeting. A short metro ride. Winding down after a busy day. Arrow Knot fits naturally into the gaps of your day without demanding a 30-minute commitment.

— WHO IS IT FOR —

Arrow Knot is built for thoughtful players who love logic puzzles, brain teasers, and pattern games. If you enjoy Sudoku, nonograms, block puzzle games, slide puzzles, or tap away puzzles, this brain puzzle game will feel like home.

— KEY HIGHLIGHTS —

• Arrow puzzle: tap arrows to unblock and slide them off the grid

data.name: Angler Fisher
data.description_full:
Angler Fisher is a fishing simulator.

Dynamic Drag System
Each fish has a unique behavior pattern: some make sharp jerks, others dive deep, and still others leap out of the water.
The weight, species, and individual "character" of each fish are taken into account.

Interactive Reel Drag
A mechanic unmatched in other games.
You adjust the drag tension in real time:
Too much tension—the line will break.
Too little—the fish will escape or get caught behind a snag.
The ideal setting ensures smooth reel operation with adjustable drag.

Graphics and Environment
Dynamic water system: water reacts to the weather, the current changes speed and direction, and waves affect the behavior of the lure.
Various locations: lakes with changing times of day and weather conditions.
A vibrant ecosystem: fish migrate depending on water temperature, time of day, and atmospheric pressure.

Economic System and Development
Market Economy: Caught fish can be...
Kept as a trophy for your collection.
Used as bait for larger catches.

Tackle Shop: With your earnings, you can purchase:
Rods of various classes (feeder and carp).
Reels with various characteristics.
Fishing lines, leaders, and hooks.
Bait and artificial lures.
Tackle Upgrades: Upgrade your gear to catch larger and rarer trophies.

Key Features of Angler Fisher
Realism: No simplified mini-games—just physics and skill.
Educational: The game teaches real-world fishing principles and tactics.

data.name: Fishing Freeze
data.description_full:
The lake is iced over, the air is still — and your next dive begins with a single tap. Press Cast, and the depth wheel chooses how far you’ll go, anywhere from 5m to 100m. The deeper it sends you, the more score points you can get.

Once you’re underwater, everything comes down to timing. Fish glide past your hook, and you need to tap at the exact moment a fish is close enough to set it. Get it right and “Hooked!” appears — now you have a catch to finish.

To bring the fish up, you face a fast 3-round swipe challenge. Each round shows a direction — swipe up, left, or right — and gives you 3 seconds to react. Clear all rounds without mistakes to catch the fish and claim your points. Swipe the wrong way or run out of time and you’ll see “Missed!” — no points, and you’re back on the shore ready to cast again.

Need a quick reminder? The Information screen keeps the rules short and clear. And Catch Guide works like a little depth notebook: each card shows a depth range, the points you can get there, and sample fish you might meet, so you always know what you’re aiming for before your next cast.

data.name: BLFFD
data.description_full:
BLFFD is the ultimate digital party game where your ability to lie is just as important as your knowledge. Designed for 2 to 20 players, this high-stakes trivia game challenges you to create the most believable fake answers to trick your friends while you try to hunt down the actual truth. Whether you are hosting a small game night or a massive online gathering, BLFFD delivers a seamless and competitive experience that keeps everyone on their toes.

The game flow is designed to be fast-paced and engaging. It begins in the Lobby, where the host can customize settings including language, total rounds, and categories. Once the game starts, the system shuffles the turn order and assigns a Chooser. This player selects a category, and our smart deprioritization algorithm picks a question that players in the room have seen the least, ensuring every round feels fresh and unpredictable.

During the Bluffing phase, everyone must submit a fake answer. To keep the game challenging and fair, BLFFD features a sophisticated cross-language blocking system. It checks your submission against the correct answer and its synonyms across all supported languages. If your bluff is too close to the truth, the game will prompt you to try again. This phase also introduces the Buff Bluff mechanic. Each player gets one chance per game to activate a Buff Bluff. If you successfully fool your friends while this is active, you earn double the points for every person you trick.

Once all bluffs are in, the Voting phase begins. All fake answers are mixed with the real one and shuffled. You must cast your vote for the answer you believe is correct, but you are strictly forbidden from voting for your own bluff. Scoring is simple but competitive: you get 2 points for finding the correct answer and 1 point for every player who falls for your bluff. If you use your Buff Bluff strategically, those points can stack up quickly and shift the leaderboard in an instant.

The Reveal phase is where the chaos happens. The host controls the pacing as the game unveils who submitted which bluff and who was fooled by them. At the end of the set number of rounds, the game checks for a winner. If there is a tie at the top of the leaderboard, BLFFD automatically triggers extra tie-breaker rounds until a single champion is crowned.

Technical reliability is at the core of the BLFFD experience. The game features robust reconnection logic, allowing players to jump back into their session if they lose their connection. It also includes ghost cleanup to remove inactive players during the lobby or end-game phases, and server time synchronization to ensure all timers are accurate for every participant.

Whether you are a master of deception or just looking for a laugh with friends, BLFFD offers a unique blend of trivia and social strategy. Download BLFFD today, set up your lobby, and see who among your friends is the ultimate bluffing champion.

data.name: Tile Hole Master
data.description_full:
Tile Hole Master is a structured tile puzzle where you control a moving hole to swallow tiles and clear the board. Each level presents a carefully arranged tile layout that requires precise movement, smart positioning, and strategic board clearing.
In Tile Hole Master, the goal is simple: move the hole across the board and collect all tiles. However, each tile puzzle introduces different formations, stacked tile clusters, compact tile grids, and layered tile layouts that change how you approach the board. You must plan your path to avoid blocking future movement while clearing every tile.
Core Tile Hole Gameplay
• Drag to move the hole freely across the board
• Swallow tiles by positioning the hole correctly
• Clear all tiles to complete the level
• Avoid bombs and blocked zones
• Use boosters to manage dense tile formations
• Progress through increasingly structured tile boards
The tile hole mechanic focuses on movement precision and spatial awareness. Because tiles are arranged in structured formations, clearing one area too quickly may limit access to other tile groups. Careful path planning becomes essential as tile layouts grow more complex.

Tile Puzzle Design
Tile Hole Master is built around tile collection and board clearing strategy. Each tile puzzle level introduces different board shapes and tile arrangements. Some boards feature compact tile stacks. Others include layered tile blocks that require gradual clearing.
The puzzle design emphasizes tile grouping and tile flow. Understanding how tiles connect and how the hole moves across the surface is key to solving each stage. Tile collect strategy becomes more important as levels increase in density and obstacle placement.

Themed Tile Collections
Throughout progression, the tile visuals evolve into themed tile worlds while maintaining the same tile hole mechanic. The themes change the appearance of the tiles but preserve the structured tile puzzle gameplay.
Each theme introduces a fresh tile environment while keeping the tile collect and board clear objective consistent. The themed tiles create visual variety without changing the core hole puzzle structure.

Mahjong-Style Tile Layouts
Some levels feature mahjong-style tile layouts, inspired by structured tile stacks and patterned tile formations. These mahjong-style tile boards focus on arrangement awareness and board clearing order.
While Tile Hole Master is not a traditional mahjong match game, the visual tile structures may resemble mahjong tile stacks. The gameplay remains centered on moving the hole, swallowing tiles, and clearing the board.
Obstacles and Boosters: As tile boards become denser, additional elements appear:
Boosters help manage complex tile formations by supporting tile clearing in crowded areas. Strategic use of boosters can assist in finishing structured tile layouts.

Strategic Board Clearing
Tile Hole Master focuses on:
• Tile movement strategy
• Board awareness
• Spatial puzzle solving
• Tile grouping efficiency
• Structured board clearing
Each tile hole puzzle requires analyzing the tile layout before making large movements. Efficient tile collection prevents the hole from getting trapped by remaining tile blocks.

3D Tile Interaction
The 3D environment enhances tile depth and tile stacking visibility. You move the hole around elevated tile blocks, dense tile clusters, and layered tile formations. This adds dimension to the tile puzzle experience while preserving the core tile collect mechanic.

Tile Hole Master combines:
tile hole gameplay, tile puzzle structure, tile collect strategy, 3D tile boards, mahjong-style layouts, and evolving tile themes.
Every level centers on tile clearing, controlled movement, and structured puzzle design. Progress through themed tile worlds, refine your tile strategy, and clear each board by mastering the tile hole mechanic.

data.name: Yarnation: Unravel Flow
data.description_full:
Unravel the Threads. Complete the Pattern. Feel the Flow.

Yarnation: Unravel Flow is a relaxing yet deeply engaging sorting puzzle game where you unravel beautifully knitted artwork using colorful yarn bobbins. Instead of blasting or matching tiles, you carefully remove stitches in the correct order to clear each woven design piece by piece.

Every level feels like solving a handcrafted knitting puzzle.
Every move shapes the flow.
Every unravel delivers a satisfying visual payoff.

If you enjoy cozy puzzle games, color sorting challenges, flow puzzles, and calm strategy-based gameplay, Yarnation: Unravel Flow offers a smooth and rewarding experience that keeps your mind active while staying relaxing.

🧶 A UNIQUE YARN PUZZLE EXPERIENCE

Bobbins move along a conveyor system and collect stitches of their own color.
Each bobbin has a limited capacity that decreases as it gathers matching yarn stitches.

When a bobbin’s capacity reaches zero, it disappears.
If capacity remains, it returns to the rack, ready to be reused later.

This simple yet clever system creates a satisfying puzzle loop where:

• Color selection matters
• Order matters
• Planning matters
• Capacity management matters

Complete each knitted pattern by using the right bobbins in the right sequence.

🧠 STRATEGY OVER SPEED

Yarnation: Unravel Flow is not about frantic tapping.
It’s about smart decisions and smooth sequencing.

As you advance through the levels:

• Patterns become more layered and detailed
• Colors overlap and intertwine
• Rack space becomes limited
• Managing your moves becomes more important

You’ll need to analyze the layout carefully, think a few steps ahead, and maintain a clean unravel flow without blocking yourself.

It’s a logic puzzle at heart — calm, thoughtful, and deeply satisfying.

🎨 COZY KNITTED AESTHETIC

Immerse yourself in a warm and visually charming yarn world featuring:

• Soft knitted textures
• Handcrafted pixel-style artwork
• Clean and colorful stitch patterns
• Smooth unravel animations
• Clear visual feedback

Watching a detailed knitted image slowly unravel into completion creates a uniquely relaxing puzzle experience.

🔁 PROGRESSIVE PUZZLE DEPTH

With hundreds of handcrafted levels, Yarnation: Unravel Flow introduces new challenges throughout progression:

• Fresh stitch arrangements
• New color combinations
• Deeper sequencing logic
• Smarter rack usage

The difficulty curve remains smooth and accessible while offering enough depth to keep puzzle lovers engaged.

🎮 SIMPLE CONTROLS, DEEP GAMEPLAY

The one-tap control system keeps the experience intuitive and easy to learn.

But beneath that simplicity lies a strategy puzzle built around:

• Color sorting
• Flow management
• Capacity control
• Smart sequencing

Easy to start.
Satisfying to master.

READY TO UNRAVEL?

Pull the right thread.
Plan your sequence.
Complete every knitted pattern with precision.

Yarnation: Unravel Flow is a fresh take on sorting puzzles — calm, strategic, visually satisfying, and beautifully woven.

data.name: Imposter Game: Who is the Spy?
data.description_full:
Listen closely and decide together - WHO IS THE IMPOSTER?

The Imposter game is built around one simple mechanic: most players know the secret word, and one does not. In every round of this imposter party word game, each person gives an association. One player must fake it and try to blend in.

The group talks, debates, and tries to find the impostor before it’s too late. Someone may confidently guess the imposter, while others wait and analyze who is the spy.


HOW TO PLAY
- See the word — or fake it if you didn’t.
- Give a clue.
- Discuss who is suspicious.
- Vote to find the impostor.

This imposter party word game is a hidden liar game, where subtle lying and careful listening decide the outcome. Players constantly try to find out who is lying, then they may challenge each other to explain their hints. When the discussion peaks, everyone will vote to guess the imposter.
In every imposter game, you must observe reactions and help the group find the impostor. Sometimes you immediately know who is the imposter; other times you hesitate, wondering who is lying while someone tries to fake it again!


Social deduction made simple: read people, think fast, and have fun!
Inspired by familiar unmask the spy game formats, this gameplay focuses on conversation and deduction—read behavior, control the situation and find who is the spy, or stay undercover and don't reveal yourself while guessing!

Listen carefully, analyze hints, and unmask the secret role. Each round challenges you to uncover the truth, even when someone stays completely under cover. Soon the room fills with questions: who imposter was acting strange? Who is lying about their clue? And finally — Who is the imposter?

PERFECT FOR GROUPS
It’s a simple game to play with friends! This flexible party game belongs in every collection of fun games to play with friends—it works as a quick group game during gatherings, trips or night parties. It fits naturally, it's easy to start, and matches other classic fun party games.
You can launch an imposter game anywhere and begin an imposter party word game session in seconds. Whether you’re hosting a casual party game night or organizing spontaneous fun games to play with friends, the format keeps everyone involved.

Play again and fake it better. Listen closer. And find the impostor! In every imposter game, someone must stay undercover, others will guess the imposter, and then must decide who is the spy.

data.name: Evil Doll: Chapter Two
data.description_full:
You wake up inside a dark house. Something is already moving.
Evil Doll 2 is a first-person survival horror escape game. You're trapped inside a massive haunted house, and Evil Doll is hunting you. He hears every sound you make. Every footstep. Every item you drop. Stay quiet, stay hidden, and find a way out — before he finds you first.
If you survived Granny, if you escaped Evil Nun, you think you're ready. You're not.

THE HOUSE
This is not the same place you escaped before. Evil Doll 2 takes place in a larger, multi-floor horror house filled with locked rooms, hidden passages, dark basements, and secrets buried deep inside the walls. Every room you enter could be a trap. Every door you open makes a sound. Explore carefully — rushing will get you killed.

THE ENEMY
Evil Doll is smarter this time. He doesn't just patrol. He listens. Drop something and he comes running. Make noise in one room and he'll search the next. The further you get, the more aggressive he becomes. There is no safe place. There is no safe moment. He is always somewhere in the house — and he is always listening.

THE PUZZLES
Every exit is blocked. Every door has a lock. To escape, you need to think. Solve dark, story-driven puzzles scattered across the house. Find hidden items, combine clues, and unlock the path forward — all while staying silent and out of sight. One mistake can cost you everything.

THE STORY
Why are you here again? Why does Evil Doll keep coming back? Short cinematic cutscenes reveal the truth behind the house and the horror that lives inside it. The deeper you go, the darker the story gets. There are answers hidden in this house — if you're brave enough to find them.

RISING DIFFICULTY
Evil Doll 2 is designed to break you slowly. The first room feels manageable. The deeper you go, the tighter the house feels, the faster Evil Doll moves, and the harder the puzzles become. It never lets you relax. That's the point.
UNLOCKABLES & SECRETS
Hidden throughout the house are items, clues, and collectibles that unlock new modes, bonus content, and extra story pieces. Brave players who explore every corner will find things most players never see.

★ Smart enemy AI that reacts to sound and movement
★ Multi-floor haunted house with hidden rooms and secret areas
★ Tense escape room puzzles with real consequences
★ Multiple endings based on your choices
★ Cinematic horror cutscenes and dark story
★ Unlockable content, modes, and hidden secrets
★ Free to play — no internet required

The house remembers.
Evil Doll is waiting.
Can you survive Evil Doll 2?

data.name: FIFA Heroes: Soccer Action
data.description_full:
FIFA Heroes is a new breed of fast-paced, arcade style, soccer mobile game where you can build a squad of soccer superstars and legends, FIFA World Cup™ mascots, surprise celebrities, mythical heroes and other beloved characters. Play it to dominate the leaderboard in real-time multiplayer matches. Gameplay consists of 5v5 street soccer games with unique power ups. The variety of characters, the unique looks you can create for them, the non-simulation fantasy-breaker gameplay, and the exciting game modes with casual controls all add up to a fresh new take on the future of soccer gaming.

FIFA OFFICIAL LICENSED GAME
FIFA Heroes lets you dominate the leaderboards in style with FIFA World Cup 2026™ soccer superstars and mascots! Maple™ the Moose, Zayu™ the Jaguar and Clutch™ the Bald Eagle, as well as many other FIFA World Cup mascots from the past, are playable characters in the game, all with their own unique skill moves and goal celebrations!

ISHOWSPEED
Pure speed. Pure chaos. Pure entertainment. The human highlight reel is a playable character, here to unleash the fastest show in soccer and turn every match into a viral moment. Out-hype everyone by playing over-the-top power moves and scoring crazy goals with IShowSpeed, Central Cee, Marlon, J Balvin, Luva and the most exciting soccer players today, including Enzo Fernandez and Joao Pedro.

INNOVATIVE GAMEPLAY EXPERIENCE
A 5v5 multiplayer soccer gameplay experience like never before, FIFA Heroes breaks the fantasy of simulation games from the past, enabling you to build crazy squads where soccer legends team up with today’s soccer stars, celebrities, and all sorts of other characters to play for glory inside a volcano, or on a glacier, or many other mind-blowing soccer pitches. Each character has a crazy skill/power move and celebration—a soccer game unlike any other.

BUILD YOUR FANTASY SOCCER TEAM
Choose soccer stars from the FIFA World Cup™ national teams past and present, and pair them up with mascots, mythical characters and more. Mix-and-match to find your perfect pick at each position on the playing field, then level up your players to increase their skills and power. Make the squad uniquely yours, then show it off in blitz matches, while sharpening your skills with every match you play.

FAST-PACED FIFA STREET SOCCER
Take it to the streets! Your speed, skills and reflexes are as important as having the right characters in your squad. Experience heart-pounding, turbocharged moments of multiplayer gameplay that will test your reaction time on the way to leaderboard domination.

SEASON PASSES
New heroes step onto the field and enrich your gameplay. Play throughout the season pass for your chance to unlock new rewards, including heroes, new emojis, new avatars, and more. Dive back in to find out which unique characters could line up in your squad.

MAKE IT UNIQUE
Show off to your friends and other players from around the world with your choice of characters, pitch, gear and your collection of emotes. The combination possibilities are endless. Have fun with it!

PLAY FIFA HEROES ANYTIME, ANYWHERE
The most exciting soccer gaming experience in years is available at your fingertips, any time you feel like playing. There is always one more match waiting for you to dominate the competition.

Build your squad, master their skills, and dominate the competition in a brand-new way to play the world’s favorite sport.

data.name: Shadow Fight 4: Arena-VTC Game
data.description_full:
TRỞ THÀNH TƯỚNG CỦA SHADOW FIGHT TRONG TRÒ CHƠI CHIẾN ĐẤU NHIỀU NGƯỜI CHƠI MỚI!

⚔️Đấu với người chơi khác trong trò chơi chiến đấu 3D trực tuyến miễn phí. Cạnh tranh trong các trận PVP 2 người chơi hoặc đấu nhanh với bạn bè. Chào mừng đến vương quốc ninja! ĐẤU NGAY!⚔️

★★★ Trò chơi di động hay nhất 2020 (Giải thưởng DevGAMM) ★★★
★★★ Các trò chơi Shadow Fight đã được tải về hơn 500 triệu lần ★★★

Đồ họa 3D sống động
- Đồ họa 3D đỉnh cao cùng hoạt ảnh chân thực cho bạn những pha hành động chiến đấu hoành tráng nhất.

Điều khiển dễ dàng
- Điều khiển tướng như trong các trò chơi chiến đấu cổ điển và có trải nghiệm chiến đấu hệt như máy chơi game ngay trên thiết bị di động.

Chế độ câu chuyện PvE
- Khi chiến đấu với đối thủ AI ở chế độ câu chuyện, bạn sẽ thân thuộc với các tướng hơn và biết được những câu chuyện trong thế giới Shadow Fight!

Trận chiến nhiều người chơi thú vị
- Lập đội gồm 3 tướng và chiến đấu trong chế độ nhiều người chơi trực tuyến. Bạn thắng trận đấu chỉ khi đánh bại được tất cả các tướng đối thủ trong trận chiến đỉnh cao. Hoặc đấu ngoại tuyến với các robot học máy tiên tiến!

Các vị tướng đỉnh cao
- Xây dựng đội gồm những chiến binh giỏi nhất, samurai và ninja. Thu thập và nâng cấp tất cả tướng — Mỗi tướng có những khả năng riêng để thay đổi và điều chỉnh theo phong cách.

Tài năng của Tướng
- Tăng cấp và mở khóa tài năng ninja. Chọn các tài năng hàng đầu và hợp với lối chơi của bạn, thay đổi chúng và thử nghiệm để tăng tỷ lệ thắng. Quyết định phong cách nào thú vị nhất! Chiến đấu với những kẻ bất tử!

Vé Chiến Đấu
- Một mùa giải mới bắt đầu mỗi tháng — nhận rương và xu miễn phí để chiến thắng! Gói đăng ký cho bạn sử dụng các vật phẩm trang trí cao cấp và nhận thẻ thưởng miễn phí không có quảng cáo.

Đấu nhanh với bạn bè
- Tìm ra người chơi Shadow Fight hàng đầu: thách đấu với bạn bè trong trận đấu PvP. Gửi lời mời hoặc tham gia với một người bạn đang chơi — bạn có thể thực hiện một số luyện tập hoặc đấu ngay với nhau!

Các vật phẩm trang trí và tùy chỉnh
- Skin cực ngầu cho các Tướng — chiến thắng đầy phong cách
- Biểu tượng cảm xúc và chế nhạo — gửi chúng cho đối thủ để thể hiện ưu thế hoặc cảm ơn họ vì một trận đấu hay
- Các tư thế đỉnh cao và bước di chuyển của ninja — ăn mừng chiến thắng bằng hành động 3D thú vị

Trở thành chiến binh hàng đầu
- Đấu trường rất dễ làm quen, nhưng để thực sự thành thạo chế độ nhiều người chơi, bạn sẽ cần xem video hướng dẫn, luyện tập với bạn bè và tham gia cộng đồng tích cực của chúng tôi.

Giải đấu PvP trực tuyến
- Tham gia các giải đấu để nhận phần thưởng và các trải nghiệm mới thú vị. Vị trí dẫn đầu sẽ mang lại cho bạn những giải thưởng tuyệt vời, nhưng nếu để thua vài trận, bạn sẽ bị loại. Tham gia một giải đấu khác để chiến đấu giành chiến thắng một lần nữa!

Giao tiếp
- Trò chuyện với người chơi khác trên Discord, trong nhóm Facebook của chúng tôi hoặc trên Reddit. Hãy là người đầu tiên nhận tất cả tin tức mới nhất và tìm hiểu bí mật của những người chơi khác. Mời bạn bè và cùng vui chơi!

Tôi đã rất muốn được chơi một trò chơi chiến đấu PvP hoặc quyền anh trên thiết bị di động kể từ khi Shadow Fight 2 ra mắt. Arena đã biến ước mơ đó của tôi thành hiện thực. Đây là trò chơi hành động dành cho tất cả mọi người. Nếu cảm thấy hứng thú, bạn có thể vào đấu nhanh để tăng thứ hạng, và khi cần nghỉ ngơi, bạn có thể chơi ngoại tuyến và chiến đấu với các thể bóng tối của những vị thần bất tử. Bạn sẽ cảm thấy mình giống như một ninja. Và trò chơi này miễn phí!

How to Play Omi4:
Objective:
Win the highest number of tricks each round to earn tokens and
secure victory.

Dealing Cards:
Omi4 uses a 32-card deck (from the standard 52-card pack).
Each player receives two batches of four cards, totaling eight
cards per player.

Choosing the Trump Suit:
The player to the dealer’s right selects the trump suit,
which outranks all other suits for that round.

Leading the First Trick:
The player who chose the trump suit leads the first trick.
Other players must follow suit if possible; otherwise,
they may play any card.

Winning Tricks:
The highest card of the suit led wins the trick unless a trump
card is played. If a trump is played, the highest trump wins.
The trick winner leads the next round.

Counting Tricks & Tokens:
5–7 tricks with the trump suit: 1 token for the trump
team. 5–7 tricks without the trump suit: 2 tokens
for the other team.
Winning all 8 tricks: 3 tokens (“Kapothi”).
If both teams win 4 tricks each, no tokens transfer;
the next winning team earns an extra token.

Winning the Game:
The first team to reach 10 tokens or more wins the game
and becomes the ultimate Sinhala Omi champion!

data.name: Flower Power: Blooming
data.description_full:
1. Game Rules
The core gameplay of Flower Power: The Art of Blooming revolves around matching and clearing tiles with identical patterns. Below the playing field, there is a slot that can hold up to 7 tiles. Clicking on a tile automatically places it into this slot. When 3 tiles with the same pattern are in the slot, they will be instantly cleared.

- Tip: You have a maximum of 7 moves per round to clear three tiles of the same design! If the slot fills up without matching three tiles, you lose. Every move counts!

- Layered Tiles: Some tiles may have multiple layers. Only after removing the top layer can you select and clear the lower layers.

- Winning Condition: Once no tiles remain on the board, you have successfully completed the level!
